descriptionHtml:
We are looking for an analytical and business-oriented IT Data Scientist to support data-driven decision-making across the organization. This role will focus on developing predictive models, extracting insights from complex datasets, and translating analytical results into actionable business recommendations.

You will work closely with IT, business, and analytics stakeholders to drive value through data, improve operational performance, and support strategic initiatives.


Responsibilities

  • Analyze large, structured, and unstructured datasets to identify trends, patterns, and business insights.
  • Develop, validate, and deploy statistical models, machine learning algorithms, and predictive analytics solutions.
  • Translate complex data findings into clear insights and recommendations for business stakeholders.
  • Collaborate with data engineers and IT teams to ensure data quality, availability, and scalability.
  • Design and maintain dashboards, reports, and data visualizations to support decision-making.
  • Support experimentation, forecasting, and scenario analysis to improve business outcomes.
  • Ensure adherence to data governance, security, and compliance standards.
  • Document models, methodologies, and analytical processes.


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Computer Science, Mathematics, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2 years of experience in data analysis, data science, or advanced analytics roles.
  • Strong proficiency in Python or R, SQL, and data manipulation techniques.
  • Familiarity with data visualization tools (e.g., Power BI, Tableau).
  • Strong understanding of probability, statistics, and analytical problem-solving.
  • Experience working with large datasets and cloud-based analytics platforms is an advantage.

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. descriptionHtml:
Job Description

This role protects company information and infrastructure from cyber threats by investigating and preventing breaches and developing security strategies. Strong technical expertise, analytical skills, and effective communication are required.

  • Identity & Access Management: Manage access controls, key management, PKI, MFA, and data protection.
  • Security Operations: Monitor security threats in real-time using SIEM, analyze incidents, and perform incident response and threat intelligence.
  • Infrastructure & Network Security: Ensure security of servers, networks, and endpoints through configuration, hardening, patch management, and endpoint protection.
  • Application Security: Perform secure code reviews, vulnerability assessments, and security testing (SAST/DAST) to test application security.
  • Penetration Testing & Red Teaming: Conduct penetration testing on applications, networks, and systems to identify vulnerabilities and provide recommendations for improvements.




Requirements:

  1. Minimum bachelor's degree in computer science, Information Systems, or related field.
  2. Minimum 4 years of experience in cyber security or related field.
  3. Preferably have relevant cyber security certifications such as CISSP, CISM, CEH, or specific certifications in SOC, Forensic, Network, or Application Security.
  4. Experience with security tools such as Microsoft Entra ID, CyberArk, IBM QRadar, Burp Suite, Fortify, SonarQube, Nessus, Kali Linux, etc.
  5. Deep knowledge of security standards such as ISO 27001, NIST, GDPR, etc.
  6. Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.

descriptionHtml:
Bank Mandiri is one of the biggest, leading financial institutions in Indonesia, providing services to customers with a wide array of banking, investing, asset management, and other sustainable financial products and solutions. We believe that digital technology will continue to change Indonesia’s banking landscape in the future, along with the rapid migration of people’s activities to digital channels. Having started the digital transformation journey long before the pandemic, Bank Mandiri reaffirms our commitment to accelerating digital transformation and innovation towards becoming the best modern, digital bank in Indonesia to provide a better life for customers through our integrated digital financial services.


To support our aspirations, our various business segments, and our strong performance-driven culture across the organization, Bank Mandiri is committed to attracting and retaining high-quality talents across the country to ensure our further accomplishments. You will be immersed in an exceptional and challenging work environment and surrounded by colleagues and leaders who are passionate about helping you grow.

The ODP Information Technology (IT) program is designed to develop and hone digital talents to be leaders and professionals who are passionate and capable in IT and technology transformation. You will be trained by highly experienced IT leaders and experts in various aspects of IT and digital banking throughout your development journey. Starting off with an intensive in-class education followed by on-the-job training and rotation across different IT departments of the Bank.

  • Bachelor's degree (S1): minimum 3,00 on a 4,00 GPA scale, or equivalent
  • Master's degree (S2): minimum 3,20 on a 4,00 GPA scale, or equivalent
  • Maximum age at selection:
  • Bachelor's degree (S1): 25 years old
  • Master's degree (S2): 27 years old
  • Demonstrate professional dispositions with good networking and communication skills
  • Fluent in English, both written and verbal communication
  • No member of the nuclear family currently works in Bank Mandiri (i.e., parents, siblings)
  • Single, never been married, and willing to remain unmarried during the first year of the program's journey
  • Willing to be relocated all over Indonesia


Required Skills

  • Good networking skills in formal and non-formal approaches with various levels of correspondence
  • Entrepreneurial, eager to connect with others, and willing to be part of related activities inside and outside of the organization to achieve goals
  • Good critical thinking and analytical skills in inquiring and acquiring relevant, comprehensive information
  • Excellent in communicating ideas, clearly and effectively to gain understanding and commitment from others

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

  • Mengidentifikasi sumber data yang relevan, mengumpulkan data yang dibutuhkan, serta melengkapi data yang hilang atau tidak lengkap dari sistem internal dan eksternal.
  • Melakukan pembersihan, validasi, dan persiapan data untuk memastikan akurasi, konsistensi, dan kemudahan penggunaan data.

  • Mengidentifikasi tren, pola, dan anomali dalam data untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan berbasis data.
  • Mengembangkan visualisasi data, dashboard, dan laporan analitis menggunakan tools yang sesuai.
  • Menyiapkan dan mempresentasikan laporan analisis serta dashboard kepada manajemen eksekutif dan tim proyek.

  • Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 2 tahun sebagai Data Analyst atau posisi lain yang berfokus pada data.

  • Mahir menggunakan Power BI, termasuk data modeling, DAX, pembuatan dashboard, publikasi laporan, dan pengaturan refresh data.
  • Menguasai Microsoft Excel tingkat lanjut, termasuk Pivot Table, Power Query, formula lanjutan (INDEX-MATCH/XLOOKUP, array formulas), serta Macro.
  • Memiliki kemampuan SQL yang kuat (GoogleSQL, MySQL, PostgreSQL, atau sejenisnya) untuk query kompleks, ekstraksi, dan transformasi data.

  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik serta mampu menjelaskan hasil analisis kepada stakeholder non-teknis.

descriptionHtml:
Who are we?

Amar Bank is one of the most technologically advanced digital banks in Indonesia. Our leading

digital lending product, Tunaiku has the distinction of being the first FinTech product in

Indonesia. We are also the first digital bank on the cloud. As the first profitable digital bank, we

managed to get listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange.

How did we manage to do that?

We are changing people’s perception of a bank. We believe we are the innovators who combine

customer focus principles with creating technology-based impact. We incorporate freedom and

flexibility as part of our startup working culture DNA to encourage innovation in creating better

financial solutions for the banking industry. We think of ourselves as, ‘A technology company

with a banking license’. For this reason, we ‘Act like a FinTech, and think like a Bank.’

How did it all start?

Founded on March 15, 1991, in Surabaya as PT Anglomas International Bank (Amin Bank), the

bank was acquired by Tolaram Group and transformed to PT Bank Amar Indonesia (Amar Bank)

in 2014. It has then undergone a significant digital transformation to become one of the

country's forerunning fintech institutions through its award-winning digital lending platform,

Tunaiku.

Our philosophy, mission, and vision

Technology must impact lives, must improve lives. We exist to provide banking to those who

‘need’ and not only to those who ‘want’. Services when provided to those who need at the time

of their need brings smiles. Our vision is to bring 200 million smiles.

More About The Bank With Startup Culture Environment

Consist of 1000+ people, you will meet people who love to grow, dream big, and actually have

fun at the workplace! We provide a great working environment that pushes people to grow

outside their comfort zone. People with high drive and ambition find us a very attractive place to

work as their career growth matches their own drive and not any staid policies. Thus we hold

the honor of being awarded “Best Place to Work in Indonesia”.

Recently Amar Bank was awarded as Inspirational Brand from APEA (Asia Pacific Enterprise

Awards) 2022. Of course, our innovation won't stop here. So if you would love to be a part of it,

have a growth mindset, and are constantly hungry for challenges, we invite you to join us in our

journey to ‘Impact Lives’.

Join us today and create #unlimitedinnovations!

Business Analyst staff will be directly reporting to Business Analyst Circle Lead and also EVP Finance. He/She will have a great deal of exposure about the company’s businesses especially its flagship product, Tunaiku and Finance related matters. Will be involved in various stage of business process along with other team members and other functions. Due to the nature of the job, it is also expected that the team member is committed to the position.

Responsibilities:

  • Analyze the current processes
  • Will be involved in the analysis of treasury transactions and Tunaiku loans
  • Assist and coordinate with related parties in designing an effective and efficient workflow
  • Implements and monitors the progress of development projects to ensure the smooth running of business and compliance within the industry environment
  • Collect data and analyze the Bank's performance, including financial reports, in accordance with predetermined deadlines

Job Description

  • Provide first-level and technical support for the university’s core applications (e.g., ACADIS, LMS, HR System, Finance System).
  • Diagnose and resolve system-related issues in collaboration with Information System Officer or vendors.
  • Assist in implementing and configuring software modules based on functional specifications or user requests.
  • Execute development tasks under supervision, such as setting up workflows, templates, forms, or parameters in supported applications.
  • Retrieve, process, and validate structured data from databases or systems for reporting, analysis, or integration purposes.

  • Support communication with external vendors or third-party developers by preparing technical details, screenshots, or log data necessary to resolve escalated issues.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Informatics, or a related technical field.
  • 1-3 years of experience in a technical IT support or application support role
  • Exposure to information systems in educational institutions is a plus
  • Experienced in Java and SQL is a must.
  • Fluency in Bahasa Indonesia and proficiency in English

descriptionHtml:
About The Role

Blibli OMG is part of Blibli’s expanding retail ecosystem, focused on delivering seamless in-store experiences and keeping our operations running smoothly. As our retail network continues to grow, reliable IT support plays a crucial role in ensuring stores and teams can operate efficiently.

As a Junior Technical Support, you will be responsible for supporting day-to-day IT operations across our retail stores and internal teams. You will ensure that hardware, software, and network systems are properly set up, maintained, and functioning — helping teams work without interruption. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys hands-on technical work, problem-solving, and continuous learning in a fast-paced retail environment.

Your contribution will directly support Blibli OMG’s operational excellence and growth, enabling smooth store operations and efficient internal systems.

What You’ll Do

  • Troubleshoot and fix issues with computers, printers, and software
  • Help users connect to the network (Wi-Fi or wired) and solve small network-related problems
  • Handle basic networking (TCP/IP, subnetting) and assist with installing CCTV & NVR systems
  • Set up laptops, desktops, printers, and other hardware for new users
  • Install and configure company-approved software
  • Keep IT equipment inventory and location records up to date
  • Perform regularly scheduled IT maintenance activities to ensure system reliability.

Qualification

  • Strong communication skills — you can talk tech in a way that everyone understands
  • Team player, but also great at working independently
  • Responsible, detail-oriented, and proactive in spotting and solving issues
  • Open to learning new technologies and growing your skills
  • Nice to have: Certifications like CCNA, MTCNA, or similar tech credentials

Why You’ll Love Working Here

At Blibli OMG, we believe smooth operations start with strong technical support. You’ll work with collaborative teams who value learning, ownership, and continuous improvement. This is a place where your technical skills make a real impact — and where you’ll have the opportunity to grow as the retail business grows.

  • Prior experience in conducting statistical experimentation or A/B testing is a plus.
  • Prior experience in developing unsupervised/supervised models is a plus.
  • Prior experience in working on cloud platforms (GCP, AWS, Azure, etc.) is a plus.

Company Description

SAMPOERNA ACADEMY

Our teaching philosophy encourages students to inquire, explore, innovate and communicate, providing vital skills required for leadership in Indonesia and abroad. Coupled with internationally-recognized academic credentials, we are equipping our students to compete and succeed at every stage of life. With the advent of the information age available at our finger-tips, our job as a school is to teach our students “to learn how to learn”.

Drawing from the world’s best curricula and American-based STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Math) methodologies, we are equipping our students with global exposure and an internationally-recognized academic qualification.

Our environment was created to encourage a culture of innovation and collaboration. Moreover, our integration of communication, multiple language proficiency, and collaboration in team projects set us apart from most other schools in ASEAN.

Vision

Sampoerna Academy graduates will assume leadership roles in a global society by being creative, passionate, life-long learners who are able to meet the challenges of a rapidly changing world and who care deeply for their fellow men and the environment.

Mission

The mission of Sampoerna Academy is to provide a safe, caring, and collaborative learning environment that is of the highest quality and meets global expectations for student achievement and character development. Our educational foundation is student-centered with a strong emphasis on Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Mathematics (STEAM) which enables students to become mature, confident global citizens with a strong sense of purpose. Our end goal is to prepare students for tertiary education and to make them work-ready and world-ready.

Core Beliefs

  • Academically, we prioritize the development of cognitive skills and communication skills over rote memorization because we believe that more than acquiring facts, students must be able to apply their knowledge in real situations.
  • We seek opportunities to engage all stakeholders to play a part in the success of our students.
  • We maintain a strong Asian cultural value system that celebrates social harmony, order, and respect.
  • STEAM competency will differentiate our students from those attending other schools.
  • Our learning spaces are a platform for hands-on activities, exploration, inquiry and the creation of knowledge and dialogue.

Job Description

  • Preparation of laboratory practicals, including set-up and breakdown as per teachers’ requests, testing such labs and equipment beforehand to ensure a successful learning experience
  • Ensuring all laboratory equipment is in good working condition, clean, stored in a safe manner and inventoried periodically.
  • Ensuring adequate supply of equipment and materials is always available
  • Responsible for checking the orders upon delivery to ensure orders are complete and in good condition.
  • Safe storage and removal of harmful chemicals and equipment
  • Keeping track of materials borrowed by teachers and students
  • Maintaining general tidiness and organization of the laboratories at the end of each workday
  • Labeling, organizing and storing chemicals and materials with awareness of safety issues, and inventory periodically.
  • Mixing of chemicals required for experiments.
  • Storage and disposal of chemicals, chemical compounds and waste materials in a safe manner.
  • Being proactive in matters relating to Health and Safety
  • Assisting the teacher in supervision of laboratory practicals when needed
  • Assist teachers in conducting experiments, if instructed.
  • Assisting students in carrying out experiments, when necessary, under the guidance of the teacher

Qualifications

  • Diploma or Bachelor in Science
  • fresh graduate are welcome, preferably in an educational institution and with laboratory background
  • Familiar with Cambridge curriculum
  • Knowledge of current lab safety regulations
  • Knowledge of general science, biology, chemistry, and physics lab procedures
  • Ability to manage a science laboratory and relevant chemicals & equipment
  • Prior working in a science laboratory

Additional Information

Internship Period: February - May 2026

descriptionHtml:
About The Role

Blibli is on a journey to become Indonesia’s #1 e-commerce platform — built on trust, innovation, and care. We’re creating better experiences for customers and sellers through technology, collaboration, and a deep commitment to quality. Here, every idea matters, and every action helps us grow stronger together.

In Operations, you’ll make sure every process runs smoothly to deliver the speed and reliability our customers expect. Your precision and ownership keep Blibli’s promise alive — ensuring every package, process, and interaction meets our standard of excellence.

As a Reverse Logistics Junior Officer, you’ll organize and manage the physical transportation of returned products — ensuring seamless movement between customers, merchants, and Blibli’s facilities nationwide. You’ll analyze logistics performance, collaborate with partners, and identify opportunities for continuous improvement to make our return management process more reliable and efficient.

What We’ll Work On Together

Operational Monitoring & Process Management

  • Coordinate and monitor the end-to-end return logistics process, ensuring service level agreements (SLAs) are achieved.
  • Escalate and resolve process bottlenecks or SLA deviations promptly.
  • Develop and implement new return logistics procedures to improve efficiency and compliance.
  • Track and report on logistics performance metrics, operational accuracy, and service reliability.
  • Oversee day-to-day outsourced return operations and ensure effective collaboration with external partners.

Asset Recovery & Value Optimization

  • Manage and evaluate returned goods stored in warehouses to determine optimal recovery or disposal strategies.
  • Collaborate with vendors to maximize asset recovery value and explore new channels for sales or liquidation.
  • Provide ongoing analysis on return-related costs, process efficiency, and value realization.

Collaboration & Continuous Improvement

  • Work cross-functionally to analyze root causes of return issues and recommend process improvements.
  • Establish and monitor performance metrics for both internal teams and 3PL partners.
  • Support logistics data reporting, trend analysis, and performance reviews to enhance decision-making.

Qualification

What You'll Bring To The Team

  • Bachelor’s degree, preferably in Information Systems, Computer Science, Information Management, Law, or Criminology.
  • Fresh graduates are welcome to apply.
  • Strong logical thinking, analytical mindset, and problem-solving skills.
  • Proficient in Microsoft Office, especially Excel.
  • Excellent communication skills to coordinate with diverse stakeholders.
  • Able to work independently and collaboratively with a positive, can-do attitude.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

We believe growth happens where people feel safe to share, fail, and try again. Here, you’ll find teammates who push you to do better, not harder — and leaders who listen before they lead. Whether you’re learning something new or teaching what you know, there’s always room to grow together.

About The Job Business Analyst - Jakarta Placement

Meratus Group is a leading integrated maritime and logistics operator in Indonesia, pioneering innovative solutions that drive efficiency and sustainability in the industry. With a rich history dating back to 1957, Meratus has evolved into a powerhouse, operating over 45 shipping routes, a fleet of 100 vessels, and a network of container terminals and logistics centers.

At Meratus, we are committed to digitalization, innovation, and transformation, ensuring seamless logistics and maritime services across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Our customer-centric approach and agile operations empower businesses to navigate complex supply chain challenges with confidence.

We take pride in fostering a dynamic and inclusive workplace, where talented professionals can thrive and contribute to shaping the future of maritime logistics. Join us and be part of a team that is redefining industry standards while making a meaningful impact on global trade and sustainability.

We are seeking a Business Analyst to connect business needs with IT solutions. You will analyze requirements, design improvements, support testing, and train users to ensure effective and efficient systems.

Responsibilities

  • Design and recommend solutions that improve application efficiency and effectiveness.
  • Conduct training sessions to support user adoption of new features and processes.

Requirements

  • ﻿﻿Bachelors degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Administration, or related field.

  • Ability to create clear and comprehensive FSDs, test cases, and training documentation.
  • Familiarity with project management tools or methodologies (e.g., Agile, Scrum, or Waterfall) is a plus.﻿

Join Us in Strengthening Data Excellence at Bank OCBC Indonesia


At Bank OCBC Indonesia, we believe that the quality of our data shapes the quality of our decisions. That’s why we’re committed to building a strong foundation in Data Governance and Data Management and we’re looking for passionate professionals to join our journey.


In this role, you’ll be part of the Risk Management Group, working closely with cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders to improve how we manage, govern, and protect the integrity of our data.


What You’ll Do

  • Review and monitor data quality profiles on a regular basis.
  • Identify root causes of data issues and ensure effective corrective actions are implemented.
  • Develop and update data management policies and governance structures to maintain best practices.
  • Coordinate with the Data Management Council (DMC) and Data Working Group (DWG) to drive data governance initiatives.
  • Oversee the creation and maintenance of data management tools to ensure relevance and effectiveness.


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Informatics, Management, Accounting, or related fields (or equivalent experience).
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in Finance & Accounting, MIS, or Internal Audit.
  • Strong analytical and strategic thinking skills.

Why Join Us?

You’ll play a key role in ensuring that our data is reliable, well-governed, and ready to support critical business decisions. This is your chance to be part of a team where data quality directly translates into business excellence.

Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

Like our full-time staff, you’ll work alongside some of the world’s top minds on cases that reshape business, government, and society. Consulting work is varied and rigorous, much of it performed at our client sites. Projects can vary in length, size, and location, depending on the client’s challenge. You’ll collaborate on challenging projects with team members from many backgrounds and disciplines, increasing your understanding of complex business problems from diverse perspectives and developing new skills and experience to help you in the future, be that at BCG or beyond.

BCG offers a comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental and vision coverage, telemedicine services, life, accident and disability insurance, parental leave and family planning benefits, caregiving resources, mental health offerings, a generous retirement program, financial guidance, paid time off, and more.

What You'll Bring

  • Penultimate year students and graduated students with less than 6 months experience are welcome to apply
  • Outstanding academic performance and strong record of extracurricular activity
  • Strong research/analysis experience and abilities, including excellent Excel skills
  • Able to work creatively and analytically
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, age, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity / expression, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected under national, provincial, or local law, where applicable, and those with criminal histories will be considered in a manner consistent with applicable state and local laws.

SAMPOERNA ACADEMY

Our teaching philosophy encourages students to inquire, explore, innovate and communicate, providing vital skills required for leadership in Indonesia and abroad. Coupled with internationally-recognized academic credentials, we are equipping our students to compete and succeed at every stage of life. With the advent of the information age available at our finger-tips, our job as a school is to teach our students “to learn how to learn”.

Drawing from the world’s best curricula and American-based STEAM (Science, Technology, Engineering, Arts, and Math) methodologies, we are equipping our students with global exposure and an internationally-recognized academic qualification.

Our environment was created to encourage a culture of innovation and collaboration. Moreover, our integration of communication, multiple language proficiency, and collaboration in team projects set us apart from most other schools in ASEAN.

Vision

Sampoerna Academy graduates will assume leadership roles in a global society by being creative, passionate, life-long learners who are able to meet the challenges of a rapidly changing world and who care deeply for their fellow men and the environment.

Mission

descriptionHtml:
CrossBoundary Advisory

About The Firm

Founded in 2011, CrossBoundary is a mission-driven investment firm committed to unlocking the power of capital for sustainable growth and strong returns in underserved markets. CrossBoundary provides transaction and investment advisory services, having developed a specialized expertise in unleashing investment across all sectors in these markets. Our advisory clients include governments, development finance institutions, private equity firms, Fortune 100 companies, and research institutions. Learn more at www.crossboundary.com

Job Description

CrossBoundary is recruiting a consultant to lead transaction teams focused on unlocking private capital in Indonesia. We are seeking candidates with 10-15+ years of experience living and working in-market, with strong contacts across the region’s power and infrastructure sector, and a thorough understanding of the investment landscape.

CrossBoundary is an investment firm. As a Consultant, you will lead a transaction advisory team and oversee mandate execution in pipeline building, investment facilitation, commercial due diligence, and market studies. Consultants also lead country-level business development and grow the business activities of CrossBoundary in the region, originating transactions and projects.

Who We Are

The CrossBoundary team is a unique group made up of people who are genuinely excited by the opportunity to make a difference in some of the most challenging yet exciting markets in the world. Team members come from diverse backgrounds but share several qualities: curiosity, humility, integrity, a drive for excellence, and a bias for action.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Lead business development across multiple channels, including private commercial opportunities and government- / donor-sponsored opportunities
  • Provide continuous client coverage of private capital investors, development finance institutions (DFIs), corporates ranging from SMEs to MNCs, and other relevant organizations to proactively identify advisory opportunities
  • Manage relationships with key CrossBoundary clients; provide strategic into program design and oversee mandate execution and reporting
  • Investment target identification and screening
    • Use conventional and unconventional channels to identify and rigorously assess investment opportunities
    • For targets that are not yet investment-ready, be able to concisely map out paths to investability and resources required to achieve investability
    • Be able to credibly articulate investment opportunities’ social and environmental impact narratives
  • Investor identification and relationship building
    • Understand investor mandates, criteria, preferences, and existing portfolios
    • Understand investor appetite to work with DFIs or other development-oriented actors
    • Manage investor relationships
  • Detailed commercial due diligence/vendor due diligence
    • Directly conduct or facilitate investor (‘buy-side) commercial due diligence
    • Compile and curate a comprehensive virtual data room
  • Robust, multi-faceted corporate and project finance models, including valuations, of private companies using rigorous, defensible methodologies
  • Draft investment memoranda and teasers, author and update sophisticated financial models
  • Recommendations on optimal transaction structures based upon near-, medium- and long-term company strategic objectives and capitalization parameters, available instruments, and investor preferences
    • Draft detailed illustrative term sheets for debt and equity deals
  • Market assessment and ongoing market analysis
    • Conduct macroeconomic and geopolitical market assessments
    • Provide sector analysis of priority areas for investment
Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree required; Master’s degree strongly preferred, ideally in Business Administration, Finance or other relevant advanced degree
  • 10+ years of experience at one of the following:
    • the project finance team of top-tier investment or commercial bank or DFI or specialist advisor with proven success; or
    • an asset manager investing in energy or infrastructure; or
    • a clean energy project developer with a sizable project portfolio
  • Experience sourcing, advising on, and closing transactions in emerging markets in the energy transition sector or broader infrastructure sectors
  • Demonstrated ability to project manage complex transactions, strategic advisory engagements, and team members
  • The following experiences will be regarded favourably:
    • Experience taking a power or infrastructure project from origination to financial close in emerging or frontier markets
    • Experience in clean power and energy transition strategic advisory engagements with public and private sector stakeholders (e.g. roadmaps, stakeholder engagements, and capital maps)
Think you have what it takes but not sure you check every box? Research shows that while men apply to roles when they meet an average of 60% of the criteria, women often only apply when they meet every requirement. If you're passionate about what we're building, we want to hear from you!

Locations

The chosen candidate will join our team in Indonesia.

Equal Opportunity Employer

CrossBoundary is an equal opportunity employer. If you need assistance and/or a reasonable accommodation due to a disability during the application or the recruiting process, please send a request to our recruiting@crossboundary.com

descriptionHtml:
Blibli is on a journey to become Indonesia’s #1 e-commerce platform — built on trust, innovation, and care. We’re creating better experiences for customers and sellers through technology, collaboration, and a deep commitment to quality. Here, every idea matters, and every action helps us grow stronger together.

In Commercial, you’ll help connect customers with the products and partners they love. Your work supports category growth, strengthens seller relationships, and creates shopping experiences that are seamless, memorable, and keep customers coming back to Blibli. Data is at the heart of every strategic decision we make. As we continue to scale and refine our products and operations, we rely on accurate insights, strong analysis, and thoughtful recommendations to move the business forward.

As a Data Analyst, you’ll play a key role in supporting cross‑functional teams with actionable insights. You’ll transform raw data into meaningful stories, uncover trends that influence product and business decisions, and ensure high data accuracy for reporting and analytics. Your work will help strengthen our data‑driven culture and empower teams to make smarter, faster decisions.

What We’ll Work On Together

  • Analyze and interpret data to support product, operational, and business decisions across multiple teams.
  • Build, clean, and maintain datasets and data models, ensuring accuracy, structure, and reliability for analysis and reporting.
  • Develop dashboards and reports using tools like Looker Studio, Tableau, and Google Data Studio to communicate key performance metrics.
  • Conduct A/B testing and experiment analysis to evaluate product performance and recommend improvements.
  • Identify trends, patterns, and anomalies to uncover opportunities and potential risks.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand business questions, translate them into analytical requirements, and present insights clearly.
  • Contribute to a data‑driven culture by sharing best practices, documenting methodologies, and improving analytics workflows.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Statistics, or a related quantitative field.
  • 2+ years of experience as a Data Analyst or in a similar analytics role.
  • Proficient in A/B Testing, BigQuery, Data Modeling, Data Cleaning, Visualization, and tracking tools such as Datatracker.
  • Strong skills in Looker Studio / Google Data Studio, Google Analytics, Tableau, Excel, and PowerPoint.
  • Solid understanding of statistics, experiment design, and data interpretation.
  • Certification in Google Analytics, Tableau, or Looker Studio is a plus.
  • Prior experience or knowledge of search or recommendation systems is preferred.

We believe growth happens where people feel safe to share, fail, and try again. Here, you’ll find teammates who push you to do better, not harder — and leaders who listen before they lead. Whether you’re learning something new or teaching what you know, there’s always room to grow together.

descriptionHtml:
We’re Hiring an ICT Officer!

We are looking for an ICT Officer to support ICT operations at our Head Office and Site. This role ensures all ICT equipment and systems are well-maintained, troubleshooted, and available to support office and plant activities. The ICT Officer will also provide technical assistance to end users, manage ICT assets, and participate in infrastructure projects to strengthen ICT operations across the company.

Work Location: Head Office, Jakarta

Reporting Line: This position reports directly to the ICT Lead

Job Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree in Information & Communication Technology.
  • Minimum 3-5 years of experience in IT, preferably in chemical, oil & gas, or IT industry.
  • Knowledge of Windows operating systems (PC & server), TCP/IP networking & cabling, endpoint security, and radio communication programming & maintenance.
  • Trained in Windows Server Administration, networking (firewall, router, switch), Microsoft 365, endpoint security & access control, IP PBX, and radio configuration.
  • Good troubleshooting skills in hardware and software.
  • Strong communication skills to support end users.
  • Hardworking, disciplined, result-oriented, and able to work under pressure.
  • Physically able to manage hardware setup and troubleshooting.
  • Good comprehension of technical literature/manuals in English.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Set up IT equipment, install networking systems, and ensure proper software installation.
  • Provide ICT technical support and resolve user inquiries.
  • Conduct routine checks on ICT equipment to prevent malfunctions.
  • Maintain and operate company drone equipment.
  • Install and perform minor hardware, software, or peripheral repairs.
  • Escalate unresolved issues to peers, Senior ICT Officer, or ICT Lead.
  • Coordinate with external vendors for major ICT problems.
  • Maintain accurate ICT asset data, ownership status, and licensing records.
  • Participate in ICT infrastructure projects and vendor supervision.
  • Maintain confidentiality of data within company ICT systems.
  • Implement SMK3 and SML, promote compliance, and take corrective actions for non-compliance.

About Us

PT ESSA Industries Indonesia Tbk., formerly known as PT Surya Esa Perkasa Tbk., underwent a transformative rebrand in 2022 to better align with its vision of leading Indonesia's drive towards world-class industrialization. Established in 2006, the company initially ventured into LPG and Condensate production with its refinery facility in Palembang. Over the years, it expanded its operations, notably entering the Ammonia production sector through its subsidiary, PT Panca Amara Utama, at the Banggai Ammonia Plant in Sulawesi Tengah. ESSA has evolved into a leading company committed to contributing to Indonesia's world-class industrialization processes. The company places a strong emphasis on environmental, social, and sustainability considerations in all its endeavors. With records of accomplishment of innovation and excellence, ESSA continues to play a pivotal role in shaping Indonesia's industrial landscape.

About The Role

We are looking for a highly analytical and forward-thinking Assistant Manager – Reporting & Distribution Forecasting to strengthen our reporting excellence and elevate our distribution forecasting capabilities. This role plays a critical part in transforming data into actionable insights, ensuring business leaders have accurate, timely, and meaningful information to drive decisions.

You will own end-to-end reporting and dashboard management while also leading monthly distribution forecasts and contributing to the development of next-generation, ML-based forecasting solutions.

Key Responsibilities

Reporting & Dashboard Excellence

  • Own and manage all reporting and dashboard activities, ensuring accurate and on-time delivery to stakeholders.
  • Lead report consolidation, optimization, and automation to improve efficiency, scalability, and reliability.
  • Assess new reporting and dashboard requirements, translating business needs into clear, impactful analytical outputs.
  • Design and execute a long-term reporting strategy, leveraging modern analytics and visualization tools to unlock deeper insights and enhance decision-making.
  • Drive continuous improvement by simplifying existing reports and eliminating low-value or redundant outputs.

Distribution Forecasting

  • Perform monthly distribution forecasts for each distribution centre, ensuring robustness and transparency in assumptions and outputs.
  • Proactively identify, investigate, and resolve irregularities or outliers in both forecasting results and underlying systems.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams to continuously refine forecasting methodologies and inputs.
  • Lead or support the development of next-generation distribution forecasting, incorporating advanced analytics and machine learning–based techniques to improve accuracy and responsiveness.

What We’re Looking For

Strong analytical and problem-solving capabilities with a structured, detail-oriented mindset.

Experience in reporting, dashboarding, and data automation.

Passion for leveraging new technologies, advanced analytics, and ML to drive business impact.

Ability to translate complex data into clear insights for both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Understanding towards forecasting principles, ideally in supply chain or distribution contexts is a plus.

Excellent communication skills and the confidence to challenge the status quo.

At Unilever we are interested in every individual bringing their ‘Whole Self’ to work and this includes you! Thus if you require any support or access requirements, we encourage you to advise us at the time of your application so that we can support you through your recruitment journey.

Job Description

  • Menangani pengaduan yang dieskalasikan, mencakup masalah teknis maupun non-teknis
  • Melakukan analisis teknis mendalam terhadap masalah yang dieskalasikan, termasuk analisis log, tracing pesan antar API, serta pengecekan utilisasi jaringan dan infrastruktur

  • Pendidikan minimal D3 jurusan Teknik Informatika, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait

  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi yang baik, rapi dalam dokumentasi, dan teliti dalam follow-up
  • Bersedia bekerja dengan sistem shift sesuai kebutuhan operasional
  • Memahami dasar-dasar IT Service Management (ITSM)

  • Familiar dengan aplikasi enterprise, terutama aplikasi berbasis layanan finansial/perbankan

Job Description

Location: Jakarta, Indonesia

Only candidates with the legal right to work in Indonesia will be considered. Please note that applicants without this eligibility will not be considered.

Rolls-Royce is an equal opportunity employer. We embrace diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees.

A new opportunity has arisen for an experienced Electrical Engineer to join our team in Jakarta, Indonesia.

As an Electrical Engineer, you will be responsible for the commissioning, installation, maintenance, and troubleshooting of mtu products and systems. This role is critical in ensuring compliance with Rolls-Royce's QHSE standards and delivering exceptional technical solutions to our customers. You will be the go-to person for addressing electrical issues and enhancing operational efficiency across client sites.

Rolls-Royce Power Systems is headquartered in Friedrichshafen in southern Germany and employs around 9,000 people. The product portfolio includes mtu-brand high-speed engines and propulsion systems for ships, power generation, heavy land, rail and defense vehicles and for the oil and gas industry as well as diesel and gas systems and battery containers for mission critical, standby and continuous power, combined generation of heat and power, and microgrids.

At Rolls-Royce, we look beyond tomorrow. We continually pioneer integrated power and propulsion solutions to deliver cleaner, safer and more competitive power.

Key Accountabilities

  • Ensure all activities are conducted in line with Rolls-Royce policies, Code of Conduct, ISO standards, Quality Management Systems, and QHSE compliance requirements.
  • Drive continuous improvement in processes and procedures for better electrical performance and service delivery.
  • Implement and maintain mtu product electrical quality in all areas of responsibility.
  • Ensure all installations, systems, and applications meet customer requirements and comply with national electrical safety codes and standards.
  • Identify and resolve potential electrical issues in mtu products through innovative and effective solutions.
  • Analyze customer equipment needs, support cost estimation, and help prepare project budgets.
  • Evaluate operational data, analyze malfunction reports, and coordinate troubleshooting efforts with internal and external stakeholders.
  • Foster cross-functional collaboration with engineering teams during commissioning and technical resolutions.
  • Maintain detailed documentation of all commissioning, troubleshooting, and technical interventions for compliance and audit trail.
  • Travel to customer sites within the region to support installation, commissioning, or field servicing needs.

Located in the heart of Alam Sutera, Mercure Serpong Alam Sutera is situated between EMC Hospital and Living World Shopping Mall, at the center of the lifestyle, entertainment, and gastronomical hub. Job Description

Duty Engineer – Summary of Responsibilities

The Duty Engineer ensures the efficient operation, safety, and maintenance of all hotel engineering systems. The role responds to technical issues and emergencies, carries out preventive maintenance, and coordinates with other departments to support smooth hotel operations and guest comfort.

Key Responsibilities – Duty Engineer

  • Ensures the smooth and continuous operation of all hotel engineering systems, including electrical, mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, fire safety, and building services.
  • Responds promptly to maintenance requests, technical issues, and emergencies to minimize disruption to hotel operations and guest comfort.
  • Conducts routine inspections and preventive maintenance according to schedules and engineering standards.
  • Monitors equipment performance and reports faults, defects, or safety hazards to the Chief Engineer.
  • Ensures compliance with safety regulations, fire life safety standards, and statutory requirements.
  • Supervises contractors and external service providers during repair and maintenance works.
  • Maintains accurate maintenance logs, work orders, and shift handover reports.
  • Coordinates closely with Front Office, Housekeeping, and other departments to support daily operations.
  • Ensures proper use, care, and storage of tools, equipment, and spare parts.
  • Acts as the engineering point of contact during assigned shifts and assumes responsibility in the absence of the Chief Engineer.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or vocational certification in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, or related field).
  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in hotel engineering or a similar hospitality environment.
  • Sound knowledge of electrical, mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, and building maintenance systems.
  • Familiar with fire life safety systems and preventive maintenance practices.
  • Ability to respond effectively to emergencies and work shifts as required.
  • Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with internal departments and contractors.
  • Basic computer skills for maintenance, reporting, and documentation.
  • Knowledge of safety regulations and statutory requirements is an advantage.

Additional Information

Job Description

Location: Jakarta, Indonesia

Only candidates with the legal right to work in Indonesia will be considered. Please note that applicants without this eligibility will not be considered.

Why join Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

Position Summary

We are looking for an Application Engineer to support the growth of our PowerGen and Sustainable Solutions business in Indonesia.

This is an office-based technical pre-sales role, where you will act as a technical subject matter expert (SME) partnering closely with the Sales team to develop technically sound, commercially competitive, and customer-aligned solutions.

You will provide customer-facing technical support across the full spectrum of application engineering activities, including equipment sizing, system configuration, integration support, and preparation of technical proposals, drawings, and tender documentation.

This role is ideal for candidates with strong experience in power generation systems, technical sales support, and application engineering, especially within the 1–3MW diesel and gas generator range.

What You Will Be Doing

Technical Sales Support & Solutioning

  • Act as the technical SME, partnering with Sales to support customer solutioning and technical engagement.
  • Work closely with Sales Managers to identify customer requirements and propose suitable technical solutions.
  • Provide technical expertise in sizing, application, configuration, and system integration of equipment and complete system solutions.

Proposals, Drawings & Tender Support

  • Develop and deliver technical proposals for bids and tenders, including drawings, calculations, and supporting documentation in compliance with client specifications.
  • Support bid and tender processes by contributing to solution shaping and supporting pricing strategies through technical documentation and equipment selections.

Customer Engagement & Technical Presentations

  • Participate in meetings, site visits, customer presentations, and negotiations, communicating technical solutions in clear, business-focused language.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with customers, consultants, and contractors.

Application Engineering & Compliance

  • Provide application guidance including load assessments, sizing recommendations, and ensuring compliance with local regulations, standards, and codes relevant to system integration and installation.
  • Coordinate with engineering and project teams to validate feasibility, technical risks, scope alignment, and cost implications.

Sales Cycle Technical Ownership

  • Act as the key technical liaison during the sales cycle, ensuring customer confidence and technical credibility.
  • Support product demonstrations, factory witness tests (when required), and customer technical training sessions.

Continuous Improvement & Compliance

  • Stay updated on market trends and competitor offerings within energy and power solutions, including control systems and emissions requirements.
  • Support internal and external audits and ensure activities align with company policies, quality standards, compliance requirements, and HSE practices.
  • Support additional technical assignments as required by the business.

Experience

Position requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in generator sales support, application engineering, power generation solutioning, or related roles.
  • Proven track record of supporting technical sales processes from lead stage to order closure.
  • Experience supporting technical proposals and tender documentation will be highly advantageous.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong knowledge of diesel and gas generator technologies, ideally in the 1–3MW range, including awareness of switchgear and electrical systems integration.
  • Strong technical understanding of power generation systems, including system interfaces, interactions, and integration requirements.

Communication & Stakeholder Management

  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical details into customer value and benefits.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, comfortable engaging customers and internal teams across different levels.
  • Strong customer focus and relationship-building capabilities.

Working Style

  • Strong team player with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities and ability to work effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Ability to manage multiple technical proposals and deadlines with strong attention to detail and responsiveness.

Education & Tools

  • Bachelor’s degree in Electrical Engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Power Engineering, or related discipline.
  • Proficient in written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD layouts and Microsoft Office tools.
  • Familiarity with SAP is preferred.

Preferred Background (Highly Relevant Profiles)

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be highly relevant:

  • Generator of OEM environment and/or exposure to major brands such as Cummins, Caterpillar, MTU, Kohler, or similar.
  • Power generation solutioning for industrial plants, mission-critical infrastructure, or complex customer installations.
  • Experience supporting tender documentation and technical proposal development in an EPC, consultant-led, or contractor-led environment.

About Mtu Power Systems

Power Systems is the Rolls-Royce business which provides world-class power solutions and complete life-cycle support under our product and solution brand mtu. Through digitalization and electrification, we strive to develop drive and power generation solutions that provide answers to the challenges posed by the rapidly growing societal demands for energy and mobility.

We deliver and service comprehensive, powerful and reliable systems, based on both gas and diesel engines, as well as electrified hybrid systems. These technologically advanced solutions serve our customers in the marine and infrastructure sectors worldwide.

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.

Rolls-Royce is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristics.

Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

Type of Contract

Permanent

descriptionHtml:
Who We Are

Boston Consulting Group partners with leaders in business and society to tackle their most important challenges and capture their greatest opportunities. BCG was the pioneer in business strategy when it was founded in 1963. Today, we help clients with total transformation-inspiring complex change, enabling organizations to grow, building competitive advantage, and driving bottom-line impact.

To succeed, organizations must blend digital and human capabilities. Our diverse, global teams bring deep industry and functional expertise and a range of perspectives to spark change. BCG delivers solutions through leading-edge management consulting along with technology and design, corporate and digital ventures—and business purpose. We work in a uniquely collaborative model across the firm and throughout all levels of the client organization, generating results that allow our clients to thrive.

What You'll Do

As a member of our consulting team, you’ll work alongside some of the world’s top minds on cases that reshape business, government, and society. You’ll collaborate on challenging projects with team members from many backgrounds and disciplines, increasing your understanding of complex business problems from diverse perspectives and developing new skills and experience to help you at every stage of your career—at BCG and beyond.

Consulting work is varied and rigorous, much of it performed at our client sites. Projects can vary in length, size, and location, depending on the client’s challenge. Because our clients operate all over the world, you may travel internationally.

If you are joining us directly from school or with a few years of experience, expect to spend time working across a wide range of clients and projects from helping to devise the integration strategy for a pharmaceutical merger to developing sustainable farming practices in emerging countries.

For more experienced professionals, or as your career advances, you’ll begin to specialize in one or more practice areas, perhaps as part of our expert consulting track for those with deep knowledge and skills in a particular discipline or industry. Every step of the way you will be guided by BCG mentors and world-class learning programs designed to meet your individual needs.

BCG offers a comprehensive benefits program, including medical, dental and vision coverage, telemedicine services, life, accident and disability insurance, parental leave and family planning benefits, caregiving resources, mental health offerings, a generous retirement program, financial guidance, paid time off, and more.

What You'll Bring

  • Work experience of minimum 6 years in top tier firms or strong academics record from a top tier MBA school
  • Outstanding academic performance and strong record of extracurricular activity
  • Strong research/analysis experience and abilities, including excellent Excel skills
  • Able to work creatively and analytically
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills

descriptionHtml:
About The Position

  • This position is required to support the implementation of the Bank’s Anti-Fraud Strategy and to strengthen fraud risk management in line with the increasing complexity of the Bank’s business and operational activities


Responsibilities

  • Develop the annual Anti-Fraud work plan
  • Conduct fraud prevention and control through Anti-Fraud Awareness socialization for Bank Amar employees
  • Perform fraud detection through monitoring systems for high-risk activities and transactions, as well as through initial assessment of whistleblower reports related to suspected fraud
  • Conduct surprise audits at least once a year, particularly for high-risk business units or units vulnerable to fraud
  • Prepare investigation plans and carry out investigations on suspected fraud cases, collect and secure evidence for further analysis, and conduct interviews and analyze investigation findings
  • Prepare and report investigation results and properly document the investigation outcomes
  • Monitor and evaluate follow-up actions on fraud incidents and control weaknesses that may potentially lead to fraud
  • Report fraud incidents and related findings to the Board of Directors and relevant functions
  • Submitting Anti-Fraud reports to the authority and revising policies related to the Anti-Fraud Strategy in accordance with ongoing developments


Requirements

  • Minimum Bachelor’s Degree (preferably in Economics, Management, Accounting, Law, Information Systems, or other relevant fields)
  • Strong understanding of OJK, Bank Indonesia, and internal Bank regulations related to anti-fraud and risk management
  • Demonstrates integrity, independence, strong analytical ability, and the capability to coordinate across functions
  • Good understanding of Fraud Risk Assessment (FRA), identification and monitoring of fraud indicators, and evaluation of internal control effectiveness
  • Able to prepare systematic analysis, risk assessments, and anti-fraud reports for management and regulatory needs
  • Minimum 2–3 years of experience in anti-fraud, risk management, compliance, internal audit, or control functions within banking/financial services


Bonus Point If

  • Have certifications in Anti-Fraud / Risk Management / Compliance is an advantage (e.g., CFE, CRMP, CAFP, CIA, or equivalent)
  • Experience in drafting policies, guidelines, or Anti-Fraud Strategy frameworks
  • Experience in conducting fraud risk assessments, developing fraud control frameworks, or evaluating fraud control effectiveness
  • Understanding of digital fraud, data analysis, or the use of fraud monitoring dashboards

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

About EY:

EY, a global leader operating in more than 150 countries delivers unparalleled service in Consulting and assists clients to transform and upskill their capabilities.

We serve our clients to build a better working world, helping them to create long-term value for people and society and build trust in the capital markets. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities, and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime. And with a commitment to hiring and developing the most passionate people, we work towards our ambition to be the best employer.

EY advises clients to understand, architect, select and implement bleeding-edge solutions required to efficiently run their businesses, with a focus on Digital and Cloud. These service areas span E-commerce, Solution Architecture, Mobile Applications, Digital Platform Architecture, Digital Technology Strategy, and Digital IT Operations.

The exceptional EY experience. It’s yours to build.

The opportunity:

The Digital & Emerging Technology team works collaboratively with clients to transform their business through disruptive innovation enablement and transformational design solutions. The team supports our clients in modernizing systems, processes and products to enhance business and customer-facing platforms and services to support high performance in a rapidly changing and competitive environment. Our team helps clients sustain competitive advantage and profitability by developing technology strategies, products, and solutions to stay ahead of the rapid pace of change and disruption and supporting the execution of complex transformations.

We're seeking a highly skilled and experienced Backend Engineer to join our dynamic team. In this role, you will play a crucial role in designing, developing, and maintaining scalable and high-performance backend systems. You will collaborate with cross-functional teams, including front-end developers, product managers, and QA engineers, to deliver robust and efficient solutions. While our teams primary focus is within the financial services industries, you will have opportunities to support other sectors including healthcare, automotive, high-tech, and media.

Your key responsibilities:

The goal is to support our clients to transform their business through technology. As a Backend Engineer you will be collaborate with cross-functional teams to define, design, and ship new features, identify and address performance bottlenecks in the backend systems, design and optimize database schemas, develop and maintain RESTful APIs for seamless communication between front-end and back-end systems, write unit tests and participate in code reviews, collaborate with technical writers to create user and developer documentation, and operating your team's software systems in a consistently high quality manner. When working on the systems within your team's domain, you take into account the appropriate architectural patterns, code design, and infrastructure options, ensuring that you deliver a system that is secure, reliable, maintainable, extensible and very well tested. Beyond delivery to the production system, engineers will be responsible for post deployment monitoring as well.

In addition to being trusted to operate independently, you also maintain a good partnership with your technical and non-technical stakeholders for projects that you are involved in. You take an active role in your projects as a team member involved in product design to rollout, taking ownership of your work and constantly focusing on moving these projects forward.

Being an experienced team member, you are also expected to continuously help the team grow and improve either by mentoring new or junior members of your team or by introducing and adopting process improvements.

Requirements:

  • Bachelor's degree (Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Mathematics) or related experience
  • 1-3 years of Development experience
  • Strong knowledge of algorithms and data structures
  • Fluency in developing and understanding sequence diagrams, class models, etc.
  • Strong proficiency in programming languages such as Java, C# .Net, or Golang.
  • Solid understanding of database systems, both relational and NoSQL.
  • Strong in fundamental programming like SOLID Principle, Clean Architecture or related fundamental knowledge and practices
  • Experience in writing maintainable and testable code, including API design, unit testing and UI testing techniques.
  • Experience working in an Agile/Scrum development process.
  • Humble and hungry engineer. Always curious, always looking for a better way
  • Highly accountable and takes ownership of one's own work.

For senior software engineer:

  • 4+ years of professional backend software development experience
  • Experience with Event-Driven Architecture such as Kafka or RabbitMQ
  • Familiarity with cloud services (e.g., AWS, Azure, Google Cloud).
  • Knowledge of containerization and orchestration tools (e.g., Docker, Kubernetes).
  • Possess excellent communication, sharp analytical abilities with proven design skills, able to think critically of the current system in terms of growth and stability
  • Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical requirements
  • Familiarity with modern build pipelines and tools
  • Identify and resolve performance and scalability issues

What we look for

About the Role

We are seeking a detail-oriented and proactive IT Asset Management & Finance Specialist to join our team in Bandung. This is a unique dual-role position that bridges the gap between IT operations and financial governance. You will be responsible for ensuring the accurate lifecycle management of all IT assets while also providing critical financial oversight for IT projects — ensuring cost transparency, budget compliance, and seamless transition of project expenditures into Business-as-Usual (BAU) operations.


If you thrive at the intersection of technology, finance, and operations — and take pride in maintaining precision, accountability, and efficiency — this is your opportunity to make a measurable impact.


Key Responsibilities

IT Asset Management

  • Manage the full lifecycle of IT assets (procurement to disposal), including tracking, tagging, and documentation.
  • Maintain accurate, up-to-date asset records in the ITAM system with 100% compliance to internal policies.
  • Conduct regular physical audits and reconcile discrepancies between system records and physical inventory.
  • Optimize asset utilization and reduce unnecessary expenditures through strategic planning and disposal protocols.
  • Collaborate with procurement, legal, and security teams to ensure compliance with vendor agreements and data protection standards.

IT Finance

  • Review and validate all Memo Budget requests for accuracy and alignment with organizational priorities.
  • Track actual spending vs. allocated budgets for all IT projects; provide weekly/monthly variance reports.
  • Analyze and approve budget transfers or reallocations between projects, ensuring proper documentation and authorization.
  • Monitor project go-live milestones, depreciation schedules, and formal project closure processes.
  • Set, review, and validate direct charge rates for internal cost allocation to business units.
  • Ensure timely and accurate charging of project costs to BAU accounts; monitor charging status and resolve discrepancies.
  • Prepare financial summaries and dashboards for leadership, supporting strategic decision-making.


Required Skills & Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Information Systems, or related field.
  • Proven experience in IT Asset Management and/or IT Finance/Project Cost Control.
  • Strong proficiency in inventory tracking systems (e.g., ServiceNow, Jira, SAP, or similar).
  • Solid understanding of budgeting, cost allocation, depreciation, and financial reporting principles.
  • Excellent data analysis and reporting skills — comfortable working with Excel, Power BI, or similar tools.
  • Experience in project planning, scheduling, and financial monitoring (e.g., MS Project, Jira, or similar).
  • Exceptional attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.
  • Strong problem-solving and decision-making abilities with a proactive, ownership-driven mindset.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills — able to collaborate effectively with IT, finance, and business teams.
  • Willing to work onsite in Bandung


How to Apply

Please send your CV to indra.nugraheni@ocbc.id with the subject line:

“IT Asset & Finance Officer – Name - Linkedin” or apply through this post.


*Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted.

descriptionHtml:
Overview

As a Microsoft Data Center Technician (DCT), you will stage, set up and perform hardware deployments. In addition, you will also perform troubleshooting and diagnostics on equipment, as well as perform hardware decommissions for simple changes and refreshes following Standard Operating Procedures. This opportunity will allow you to deepen your understanding of Data Center standard processes and procedures, develop mentoring skills while providing guidance to peers, familiarizing yourself with security and data management procedures, and accelerate your career growth in the process.

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I DCT, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform. As a group, CO+I is focused on the personal and professional development of all employees and offers training and growth opportunities including Career Rotation Programs, Diversity & Inclusion training and events, and professional certifications. Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 Data Centers in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our data center design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider. Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

  • Perform diagnostics and troubleshooting following standard procedures, quickly identifies the cause(s) of issues, and replaces faulty components with minimal customer and business disruption.
  • Perform post-execution quality checks and verifies that grounding, staging, labeling, and cabling are set up properly according to safety protocols, deployment standards, and planned Network Design Tasks (NDTs).
  • Decommission hardware for simple changes and refreshes (e.g., memory upgrades, rebuilds) following standard procedures with minimal guidance.
  • Follow procedures to communicate, report, and escalate incidents to appropriate Microsoft data center operations management units, Technician Leads, and engineering specialists.
  • Assist and provide guidance to other technicians to complete challenging or complex tasks.
  • Complete required training aligned to the role and workload; observes more experienced technicians to gain hands-on experience and relevant on-the-job training.
  • Contribute to a positive and effective team environment by sharing information with others, contributing to regular team meetings, asking questions, and staying apprised of the status of others' work.
  • Take pride and a sense of accountability for the service quality, completeness, and resulting user experience; displays accountability and ownership of the data center facilities.
  • Embody our culture and values.

Qualifications

Required Qualifications:

  • Bachelors Degree in IT or Telecommunications or equivalent and basic knowledge of computer hardware and components AND 1+ year(s) industry work experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.

Background Check Requirements

Ability to meet Microsoft, customer and/or government security screening requirements are required for this role. These requirements include, but are not limited to the following specialized security screenings:

  • Microsoft Cloud Background Check: This position will be required to pass the Microsoft Cloud background check upon hire/transfer and every two years thereafter.
  • This position requires verification of Indonesian Citizenship due to citizenship-based legal restrictions applicable to the role and as a result, you will need to provide a valid Indonesian passport to verify your Indonesian Citizenship.

Whilst not required, we also look for the following Preferred Qualifications:

  • 2+ years' industry work experience supporting IT equipment or related technology.
  • Applicable certifications: CompTIA (A+, Server+, Network+), Basic Structure Cabling (BSC).

Benefits/perks listed below may vary depending on the nature of your employment with Microsoft and the country where you work.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Microsoft is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, ancestry, citizenship, color, family or medical care leave, gender identity or expression, genetic information, immigration status, marital status, medical condition, national origin, physical or mental disability, political affiliation, protected veteran or military status, race, ethnicity, religion, sex (including pregnancy), sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable local laws, regulations and ordinances. Deskripsi Pekerjaan

  • Data Management: Memastikan pengelolaan data AstraPay yang akurat, aman, dan efisien untuk mendukung pengambilan keputusan yang efektif serta meningkatkan efisiensi operasional.
  • Data Governance: Menetapkan kebijakan, standar, dan proses dalam pengelolaan aset data AstraPay guna menjamin kualitas, keamanan, serta kepatuhan data di seluruh siklus hidup data AstraPay.
  • Data Compliance: Memastikan praktik pengelolaan data AstraPay sesuai dengan peraturan perundang-undangan, regulasi, dan standar industri yang berlaku, serta meminimalkan risiko hukum dan regulasi.
  • Data Analytics & Insight: Menganalisis dan menginterpretasikan kumpulan data AstraPay yang kompleks untuk mengidentifikasi pola, tren, dan insight yang mendukung pengambilan keputusan serta mendorong strategi bisnis.
  • Data Monetization: Mengoptimalkan aset data AstraPay untuk menciptakan peluang pendapatan baru dan nilai bisnis melalui strategi berbasis data, seperti penyediaan layanan data-driven atau peningkatan fitur dan produk.

Persyaratan

  • Pendidikan minimal Sarjana (S1) di bidang Teknologi Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, Data Science, atau bidang terkait. Pengalaman di bidang analitik data akan menjadi nilai tambah.

A pioneer of engineered materials, Michelin is building the world’s leading manufacturer of life-changing composites and experiences.

At Michelin, Supply Chain & Logistics is not just about moving products, it’s about enabling growth, serving customers, and shaping a more sustainable future.

Across APAC and beyond, our teams work at the heart of the business, partnering closely with commercial, industrial, and regional stakeholders to anticipate challenges, make smart trade-offs, and deliver impact where it matters most.

Required

  • Minimum of 3–5 years of experience in Data Analyst
  • Proficiency in in Data Analysis Tools : Microsoft Azure (data factory, databricks, datalake), Excel, Dataiku , Power BI
  • Strong in analytical and problem skills
  • Ability to translate data insights into actionable recommendations
  • Continuous improvement mindset
  • Business Proficiency in English

Requirements

Job description :

  • Perencanaan dan Strategi Produksi

Menyusun Target Tahunan/Bulanan: Merancang rencana kerja produksi (misalnya target Overburden removal dan Coal/Ore getting) berdasarkan target perusahaan.

Optimalisasi Armada: Mengatur alokasi alat berat (excavator, dump truck, dozer) agar bekerja secara maksimal dengan biaya operasional minimal.
