  • Pengawasan Operasional di Lapangan

Monitoring Real-time: Memantau kemajuan tambang setiap hari untuk memastikan operasional sesuai dengan desain tambang (mine plan).

Evaluasi Vendor/Kontraktor: Jika perusahaan menggunakan kontraktor, Manager Operasional bertugas mengawasi kinerja mereka agar sesuai dengan kontrak kerja (SLA).

Penyelesaian Masalah (Troubleshooting): Mengambil keputusan cepat saat terjadi kendala teknis di pit, masalah cuaca, atau kerusakan alat yang bersifat masif.

Technology Managed Services Team assists organizations in leveraging technology across platforms and environments to address specific objectives and help achieve business goals. We are seeking a talented individual, who will be able to work at the highest professional standards, to join our team.


You will work with industry experts and other experienced SAP consultants with expertise across SAP modules (MM / FICO / ABAP / Basis). We are trusted by international clients to provide sophisticated tailored services to keep adopting the latest SAP initiatives and technology.


What you will do:

  • Supports and delivers SAP solution reviews and feasibility studies.
  • Supports pre-sales activities for SAP opportunities in Indonesia including solution design, proposal development, and system demonstration to future clients.
  • Maps client business processes to solution requirements in SAP projects that may includes various client line of business such as Finance, Sourcing and Procurement, Manufacturing, Supply Chain, Asset Management, Sales, R&D/Engineering, Human Resources, and Analytics.
  • Delivers solution design, configuration and required development in any of SAP solutions, by applying KPMG methodologies and standards.
  • Participates in transition planning of client solution landscapes.
  • Drives deployment of KPMG best practice business processes on SAP solutions for specific client line of business or industries.
  • Delivers solution training to client project members.
  • Creates project documentation and document delivered services.
  • Delivers solution testing and issue resolution.
  • Supports client on data migration to the newly deployed SAP solution.
  • Collaborates and cross-functional teams to integration SAP solutions seamlessly.
  • Supports project manager to provide the up-to-date project status and progress report. Report project issue and project risk in a timely manner.
  • Provides SAP application maintenance service in respective SAP line of business for clients.
  • Maintains client relationship.
  • Stays abreast of SAP updates and proactively propose relevant enhancements for client system.
  • Creates and maintain excellent relationship with SAP Indonesia and should be aware of SAP market in Indonesia on continuous basis.
  • Creates and maintains relationship in SAP ecosystem.


Desired skills & experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher degree in Computer Engineering, Computer Science, Information Technology, or any related field.
  • In-depth knowledge of minimum 1 solution in the SAP line of business.
  • Minimum 1 year experience in SAP engagements that include in any of the SAP solution.
  • Proven experience in SAP engagements may include solution implementation, roll-out, migration or application management service.
  • Proven experience in S/4HANA migration project or SuccessFactors implementation are preferable.
  • Possesses valid certifications in any of the SAP solution is highly preferable.
  • In-depth knowledge of an SAP implementation methodology.
  • Excellent leadership, communication both Bahasa Indonesia and English, interpersonal and client-facing skills.
  • Strong problem-solving skills and ability to devise innovative SAP solutions.
  • An innate collaborator capable of initiating, inspiring and managing action.
  • Strong time-management, multi-tasking and sense of ownership.
  • Willingness to challenge new things by leveraging SAP skills and knowledge.
  • Ability to travel for on-site client engagements.


Only shortlisted candidates will be contacted by KPMG Siddharta Advisory Recruitment team. All applicants' information and personal data will be treated as strictly confidential and used for recruitment purposes only.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

  • Mengumpulkan, menganalisis, dan mendokumentasikan kebutuhan bisnis dari stakeholder dengan berkolaborasi bersama Product Specialist dan tim terkait.
  • Menerjemahkan kebutuhan bisnis ke dalam spesifikasi fungsional dan teknis yang jelas untuk pengembangan sistem.
  • Melakukan gap analysis antara sistem yang berjalan, proses bisnis, dan target tujuan bisnis.
  • Merancang solusi sistem termasuk alur sistem, Data Flow Diagram (DFD), Entity Relationship Diagram (ERD), use case, serta dokumentasi pendukung lainnya.
  • Mengusulkan solusi teknis dan desain sistem yang selaras dengan kebutuhan bisnis, standar arsitektur TI, dan best practices.
  • Berkolaborasi dengan tim pengembang untuk memastikan implementasi kebutuhan berjalan akurat serta solusi sistem diselesaikan tepat waktu.
  • Berkoordinasi dengan tim QA dalam menyiapkan skenario pengujian, mendukung aktivitas testing, serta memvalidasi fungsi sistem sebelum implementasi.
  • Mengidentifikasi ketidakefisienan sistem, mengusulkan perbaikan, serta mendukung inisiatif optimasi, enhancement, dan integrasi sistem.

Persyaratan

  • Pendidikan minimal S1 di bidang Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait.
  • Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 1 tahun sebagai System Analyst, Business Analyst, atau posisi terkait.
  • Mahir menggunakan tools desain perangkat lunak dan pemodelan sistem (misalnya UML, DFD, ERD, dan flowchart).
  • Memahami arsitektur perangkat lunak, arsitektur database, serta konsep integrasi sistem.
  • Memiliki pemahaman yang kuat terhadap proses bisnis dan mampu menerjemahkan kebutuhan bisnis ke dalam solusi sistem.
  • Berpengalaman dalam proses penggalian kebutuhan, dokumentasi, dan metodologi analisis sistem.
  • Memiliki kemampuan berpikir analitis, problem solving, dan perhatian terhadap detail yang baik.
  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan kerja sama tim yang baik untuk berkolaborasi dengan stakeholder teknis maupun non-teknis.

Leads national strategy, governance, and coordination for handling, preventing, and mitigating theft incidents involving network infrastructure and assets (e.g., BTS, transmission, power systems, cables, and ancillary equipment). Ensures service continuity and asset protection by standardizing processes, managing escalations, ensuring compliance with established SLA/KPI for incident response and recovery.

Investigation

descriptionHtml:
Blibli is on a journey to become Indonesia’s #1 e-commerce platform — built on trust, innovation, and care. We’re creating better experiences for customers, merchants, brands, and sellers through technology, collaboration, and a deep commitment to quality. Here, every idea matters, and every action helps us grow stronger together.

In Commercial, you’ll help connect customers with the products and partners they love. Your work supports category growth, strengthens seller relationships, and delivers seamless, memorable experiences that keep customers coming back to Blibli.

As a Merchandising Junior Officer for the Sport Category, you’ll bring this mission to life by hunting new merchants and brands within the category, ensuring a diverse and competitive product assortment for our customers.

  • Identify and onboard new merchants and brands in the sport category.

  • Excellent negotiation and communication skills.
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, target-driven environment.

For thousands of years, maps have provided humans with the knowledge they need to make decisions. As a Maps Evaluator, you will have the opportunity to provide ground truth for your town, city or country.


At Peroptyx, we are looking for Data Analysts who will review mapping data for digital mapping applications. Your research capabilities will validate and ensure that the navigation of certain routes are accurate and safe.


As part of this role you will verify that business names and opening hours are correct. You will check that the distance from a starting point to an end destination is listed accurately, resulting in better user experiences.


With this job you can plan your days around this highly flexible working schedule, work weekends or late evenings, all from the comfort of your own office. The flexibility of our roles minimizes the impact on your daily routine.


So, whether you are a student looking to earn as you learn, a retiree looking for a new challenge, a part-time/full time professional or a work from home parent, Peroptyx has the right role for you!


Benefits

  • Work up to 20 hours per week.
  • Earn a competitive rate of pay.
  • Develop your research skills.
  • Avoid the long commute.
  • Work from the comfort of your home office.
  • Enjoy the flexibility of setting your own working hours!


Ideal Candidate

  • Fluent in English and Indonesian.
  • Excellent research skills.
  • Excellent local knowledge of your home country.
  • Good understanding and general knowledge of the geography and culture of Indonesian.
  • Analytical mindset.


Job Requirements

  • Must be living in Indonesia for a minimum of 5 consecutive years.
  • Must pass an online open-book exam that can verify your full understanding of the material and concepts.
  • Must be willing to work a minimum of 10 hours and up to 20 hours per week depending on task availability.
  • Good working knowledge of search engines, map applications and familiarity with social media platforms.
  • Strong ability to learn, understand and apply multiple sets of different instructions.
  • All work must be of an independent nature.

Erdigma Group, yang dikenal dengan inovasi dan pendekatan kreatifnya, saat ini sedang membuka ruang desain kreatif yang bertujuan untuk memberikan dampak signifikan di bidang desain dan arsitektur.   • Pengalaman minimal 3 tahun di bidang arsitektur dengan portofolio desain ruang kreatif yang kuat.

Responsibilities

About The Role:

At Tentang Anak, we move super fast because we work for the needs of 80 million Indonesian children & families that can’t wait. We seek people who are hungry to solve the problem, accountable & bring speed in everything they do.

This role owns end-to-end packaging development at Tentang Anak, from concept and design through supplier readiness and mass production, ensuring packaging is functional, compliant, cost-effective, and aligned with brand direction. Working cross-functionally, you will drive packaging innovation, manage artwork and regulatory compliance, optimize costs, and ensure production readiness in a fast-paced environment supporting our mission to serve Indonesian children and families.

Job Responsibility

End-to-End Packaging Development

  • Lead end-to-end packaging development from concept → prototype → supplier development → mass production readiness.
  • Translate product concept and brand direction into feasible packaging solutions (primary + secondary).
  • Manage packaging specification development including material, dimensions, artwork guidelines, and print specs.

Packaging Innovation & Improvement

  • Explore new packaging formats/materials to improve user experience, product safety, and differentiation in market.
  • Conduct packaging benchmarking and continuously propose improvements in aesthetics, function, and sustainability.
  • Support brand innovation by proposing cost-effective and manufacturable packaging designs aligned with brand identity.

Artwork Development & Compliance

  • Coordinate and manage packaging artwork development with internal creative team and external agencies.
  • Ensure artwork and packaging comply with regulatory requirements (BPOM labeling, barcode readiness, mandatory claims, ingredient list, caution statements).
  • Handle packaging approval process and ensure final output is aligned with timeline and quality standards.

Supplier & Cost Management

  • Source, evaluate, and recommend packaging suppliers based on quality, cost competitiveness, lead time, and reliability.
  • Drive packaging cost optimization initiatives (value engineering, material/spec adjustment, MOQ efficiency, supplier comparison).
  • Support procurement negotiation with data (cost breakdown, spec benchmarking, alternative materials).

Testing, Quality & Production Support

  • Coordinate packaging testing including compatibility, leakage, stability, drop test, sealing performance, usability, and transportation stress.
  • Ensure production readiness by coordinating with manufacturer, supply chain, and QA on packaging SOP & QC standards.
  • Troubleshoot packaging-related issues in pilot and mass production; lead root cause analysis and corrective actions.

Project Management & Cross Functional Collaboration

  • Own packaging development timeline, deliverables, and risk mitigation plans as part of NPD project execution.
  • Work closely with PD, QC and QA, Procurement, Supply Chain, OEM, and Commercial team to ensure packaging success.
  • Maintain packaging development documentation for all SKUs (spec sheet, supplier info, final artwork, change log).

Requirements

Experience & Background

  • Minimum 5 years experience in Packaging Development / Packaging Engineering / Product Development, preferably in FMCG, personal care, baby/kids care, cosmetics, or pharma.
  • Proven experience managing end-to-end packaging development projects (primary + secondary packaging).
  • Experience in handling supplier development, cost optimization, and packaging troubleshooting during production.

Technical Knowledge

  • Strong understanding of packaging materials (plastic, paper, glass, aluminum), printing methods, and packaging structures.
  • Familiar with packaging testing and validation (compatibility, leakage, drop test, shipping test, stability packaging).
  • Knowledge of regulatory packaging requirements (BPOM labeling, barcode readiness, claim limitation, safety statement).

Core Skills

  • Strong project management & stakeholder management skills (able to coordinate cross function).
  • Excellent attention to detail (spec accuracy, artwork review, compliance).
  • Strong negotiation mindset and analytical thinking for cost saving and supplier evaluation.
  • High ownership, ability to work in fast-paced environment with tight launch timelines.

Preferred

  • Experience with packaging for personal care products (shampoo/body wash/cleanser) and/or Pharma.
  • Experience working with OEM/CM and internal brand team.
  • Familiarity with sustainability packaging initiatives is a plus.

Primary Job Role :

The IT Data Analyst and Protection is responsible for conducting in-depth data analysis to assess and mitigate risks within the organization. This role involves collecting, organizing, and interpreting large datasets to identify trends, patterns, and potential risks that could impact the company's operations.


The Data Analyst and Protection Officer will collaborate with cross-functional teams to provide actionable insights and recommendations to enhance risk management strategies and ensure the company's overall stability. Also ensuring the data security and recommending improvements for the data privacy and protection process, and data breach incident response plan.


Job Description :

  1. Collect, clean, and preprocess data from various sources to ensure accuracy and completeness.
  2. Analyze and interpret complex datasets using statistical and data visualization techniques to identify potential risks and trends.
  3. Collaborate with risk management teams to define risk metrics and develop models for assessing and quantifying risks.
  4. Monitor and track key risk indicators (KRIs) and key performance indicators (KPIs) to identify emerging risks and trends.
  5. Produce comprehensive reports and presentations summarizing risk analysis findings for stakeholders and senior management.
  6. Collaborate with IT teams to ensure data integrity, security, and compliance with data protection regulations.
  7. Participate in the development and improvement of risk management strategies, policies, and procedures.
  8. Stay updated on industry trends and best practices in risk management and data analysis.


Job Qualifications :

  1. Willing to Work From Office (Kemang & Mayapada) Monday - Frinday (09.00 - 18.00).
  2. Bachelor's degree in a relevant field such as Finance, Economics, Statistics, Mathematics, or Computer Science.
  3. Proven experience (3+ years) in data analysis, risk management, or a related field (Financial Technology is a plus).
  4. Strong knowledge in iso 27001 about data protection is a plus.
  5. Proficiency in data analysis tools such as Python, or SQL, and experience with data visualization tools (e.g., Tableau, Power BI).
  6. Strong proficiency in Ms. Excel
  7. Familiarity with financial products, markets, and regulatory requirements is a plus.
  8. Excellent analytical skills with the ability to work with complex, large datasets and draw actionable insights.

Logistics Officer (Wine Distribution)

| Ungasan, Badung, Bali | On-site | Wine Adore Indonesia |

Wine Adore Indonesia is looking for a Logistics Officer to manage shipment, delivery, and inventory operations for our wine distribution business. This role sits within the Logistics Team and plays a key role in ensuring smooth movement of goods, accurate stock control, and compliance with regulations related to alcoholic beverages.

You will work closely with warehouses, freight partners, and internal stakeholders to support both import-related coordination and domestic distribution, while maintaining product quality and operational efficiency.

Key Responsibilities

  • Coordinate domestic deliveries and support import shipments for wine products
  • Liaise with freight forwarders, couriers, warehouses, and customs-related partner
  • Prepare, review, and track logistics documentation, including shipping documents, delivery records, and excise-related paperwork
  • Monitor shipment and delivery timelines to ensure timely and compliant distribution
  • Ensure proper handling, storage, and transportation of wine products, including temperature control, packaging standards, and breakage prevention
  • Maintain accurate inventory movement records and support stock reconciliation with warehouses
  • Track logistics costs and support internal logistics reporting
  • Identify and resolve shipment, delivery, or stock discrepancies
  • Ensure logistics activities comply with applicable regulations for alcoholic beverages


Requirements

  • Indonesian citizen or permanent resident
  • Fluent in English (spoken and written)
  • 3–5 years of experience in logistics, supply chain, or warehouse operations
  • Strong understanding of shipment processes, logistics documentation, and inventory flow
  • Experience coordinating with freight forwarders, warehouses, and delivery partners
  • Detail-oriented, well-organized, and able to manage multiple shipments and priorities
  • Good communication skills and ability to work with internal and external stakeholder
  • Proficient in Microsoft Excel or logistics-related systems
  • Willing to work on-site in Bali


Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience handling wine or alcoholic beverages
  • Exposure to import or export coordination and excise-related documentation
  • Understanding of wine handling standards, including temperature sensitivity and fragile goods
  • Background in FMCG, beverage, hospitality, or retail industries

  • Strong skills in Excel / Google Sheets (pivot tables, formulas, basic analysis).
  • Good understanding of key business metrics (active users, GMV, conversion rate, retention).
  • Able to communicate insights clearly and confidently to non-technical stakeholders.

descriptionHtml:
Who are we?

Amar Bank is one of the most technologically advanced digital banks in Indonesia. Our leading digital lending product, Tunaiku has the distinction of being the first FinTech product in Indonesia. We are also the first digital bank on the cloud. As the first profitable digital bank, we managed to get listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange.

How did we manage to do that?

We are changing people’s perception of a bank. We believe we are the innovators who combine customer focus principles with creating technology-based impact. We incorporate freedom and flexibility as part of our startup working culture DNA to encourage innovation in creating better financial solutions for the banking industry. We think of ourselves as, ‘A technology company with a banking license’. For this reason, we ‘Act like a FinTech, and think like a Bank.’

How did it all start?

Founded on March 15, 1991, in Surabaya as PT Anglomas International Bank (Amin Bank), the bank was acquired by Tolaram Group and transformed to PT Bank Amar Indonesia (Amar Bank) in 2014. It has then undergone a significant digital transformation to become one of the country's forerunning fintech institutions through its award-winning digital lending platform, Tunaiku.

Our philosophy, mission, and vision

Technology must impact lives, must improve lives. We exist to provide banking to those who ‘need’ and not only to those who ‘want’. Services when provided to those who need at the time of their need brings smiles. Our vision is to bring 200 million smiles.

More about the bank with startup culture environment

Consist of 1000+ people, you will meet people who love to grow, dream big, and actually have fun at the workplace! We provide a great working environment that pushes people to grow outside their comfort zone. People with high drive and ambition find us a very attractive place to work as their career growth matches their own drive and not any staid policies. Thus we hold the honor of being awarded “Best Place to Work in Indonesia”.Recently Amar Bank was awarded as Inspirational Brand from APEA (Asia Pacific Enterprise Awards) 2022. Of course, our innovation won't stop here. So if you would love to be a part of it, have a growth mindset, and are constantly hungry for challenges, we invite you to join us in our journey to ‘Impact Lives’.

Join us today and create #unlimitedinnovations!

About the position:

Leading the Product Partnership team enabling EBF's product vision and applying growth strategies to all EBF partners to optimize users conversion and active transaction rates.

Responsibilites:

  • Pre-Sales - Solutioning
  • Work with Sales to conduct in-depth (discovery) interviews, understand partners business objectives, needs in technical requirements.
  • Crafting a product solution proposal to assist Strategic Partnership team for acquiring new business Partners based profile to meet within the use cases and Amar Bank’s products;
  • Design optimal solutions based on partners needs including B2B end to end technical proposal and end to end customer journey in partner’s digital platform
  • Aligned with Business units regarding a product solution proposal for Partners use cases are met within their SOPs, Risk Criteria, Underwriting Process, and Commercial, alongside for the operational flow process;
  • Provides EBF product presentations and demonstrates EBF use case scenarios tailored with partner needs
  • Collaborate with Product Owner and Integration Manager to develop and integrate Partners use cases based on product solution proposal that already agreed upon, also provide technical guidance and support through the integration process;
  • Creating and collecting operational docs that needed for Partners and Business units documentation for Compliance requirement;
  • Ensure the EBF service goes live successfully with the partner in accordance with the agreed technical solution and is fully integrated into Amar’s operational processes
  • Post Sales - Relationship & Growth
  • Managing and build strong relationship with key person at Partners organization as the primary person in charge;
  • Create report monitoring on Partnership performance and analyze the impact results as the key indicators and regular reporting
  • Provides 1st level of support and immediate troubleshooting when partners encounter technical issues after partner integrated EBF service
  • Obtain partner feedback such as, new feature needs, or areas for service improvement and request to the product team for further product development plan
  • Develop Partnership Strategy with Partners (e.g. joint go-to-market, co-marketing, cross sell/upsell program) to maximize revenue generation, increase product adoption and generate leads based on use cases that are already implemented;
  • Implement Growth strategy with ongoing partner to scale-up users conversion and boost users transaction through programs or promotion
  • Regularly conduct AB testing to identify customers behavior, preferences and make necessary improvements in collaboration with the Marketing team to increase conversion rates
  • All reconciliation related with partner incentive/revenue sharing completed within schedule without dispute and paid as agreed timeline


Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Economics, Computer Science, Business Administration, Communications, Industrial Engineering or any related field;
  • Have 3 - 5 years of experience in Account Manager, Solution Consultant, Customer Success (is a plus) or Business Development, Sales Partnership, Project Management, Business in digital banking, fintech B2B digital product, SaaS technology is a plus;
  • Having business sense and strong analytical skills to create and analyze data and turn it into strategic partnership actions
  • Have strong negotiation, communication, and interpersonal skills to manage cross-functional teams, both internal and external parties to handle end-to-end projects;
  • Improvement, Performance Marketing or any related roles;


Bonus point if:

  • Having experienced in Banking Digital Marketing and Expert in payment system
  • Familiar with digital banking B2B partnership with other industries workflow;
  • Have a knowledge of SaaS/APIs/SDKs tech products integrate with other tech platforms workflow

descriptionHtml:
MAKE HISTORY WITH US!

At PMI, we’ve chosen to do something incredible. We’re totally transforming our business, and building our future on smoke-free products with the power to improve the lives of a billion smokers worldwide.

With huge change, comes huge opportunity. So, wherever you join us, you’ll enjoy the freedom to dream up and deliver better, brighter solutions and the space to move your career forward in endlessly different directions.

Role Overview

Working within the Enterprise Data and Analytics organization as a data analyst, joining with a high-level perspective and customer insight to deliver on the goals, vision, and roadmap for metadata and catalog product development, quality, master and reference data including technical and business metadata, tagging, lineage, quality, reporting, master data, and issue resolution.

Taking responsibility for communicating with stakeholders across the board, including customers, business managers, delivery teams and external partners; ensuring goals are clear, and the vision is aligned with business objectives.

Delivering on data services within the data management lifecycle; measuring its impact and outcomes on business objectives.

JOIN US!

Your ‘day to day’

  • Responsible for backlog delivery in the context of project, capability, and business as usually focused work. Collaborating with stakeholders to right size the backlog and roadmap.
  • Responsible for working with the product owner and stakeholders to define and implement standardized metadata framework attributes in the catalog (business, technical, tagging, ownership, etc.).
  • Responsible for data quality dashboarding, ensuring stakeholder expectations are accounted for and met in support of error detection and issue resolution.
  • Responsible for ensuring that deployed data quality rule results are deployed timely, accurately, and consistently and in a manner that meets governance needs for issue resolution processes.
  • Monitor outcomes, taking appropriate remedial action where necessary.
  • Responsible for partnering with stakeholder organizations to solicit requirements and action them within the catalog.
  • Responsible for training stakeholders on the enterprise catalog and data quality as it relates to use and value proposition to their given persona context.
  • Adhere to principles, policies and standards to achieve quality and compliance of solution and services; providing advice on policy when necessary
  • Analyze, collect requirements, guide, and build within in our master and reference data platform
  • Drive collaboration and knowledge sharing with colleagues in IT and other functions on matters such as applicable principles, practices, standards, procedures and guidelines, efficient use of tools and technologies.
  • Ensure that business objectives and requirements are clearly understood.
  • Provide information and business advice to resolve complex or contentious queries and issues; enabling others to take appropriate actions.
  • Create and maintain system/services documentation, training programs/materials, operating manuals with assigned scope

Who We’re Looking Fo

  • University degree in Computer Sciences / Information Technology / Engineering / Business Administration with additional certificates
  • 2+ years of experience in Information Technology or Business Function in multinational company.
  • Customer Experiences Implementation, Consumer Centricity Expert, and Stakeholder Relationship Management
  • Data Cataloging, Data Quality, Master Data, and Reference Data
  • Data and Analytics Literacy
  • DAMA CDMP Fundamentals certification would be an additional benefit
  • AWS - Cloud Practitioner certification would be an additional benefit

Please note that only online applications will be taken into consideration. Only selected candidates will be contacted.

descriptionHtml:
What you will do:

As the host/cashier serves as the welcoming face and final point of contact for guests, ensuring a seamless and memorable dining experience from arrival to departure. This role is responsible for greeting and seating guests with warmth and professionalism, managing reservations efficiently, and coordinating with the service team to optimize table flow.

Host/Hostess

  • Greet guests promptly with a genuine smile, making them feel welcomed and valued from the moment they enter.
  • Handle phone, online, and walk-in reservations; update booking systems accurately to ensure efficient table allocation.
  • Escort guests to their tables in a timely manner, ensuring a smooth seating flow that balances guest comfort with operational capacity.
  • Monitor table turnover and collaborate with the service team to optimize seating arrangements during peak hours.
  • Coordinate between the service and kitchen teams to keep guest waiting times reasonable and manage special seating requests.
  • Represent the Bobobox FnB business's refined hospitality standards through polished appearance, professional language, and attentive service.

Cashier

  • Handle all digital payment transactions with speed, precision, and transparency.
  • Ensure all bills are correct, itemized, and presented to guests clearly and courteously.
  • Count and reconcile cash drawers accurately at the end of shifts, following company procedures.
  • Thank guests warmly, ensuring their final impression is as memorable and positive as their welcome.
  • Address any billing concerns or discrepancies promptly and politely to maintain guest trust.
  • Maintain accurate payment records and follow all financial control policies.

You will fit in this job if you:

  • Minimum high school or a diploma in hospitality/tourism management is preferred
  • At least 1–2 years of experience in a guest-facing role within a restaurant, hotel, or similar hospitality environment; luxury or fine-dining experience preferred.
  • Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills, with the ability to engage guests warmly and professionally.
  • Strong organizational skills to manage reservations, seating flow, and payment processes efficiently.
  • Accuracy and attention to detail in handling transactions and billing.
  • Well-groomed, professional appearance in line with the Bobobox FnB business's luxury brand standards.
  • Naturally hospitable, courteous, and attentive to guest needs.
  • Proactive problem solver with a positive attitude.
  • High level of integrity and trustworthiness in handling financial transactions.
  • Flexibility to work varying shifts, including evenings, weekens, and public holidays.
  • Willing to work on-site at Puncak, Bogor

descriptionHtml:
Requirements

Key Skills

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills.
  • Ability to translate complex technical information for non-technical users.
  • Expertise in specific HIS/EMR and ERP software.
  • Project management and change management skills to support user adoption.

Responsibilities

A Business Analyst specializing in HIS (Health Information Systems), EMR (Electronic Medical Records), and ERP (Enterprise Resource Planning) analyzes, documents, and translates business needs into technical solutions for healthcare and enterprise systems. Key responsibilities include gathering and documenting user and system requirements, analyzing and optimizing workflows, translating these needs into technical specifications for IT implementation, and providing training and support to end-users.

Core Responsibilities

  • Requirement Gathering:

Work with stakeholders to gather and document detailed business needs for HIS, EMR, and ERP systems.

  • Process Analysis:

Analyze existing business processes to identify inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement and optimization.

  • Technical Specification:

Translate business requirements into clear functional and technical specifications for the IT department to implement in the systems.

  • System Implementation & Testing:

Collaborate with IT teams on the implementation and customization of HIS, EMR, and ERP systems and conduct thorough system testing.

  • User Support & Training:

Provide training, support, and documentation to end-users to ensure successful adoption and utilization of the systems.

  • Data Analysis & Reporting:

Analyze system data, create visualizations, and provide insights to support strategic decision-making.

Specific Focus Areas

  • HIS/EMR Focus:

Understand and document requirements for health information systems, focusing on clinical workflows, patient data management, regulatory compliance (like HIPAA), and user experience for healthcare providers.

  • ERP Focus:

Analyze and optimize core business processes (like finance, HR, supply chain) and align them with ERP system capabilities to improve efficiency and data integration across departments.

EY, a global leader operating in more than 150 countries delivers unparalleled service in Consulting and assists clients to transform and upskill their capabilities.

We serve our clients to build a better working world, helping them to create long-term value for people and society and build trust in the capital markets. That starts with a culture that believes in giving you the training, opportunities, and creative freedom to make things better. Whenever you join, however long you stay, the exceptional EY experience lasts a lifetime.

At EY, you’ll have the chance to build a career as unique as you are, with the global scale, support, inclusive culture, and technology to become the best version of you. And we’re counting on your unique voice and perspective to help EY become even better, too. Join us and build an exceptional experience for yourself, and a better working world for all.

We look forward you to joining us in the Cybersecurity Junior Consultant team with below roles:

  • Cyber Engineer – Red Team and Blue Team
  • Cyber Engineer – Managed Services
  • Cyber Threat Modelling
  • Managed Services
  • Identity Management

Requirements:

  • Bachelor’s Degree or above in Information Systems, Computer Science, Electronics and Communications, or related disciplines.
  • Fresh graduates or min. 1-2 years experienced in Cybersecurity roles.

The opportunity:

You will help our clients navigate the business and technology transformation vision. We’ll look to you to provide our clients with a unique business and technology perspective on how technology can transform and improve their entire organization – starting with key business issues they face. This is a high-growth, high-visibility area with plenty of opportunities to enhance your skill set and build your career. 

Your key responsibilities:  

You’ll spend most of your time working with a wide variety of clients and your colleagues to deliver the latest trends, practices, technologies, and architecture to design, build and maintain scalable and robust solutions that unify, enrich, collaborate and deliver value.    

Skills and attributes for success:

  • Outstanding team player
  • High level of motivation
  • Strong work ethic
  • Self-starting attitude
  • Independent and able to manage and prioritize workload
  • Ability to quickly and positively adapt to change
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, presentation, client service, and technical writing skills, coupled with excellent executive presence.
  • Significant experience in managing and delivering medium to large teams on complex programs and projects.
  • Assessing, designing, architecting, and developing solutions leveraging the latest technologies and trends to exceed the business requirements
  • Unifying, enriching, and delivering value to derive insights and opportunities
  • Leveraging in-house and partners - platforms and solutions as needed and recommending and building new platforms/solutions as required to exceed business requirements
  • Communicating findings, recommendations, and opportunities to improve platforms and solutions
  • Demonstrating a deep understanding of technology, concepts, tools, features, functions, and benefits of different approaches
  • Seeking out information to learn about emerging methodologies and technologies
  • Clarifying problems by driving to understand the true issue
  • Looking for opportunities for improving methods and outcomes
  • Collaborating, influencing, and building consensus through constructive relationships and effective listening
  • Solving problems by incorporating data into decision making 
  • Proven track record of sales and delivery in a consulting context with established client relationships and experience

Job Description

Location: Jakarta, Indonesia

Only candidates with the legal right to work in Indonesia will be considered. Please note that applicants without this eligibility will not be considered.

Why join Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.

Position Summary

We are seeking a highly experienced Project Manager with deep expertise in mission-critical infrastructure, specifically data centers, power systems, or industrial plants.

You will lead high-value, technically complex projects involving electrical power supply, mechanical systems, backup power, and commissioning, ensuring safe, reliable, and on-time delivery.

This role is ideal for candidates with proven experience managing large-scale EPC/design-build projects and coordinating multi-disciplinary engineering and vendor teams.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Lead full lifecycle execution of mission-critical/data center projects ranging from multi-million USD values, managing scope, schedule, budget, and risk with precision.
  • Oversee engineering design reviews and ensure compliance with technical standards, local regulatory requirements, and customer specifications.
  • Manage complex procurement cycles including RFP generation, bid evaluation, commercial negotiation, and supplier delivery performance.
  • Direct and coordinate internal engineering teams (electrical, mechanical, controls), external EPC partners, subcontractors, and specialist vendors.
  • Provide hands-on oversight during installation, system integration, testing, FAT/SAT, and commissioning of power systems and associated infrastructure.
  • Maintain a high level of customer engagement, providing progress reporting, escalation management, and ensuring exceptional service throughout the project.
  • Drive stringent HSE performance, enforcing Zero Harm standards and monitoring safe practices at all project sites.
  • Identify risks, develop mitigation and recovery plans, and ensure project governance through structured reporting to senior leadership.

Position Requirements

  • Minimum 7–10 years of proven project management experience in data centers, mission-critical facilities, EPC power systems, or industrial infrastructure. General construction-only profiles will not be considered.
  • Demonstrated success delivering large-scale projects (>USD [insert value] million) involving complex electrical/mechanical systems and commissioning activities.
  • Strong technical understanding of HV/LV electrical systems, power generation, UPS/gensets, cooling systems, mechanical services, or controls/automation.
  • Expertise in detailed project planning, scheduling, budgeting, risk control, and contract management.
  • Hands-on experience supervising site activities, including installation, testing, pre-commissioning, and commissioning.
  • Ability to read and interpret engineering drawings, schematics, and technical specifications.
  • Strong stakeholder management capability, with experience leading cross-functional teams and managing customers at senior levels.
  • Degree in Electrical, Mechanical, Power Engineering, or a related engineering discipline.
  • Proficient in English; skilled with MS Office, AutoCAD, SAP, and project scheduling tools (MS Project/Primavera).

Preferred Requirements

  • PMP, PRINCE2, or equivalent project management certification.
  • Experience with EPC or design-build delivery models.
  • Experience with mission-critical sectors such as:
    • Data centers
    • Power generation plants
    • Industrial automation facilities
    • Backup of power or energy systems
    • Marine or infrastructure projects
  • Strong negotiation and vendor management skills.
  • Proven leadership in high-pressure, deadline-critical environments.
About Mtu Power Systems

Power Systems is the Rolls-Royce business which provides world-class power solutions and complete life-cycle support under our product and solution brand mtu. Through digitalization and electrification, we strive to develop drive and power generation solutions that provide answers to the challenges posed by the rapidly growing societal demands for energy and mobility.

We deliver and service comprehensive, powerful and reliable systems, based on both gas and diesel engines, as well as electrified hybrid systems. These technologically advanced solutions serve our customers in the marine and infrastructure sectors worldwide.

Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.

Rolls-Royce is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristics.

Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

Type of Contract

Permanent

descriptionHtml:
About the Role

At Electrum, quality and reliability are critical to delivering a seamless electric mobility experience across Indonesia. We are looking for a Quality Improvement Manager to strengthen service quality, preventive maintenance, and operational consistency across our EV and battery-swapping ecosystem.

This role will focus on preventive maintenance programs, service advisor excellence, and quality assurance & training, ensuring our vehicles, battery swap stations, and service operations meet high reliability and customer satisfaction standards as we scale.

You will work closely with Operations, Service, CX, Engineering, and Training teams to embed a strong quality culture and continuously improve how we serve our customers and partners.

What You Will DoPreventive Maintenance & Reliability

  • Design and continuously improve preventive maintenance programs for Electrum’s EVs, battery systems, and supporting infrastructure.

  • Define maintenance standards, inspection routines, and checklists to reduce downtime, breakdowns, and repeat issues.

  • Analyze maintenance and failure data to identify root causes and implement preventive actions.

  • Monitor preventive maintenance compliance and effectiveness across service locations and partners.

  • Partner with Operations and Engineering teams to improve asset uptime, safety, and operational readiness.

Service Advisor Quality & Customer Experience

  • Establish service advisory standards covering diagnosis quality, communication accuracy, job documentation, and follow-up.

  • Audit service advisor practices to ensure clear explanations, accurate recommendations, and proper handover to technicians.

  • Improve service intake, estimation accuracy, and service completion quality.

  • Work with CX teams to analyze complaints, NPS feedback, and service pain points.

  • Coach and support service advisors to consistently deliver Electrum’s service standards.

Quality Assurance & Training

  • Develop and maintain quality assurance frameworks, SOPs, and service guidelines aligned with Electrum’s operational model.

  • Design and deliver training programs for service advisors, technicians, and operational teams.

  • Lead onboarding, refresher training, and capability-building initiatives to support scale and consistency.

  • Conduct regular audits, field inspections, and compliance checks across service operations.

  • Identify skill gaps and work with HR and Training teams to build structured learning paths.

Continuous Improvement & Reporting

  • Lead root cause analysis (RCA) and corrective/preventive action (CAPA) initiatives for recurring issues.

  • Track and report quality KPIs such as preventive maintenance compliance, repeat repair rate, first-time fix rate, service SLA, and customer feedback trends.

  • Drive continuous improvement initiatives that improve reliability, reduce cost, and enhance customer trust.

  • Provide regular insights and recommendations to leadership on quality performance and risk areas.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Automotive, Mechanical, Electrical, Industrial) or related field.

  • 5–8 years of experience in service operations, maintenance, quality management, or technical training roles.

  • Strong understanding of preventive maintenance systems and service workflows.

  • Experience working closely with service advisors, technicians, and field operations teams.

  • Proven experience in quality assurance, audits, and process improvement.

  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and root cause analysis skills.

  • Ability to design and deliver effective technical and service training programs.

  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in EV, automotive, fleet, or heavy equipment environments.

  • Familiarity with battery systems, charging or battery-swapping operations.

  • Knowledge of Lean, Six Sigma, or continuous improvement methodologies.

  • Experience managing quality across multi-site operations.

Meratus Group is a leading integrated maritime and logistics operator in Indonesia, pioneering innovative solutions that drive efficiency and sustainability in the industry. With a rich history dating back to 1957, Meratus has evolved into a powerhouse, operating over 45 shipping routes, a fleet of 100 vessels, and a network of container terminals and logistics centers.

At Meratus, we are committed to digitalization, innovation, and transformation, ensuring seamless logistics and maritime services across Indonesia and Southeast Asia. Our customer-centric approach and agile operations empower businesses to navigate complex supply chain challenges with confidence.

We take pride in fostering a dynamic and inclusive workplace, where talented professionals can thrive and contribute to shaping the future of maritime logistics. Join us and be part of a team that is redefining industry standards while making a meaningful impact on global trade and sustainability.

﻿Position Overview:﻿

﻿This position will be responsible for supporting the ship operational area and will report directly to Ship Manager.

Responsibilities

  • Supporting Ship Manager in purchasing spare parts, services, and consumables for ships.
  • Assist Ship Manager liaise with Workshop to ensure all ship general maintenance, engine repair / overhaul is carry out timely.
  • Responsible for the validity of ship documents as well as controlling the documents, including ship certificates.
  • Monitors all the Monthly Reports from the ship.
  • Administration & correspondence to and from vessels.

Requirements

  • Minimum Bachelor Degree in Marine Engineering or related major.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in related field.
  • Posses solid experience in the container shipping company (especially for the technical/engineering field).
  • Willing to carry out not only operational tasks but also administrative tasks.
  • Proficient in English.
  • Willing to be placed at Jakarta office (Priok, Jakarta Utara).

The Business Automation Associate supports the design, implementation, and maintenance of automated solutions that streamline business processes, improve efficiency, reduce manual work, and enhance data accuracy across departments.


Key Responsibilities:

  1. Analyze existing business processes to identify automation opportunities.
  2. Assist in designing and implementing workflow automation using tools such as RPA, low-code/no-code platforms, or scripting solutions.
  3. Support integration between business systems (ERP, CRM, HRIS, finance tools, etc.).
  4. Develop, test, and maintain automated workflows, bots, and dashboards.
  5. Monitor automation performance and troubleshoot issues to ensure system stability.
  6. Document automation processes, system configurations, and user guidelines.
  7. Collaborate with business stakeholders to gather requirements and optimize solutions.
  8. Assist in data extraction, transformation, and reporting automation.
  9. Ensure automation solutions follow security, compliance, and data governance standards.
  10. Support continuous improvement initiatives and automation best practices.


Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Business Analytics, Engineering, or related fields
  • 1-2 years of experience in business automation, process improvement, or IT support (fresh graduates are welcome)
  • Basic understanding of business processes (finance, operations, HR, or sales)
  • Familiarity with automation tools (e.g., Power Automate, UiPath, Zapier, Make, Automation Anywhere)
  • Basic knowledge of databases, APIs, or scripting (Python, SQL, JavaScript is a plus)


About Kawan Lama Group

Established in 1955, Kawan Lama Group is a multi-sector group of companies who are constantly innovating for improving the quality of lives. Manages 28 brand portfolios operating in six different sectors: Commercial & Industrial, Consumer Retail, Food & Beverages, Property & Hospitality, Manufacturing & Engineering, and Commercial Technology. Aiming to be more than family business - but beyond that, we are business for families, we carry the mission to bring values for betterment of lives through business development and continuous growth.

Job Description

Are You Ready to Make It Happen at Mondelēz International?

Join our mission to change the way the world snacks. Make It Matter.

MDLZ would like to harness the potential and use data efficiently to empower the AMEA Direct Materials Sourcing teams to source better than the competition. This role is responsible to bridge BU business needs to effective/value driven execution proposals via connecting all dots BU/Spend areas. being engaged into data insights building and performing benchmarking analysis. This role will be performing cost model analysis including sourcing strategy optimization leveraging multiple sources across the spend portfolio and data lake. In addition, this role will be drawing insights & conclusions to enable spend area digital agenda.

How You Will Contribute

  • The critical skill set required in these roles is to bridge BU business needs to effective/value driven execution proposals via connecting all dots BU/Spend areas.
  • Provides advanced analytics and Use of data visualization tools (e.g. PowerBI or Tableau) to help translate complex data into simple & meaningful insights. Partner with Sourcing Managers to model impact of trading variables.
  • Perform analysis to benchmark costs to support sourcing decisions & productivity programs.
  • Support execution of broader AMEA Direct Materials Sourcing Excellence COE team agenda.


What You Will Bring

A desire to drive your future and accelerate your career. You will bring experience and knowledge in:

  • Strong analytical skillset with experience in Excel (e.g. advanced formulas, pivot table, VBA) and visualization and reporting platforms such as Tableau or Power BI is a must.
  • Experience working with advanced analytics platforms such as R/Python or SQL experience will be considered as asset.
  • Ability to simplify complex problems and communicate to non-technical audience.
  • Experience working with & understanding complex business problems and being able to model scenarios/solutions will be an asset.
  • 3-5 year experience in a Procurement, Spend analytics is preferred.
  • University bachelor’s degree in a business administration, economics or quantitative discipline (e.g., engineering, statistics, maths, analytics, finance, science).


More About This Role

KPIs / Dimensions:

Spend Analytics accuracy & Robust KPI governance

AMEA Direct Materials Scope

Targets / Dimensions:

Developing best practices with analytical skills.

Creating data into meaningful insights with right visualization

Key Interfaces / Stakeholders:

External: Suppliers

Internal: BU procurement Lead and other BU MSC Stakeholder, Spend Area Sourcing Managers / Sourcing Directors, Global Analytics Manager, Data analytics network

Key Leadership Competencies:

Creativity, Integrity and trust, Strategic agility, Intellectual horsepower, Presentation skills, Problem solving, Process management

Key Functional Competencies:

  • Data Modelling and Scenario Building
  • External and internal Cost Benchmarking
  • Runing Data analytics, Deriving Insights & Drawing Conclusions
  • Building & Running Optimization models
  • Making complex topics simple
  • Stakeholders influencing


No Relocation support available

Business Unit Summary

Mondelēz International in Southeast Asia is in five countries serving 19 markets with more than 18 nationalities and 7,500 employees. This group is emerging as one of the fastest growing regions in Asia, the Middle East and Africa, and we are proud of consistently producing high quality products in nine manufacturing sites. We are market leaders in key snacking categories, making and selling brands like Oreo and Tiger biscuits, Kinh Do mooncakes, Jacob’s crackers, Cadbury Dairy Milk chocolate, Tang powdered beverage, Halls candy and Eden cheese. We set the benchmark in being a responsible business and contributing to the communities in which we operate.

Mondelēz International is an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, gender, sexual orientation or preference, gender identity, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law.

descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We are looking for a Data Scientist – Credit Analytics to build, analyze, and optimize credit risk models that support Electrum’s financing, rent-to-own, and partner credit programs. In this role, you will work closely with Risk, Finance, Product, and Operations teams to translate data into actionable insights that drive better credit decisions, portfolio performance, and customer outcomes.

You will play a key role in developing data-driven frameworks for credit scoring, approval, monitoring, and loss mitigation across Electrum’s ecosystem.

What You Will DoCredit Modeling & Analytics

  • Develop and maintain credit scoring models, risk segmentation, and decision frameworks.

  • Analyze customer, transaction, and behavioral data to assess creditworthiness and default risk.

  • Build and validate predictive models for approval rate, delinquency, default, and recovery.

  • Monitor portfolio performance metrics such as NPL, PD, LGD, ECL, and vintage analysis.

Data Analysis & Insights

  • Conduct deep-dive analyses to identify drivers of credit performance and risk trends.

  • Perform cohort, funnel, and behavioral analysis to improve underwriting and credit policy.

  • Translate complex data findings into clear insights and recommendations for stakeholders.

  • Support A/B testing and experimentation for credit rules, pricing, and policy changes.

Risk Strategy & Decision Support

  • Partner with Risk and Business teams to define credit policies, cut-offs, and eligibility rules.

  • Provide data support for credit strategy initiatives including limit setting, pricing, and collections.

  • Design dashboards and monitoring tools to track portfolio health and early warning indicators.

Data Engineering & Governance

  • Work with Data Engineering teams to ensure data quality, availability, and reliability.

  • Define data requirements, feature engineering logic, and data documentation standards.

  • Ensure compliance with data governance, privacy, and regulatory standards.

What You Bring

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics, Engineering, or related field.

  • 2–5 years of experience in credit analytics, risk modeling, or financial data science.

  • Strong proficiency in Python or R for data analysis and modeling.

  • Solid understanding of statistical modeling, machine learning, and predictive analytics.

  • Experience working with structured datasets (SQL, data warehouses).

  • Knowledge of credit risk concepts such as PD, LGD, EAD, NPL, IFRS 9 / PSAK 71 is a strong advantage.

  • Ability to clearly communicate insights to non-technical stakeholders.

Nice to Have

  • Experience in fintech, lending, BNPL, rent-to-own, or consumer finance.

  • Familiarity with alternative data sources (telemetry, transactional, behavioral data).

  • Experience with BI tools (Looker, Tableau, Power BI).

  • Exposure to model governance, validation, or regulatory reporting.

This position is posted by Jobgether on behalf of a partner company. We are currently looking for a Design Engineer in Indonesia.

This role focuses on turning high-fidelity product designs into functional, interactive front-end prototypes in a fast-paced, fully remote environment. You will partner closely with product designers to iterate rapidly, translating Figma mockups into working prototypes that accelerate validation, improve stakeholder communication, and streamline handoff to engineering. Leveraging AI-assisted coding tools, your work ensures that designs are implemented with precision, visual polish, and functional quality. You will help set the standard for prototype-driven design, supporting experimentation, innovation, and rapid product development while contributing to reusable front-end components. This role requires strong technical skills, attention to detail, and a design-oriented mindset to deliver high-impact results quickly and effectively.

Accountabilities

  • Work 1:1 with product designers to transform Figma concepts into interactive, production-quality prototypes.
  • Build prototypes using technologies consistent with the production front-end (React, Next.js , TypeScript, Tailwind), leveraging AI coding tools like Cursor and Claude Code.
  • Translate multi-screen flows into functional implementations, iterating quickly through critique loops to ensure alignment with design intent.
  • Deploy prototypes to preview environments for asynchronous review, feedback, and stakeholder alignment.
  • Collaborate with the Design Systems and front-end engineering teams to ensure consistency and maintain reusable components.
  • Provide input on technical feasibility, complexity, and potential improvements while managing multiple workstreams.
  • Maintain high attention to visual fidelity, interaction polish, and UX quality in all prototypes.

Requirements

  • 3+ years of experience building web interfaces using modern front-end frameworks and component-based architecture.
  • Strong proficiency with React, TypeScript, Next.js , Tailwind CSS, and related front-end libraries (Radix, Headless UI, shadcn/ui).
  • Hands-on experience with AI-assisted coding tools (Cursor, Claude Code) for rapid prototyping.
  • Ability to translate design specifications into functional code while maintaining high visual and interaction standards.
  • Experience working in production-style codebases, Git workflows, and preview deployments (e.g., Vercel).
  • Exceptional collaboration and communication skills, with the ability to work asynchronously and in real-time across remote teams.
  • High attention to detail and a design-oriented mindset, with a focus on UX quality, visual polish, and interaction fidelity.
  • Bonus: familiarity with animation libraries (Framer Motion, CSS transitions) and accessibility best practices.
  • Proficient in English (CEFR Level C2 / ILR Level 5).

Benefits

  • Competitive salary: $90,000 - $100,000 USD per year, with annual review, benefits, and potential equity participation.
  • Fully remote work from anywhere in the world.
  • Autonomy and trust to manage outcomes with minimal oversight.
  • 35 days of PTO annually, plus paid sabbatical after 5 years.
  • Comprehensive medical coverage or reimbursement options for you and your family.
  • Parental leave for new or expanding families.
  • Home office and learning & development stipends to support productivity and professional growth.
  • Annual bonus potential for roles without variable income or commission.
  • Twice-yearly fully paid company retreats in global locations.

Our system identifies the top-fitting candidates, and this shortlist is then shared directly with the hiring company. The final decision and next steps (interviews, assessments) are managed by their internal team.

We appreciate your interest and wish you the best!

descriptionHtml:
As a fraud analyst, the jobholder will be to conduct monitoring, investigation and detecting potential fraudulent activity in the bank's digital transactions. Your responsibilities will include reviewing customer transactions for any signs of suspicious behavior, identifying potential fraud trends, and investigating any incidents of fraud and this includes contacting the customers to conduct inquiries as necessary. You will also work closely with other teams, such as IT, Customer Service and Risk Management, to develop and implement fraud prevention strategies and policies. Additionally, you will need to keep up-to-date with the latest fraud detection technologies and tools and participate in regular training sessions and team meetings. Your efforts will be crucial in ensuring the safety and security of the bank's digital transactions and maintaining customer trust and confidence.

Major Responsibilities

  • Monitoring and investigating fraud alerts and customer reports to detect any signs of suspicious activity or behavior that may indicate potential fraud.
  • Analyzing transaction data and patterns to identify potential fraud trends and patterns.
  • Investigating incidents of suspected fraud, including gathering evidence and working with other teams to resolve cases.
  • Collaborating with other departments, such as IT, Customer Services and Risk Management, to develop and implement fraud prevention strategies and policies.
  • Staying up-to-date on the latest fraud detection technologies and tools and participating in regular training sessions and team meetings.
  • Maintaining accurate records of fraud incidents and investigations and providing regular reports to management.
  • Ensuring compliance with regulatory requirements related to fraud prevention and reporting.

Requirements

  • A minimum of 2 years’ hands-on experience in a fraud investigation role in banking and Data Analytics.
  • Experience in digital banking and/or financial technology companies will be a significant plus.
  • Basic python programming is a plus.
  • Advance knowledge in SQL and basic statistical knowledge is a must
  • Strong analytical skills and put attention on details
  • Conversational ability in English is a must
  • Strong and highly motivated with positive mindset attitude
  • Collaborative and comfortable working in a dynamic and fast-paced environment

descriptionHtml:
Deskripsi Pekerjaan

  • Conduct end-to-end design processes from understanding business and user needs, creating concepts, wireframes, prototypes, to final UI designs ready for implementation.
  • Coordinate with Product Managers to understand problems, feature requirements, user stories, and product priorities.
  • Collaborate with UX Researchers to leverage research insights and validate solutions through usability testing or other methods.
  • Develop and present design solutions to stakeholders, ensuring alignment with business goals and user needs.
  • Create user flows, journey maps, wireframes, and prototypes to visualize and validate ideas.
  • Develop high-fidelity UI designs that align with UX/UI best practices.
  • Support implementation with the Engineering Team by ensuring the final output matches the design through design handoff, design QA, and effective communication.
  • Manage, develop, and maintain the Design System, including:
    • Creating, updating, and documenting UI components.
    • Ensuring consistency across platforms and squads.
    • Collaborating with Interaction Designers/Design System Owners to refine components.
    • Identifying gaps in the design system and proposing improvements.
    • Advocating for and enforcing Design System usage across Design and Engineering teams to ensure consistent and scalable output.
  • Iterate on designs based on feedback, data, and usability testing results to improve user experience quality.
  • Keep up with design trends, technology, and best practices to continuously enhance product design quality.
  • Actively participate in brainstorming sessions, co-design workshops, or design critiques to generate creative and data-driven design solutions.
  • Document design processes, design decisions, and guidelines for internal knowledge sharing.
Persyaratan

  • Bachelor's degree graduate from preferably Computer Science, Informatics/Information Systems, or DKV major or related fields.
  • Minimum 2 years of work experience as a Product / UI Designer with experience in delivering end-to-end design for digital products.
  • Proficient in design tools: Figma (primary), Adobe Creative Suite, or other supporting tools.
  • Understands UX/UI principles, design thinking, and user-centered design.
  • Able to create wireframes, user flows, prototypes, and high-fidelity UI.
  • Familiar with usability testing, heuristics, and interpreting research insights.
  • Understands design systems (creation & implementation).
  • Strong communication and cross-functional collaboration skills (PM, Engineering, Research).
  • Nice to have: Experience creating or implementing a design system is a plus.

Other Requirements

  • Able to work independently or collaboratively within a squad.
  • Has a portfolio relevant to Product Design experience.
  • Data-driven and able to leverage user insights.
  • Strong at prioritization and comfortable working in a fast-paced environment.
  • Possesses a growth mindset and strong attention to detail.

Type

Welcome to Motel

Our story began during a road trip in the 1990s, where our founders, Will and Andy, travelled across America collecting vintage items while living out of motels. They started purchasing vintage clothing in the USA and selling it wholesale, which eventually led to the creation of stores. From there, they began designing reworked vintage pieces, and thus, Motel was born.

Over 30 years and a team of 200+ people later, every piece of clothing we make is created with the same spirit of fun, freedom and adventure as the road trip that first defined the brand. We’re still ambitious and independent, but now we’re a global team - we work from an operational base in Worcester, a design studio in London and a creative studio in Bali.

The Role

As a Web Administrator, you will be responsible for preparing new-in items accurately across all sites and ensuring they go live on time as requested.

Main Tasks & Responsibilities

  • Setting an item live on website
  • Daily check of new-In stock level in each site and update to A/B slide
  • Update Most Wanted Collection from last new-in according to 175 Trade Report every Monday
  • Daily check Coming Soon item for related sites
  • Update Model’s Name in Daily Sales Figure one day after New-In item set live
  • Update back in stock collection when there is an email notification for all sites
  • Support Motel's sustainability initiatives by considering how our practices can improve, actively working in line with the sustainability journey of the business.

About You

  • Minimum of a Diploma or Bachelor’s degree in any field
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills
  • An individual with strong attention to detail
  • Have a basic understanding of women’s fashion & visual merchandising
  • Familiar with Google spreadsheet, slide & docs
  • Ability to work overtime when necessary

What's in it for you?

  • Competitive salary in line with industry benchmarking
  • A comprehensive health and social security package, including working social security.
  • Team socials and meetups
  • Monthly well-being activities to support your health and wellbeing
  • Tailored progression pathways
  • Bonus scheme for employees, paid out twice a year at management discretion
  • Motel is a growth mentality company!

At Motel Rocks, we value and believe in fostering an inclusive and diverse environment for our employees, customers, and partners. We are committed to building a brand that celebrates differences and promotes equal opportunities.

descriptionHtml:
Sebagai Senior Penetration Tester, Anda akan bertanggung jawab dalam merancang, memimpin, dan mengeksekusi pengujian keamanan tingkat lanjut pada berbagai sistem dan aplikasi. Posisi ini berperan strategis dalam mengidentifikasi celah keamanan kritis, mensimulasikan serangan dunia nyata, serta memberikan rekomendasi mitigasi yang efektif bagi klien maupun tim internal.

Jobdesk

  • Menentukan dan memimpin proses scoping pengujian keamanan (web, mobile, API, network, cloud, internal/external)
  • Menyusun dan menegakkan Rules of Engagement (RoE) serta metodologi pengujian (black box, gray box, white box)
  • Berkoordinasi dengan stakeholder (klien, engineering, product, infra) untuk memahami aset dan tujuan pengujian
  • Melakukan advanced penetration testing & exploitation pada:
  • Web Application
  • Mobile Application (Android/iOS)
  • API
  • Network & Infrastructure
  • Cloud Environment
  • Melakukan simulasi real-world attack scenario, seperti:
  • Phishing simulation
  • Credential harvesting
  • Lateral movement & pivoting
  • Command & Control (C2) scenario
  • Menganalisis tingkat risiko, dampak bisnis, dan kemungkinan eksploitasi dari setiap temuan
  • Menyusun laporan penetration testing yang komprehensif (Executive Summary & Technical Report)
  • Memberikan rekomendasi mitigasi yang realistis, aplikatif, dan sesuai kondisi sistem
  • Melakukan presentasi hasil temuan kepada klien atau stakeholder internal
  • Menjadi mentor / reviewer bagi pentester junior (code review, methodology review, report review)
  • Mengikuti perkembangan terbaru terkait vulnerability, exploit, dan tren keamanan siber

Kualifikasi

  • Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 Teknik Informatika, Ilmu Komputer, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait
  • Pengalaman minimal 3–5 tahun sebagai Penetration Tester / Red Team / Security Consultant
  • Memahami secara mendalam Cyber Security Fundamentals (Networking, OS, TCP/IP, HTTP/HTTPS)
  • Menguasai Web & API Security, terutama OWASP Top 10
  • Berpengalaman melakukan manual penetration testing (bukan hanya automated scanning)
  • Familiar dengan standar & metodologi:
  • PTES
  • OWASP Testing Guide
  • NIST / MITRE ATT&CK
  • Menguasai tools keamanan seperti:
  • Burp Suite, Nmap, Metasploit
  • SQLmap, Nikto, Gobuster, ffuf
  • Hydra, John the Ripper, Hashcat
  • Memiliki kemampuan scripting (Python, Bash, atau JavaScript) untuk automation & custom exploit
  • Memiliki kemampuan analisis, problem solving, dan dokumentasi yang sangat baik
  • Mampu berkomunikasi teknis maupun non-teknis dengan jelas

descriptionHtml:
Company Description

A global luxury brand with hospitality at its heart, Raffles Hotels & Resorts encompasses 20 ultra luxury hotels and resorts in key international destinations, some with additional branded private residences. Four further hotel properties will open under the Raffles brand in 2024-25. Named after the pioneering British founder of Singapore, Sir Stamford Raffles, the Raffles brand is synonymous with the elegant British etiquette, effortless glamour and sophistication of an earlier era, while bringing a sensibility that is in tune with the lives of our well-travelled guests – at once a vibrant heart and a tranquil haven.

At Raffles our service style is warm, personalised and gracious, with a legendary spirit of generosity embodied by our signature Raffles Butlers. We have led the way in creating hotel interiors that are art museums in their own right; we are fertile ground for creativity in the culinary arts, attracting leading chefs; and we work with expert practitioners and specialist partners to create next-generation wellness experiences. We have always sought to preserve both cultural and natural heritage, employing historians, marine biologists and art curators within the properties, to underline an experience that is truly authentic.

At Raffles, visitors arrive as guests, leave as friends and return as family. Along the way they will discover a place to celebrate, adventure, exchange ideas and be inspired; and a new meaning of luxury that touches the emotions as elegantly as the Raffles name itself.

Raffles Jakarta is strategically located in the heart of the Kuningan district within Jakarta's Golden Triangle. It is an art-filled oasis that elegantly blends history, culture, and luxury. The hotel is more than just a place to stay; it's a meeting point for art and ideas, business and leisure, glamour and fashion. Connected to Lotte Shopping Avenue and the Ciputra Artpreneur Centre, home to The Hendra Gunawan Museum, and a 1,200-seat Broadway Musical Theatre, our location is ideal for both local and international guests, offering convenience and a wealth of cultural experiences. The hotel offers exceptional facilities, including the serene Raffles Spa, a tranquil outdoor pool, versatile meeting spaces, and a state-of-the-art fitness centre, providing luxury and comfort.

At Raffles Jakarta, we pride ourselves on our dedicated team, who excel in delivering exceptional service and attention to detail. Founded by Dr. (HC) Ir. Ciputra, our hotel brings the legacy of renowned Indonesian artist Hendra Gunawan to life through our magnificent interiors. We are deeply committed to sustainability and community engagement, striving to minimize our environmental impact and actively support the local community. By choosing Raffles Jakarta, you do not just work at a luxury hotel but also support a hotel that cares about the local community.

By joining our team, you will join a community that values excellence, creativity, and sustainability. Embark on a rewarding career journey with Raffles Jakarta and contribute to our art, history, and luxury legacy.

Job Description

The Chief Engineer oversees and manages all aspects of engineering and maintenance operations within the Residences. They are responsible for ensuring the efficient functioning and upkeep of the Residences' physical infrastructure, including electrical systems, HVAC, plumbing, lift (elevator) systems, and other essential equipment. They collaborate closely with various departments to address maintenance issues promptly and implement preventive measures to minimize disruptions. Additionally, the Chief Engineer plays a pivotal role in implementing sustainable and energy-efficient practices, ensuring compliance with safety and regulatory standards.

Qualifications

  • Education: Bachelor’s degree in Engineering or a related field preferred. Specialization in Mechanical Engineering, Electrical Engineering, or Facilities Management is an advantage.
  • Experience: Minimum five years of progressive engineering and maintenance experience, ideally in a hotel, residences, or upscale property setting. Proven expertise in lift (elevator) maintenance, including troubleshooting, inspections, and preventive maintenance.
  • Leadership: Strong leadership capabilities with experience supervising a technical team. Demonstrated ability to delegate, train, and develop team members and foster a collaborative working environment.
  • Communication: Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts clearly to non-technical audiences and collaborate effectively across departments and with external vendors.
  • Problem-Solving: Agile and solutions-focused, with the ability to respond quickly to operational issues, assess risks, and make sound decisions under pressure. Experience in emergency preparedness or crisis management is an advantage.
  • Financial Acumen: Working knowledge of budgeting and cost control. Experience managing maintenance budgets, optimizing resources, and negotiating vendor or service provider contracts.
  • Compliance: Familiarity with safety standards, building regulations, and environmental requirements, ensuring all engineering operations remain compliant and properly documented.
