descriptionHtml:
ZALORA is looking for an IT Support Engineer to deliver reliable service desk and onsite IT support across our Jakarta Head Office (Jakarta Selatan). In this role, you’ll support end-user devices and business applications, maintain day-to-day IT operations (including backups, monitoring, and logging), ensure SOP/policy compliance, and assist with IT procurement.

Responsibilities:

  • Service Desk & Applications support: Provide support of all company owned end user devices
  • Operations: Deploy, maintain, execute and support procedures for highly effective and reliable onsite IT operations. Utilize appropriate tools and utilities to facilitate operations monitoring. Administer operations applications such as backups, system monitoring and logging. Initiate action to ensure problems are addressed promptly and appropriately
  • Policy and compliance: Auditing IT operational environment to comply with approved SOPs
  • Procurement: Assist in sourcing of IT equipment and infrastructure vendors

Requirements:

  • Candidate must possess at least a Professional Certificate, Diploma, Advanced/Higher/Graduate Diploma, Bachelor’s Degree, Post Graduate Diploma, Professional Degree in Computer Science/Information Technology or equivalent.
  • Minimum 1-year working experience in hands-on service desk support and IT infrastructure support
  • Willing to work in ZALORA's Head Office (Jakarta Selatan) and ZALORA's Warehouse (Bekasi)
  • Excellent troubleshooting skillset in Linux, Mac OS, Windows 10 & 11 operating systems, printer and device drivers, wireless and LAN connections
  • Familiar with the installation, configuration management and debugging of hardware devices (router, firewall, switch, server and NAS Storage)
  • Familiar with Kaseya VSA Professional and Helpdesk Ticketing System
  • Excellent knowledge in deploying and maintaining MS Active Directory GPO and Powershell scripting
  • Fluent in English & Bahasa
  • Excellent in creating IT documentation (SOPs, work instruction, and user guide)
  • Proactive and fast learner. Passion about new concepts & technologies
  • Strong analytical mind and willing to accept new challenges
  • Self-motivated, ability to work independently with minimum supervision

The ZALORA Story

ZALORA exists for the millions of fashion consumers in Asia seeking a shopping experience focused on their unique styles, trends and fit. As Asia’s leading online fashion destination, ZALORA was founded in 2012 and has a presence in Singapore, Indonesia, Malaysia & Brunei, the Philippines, Hong Kong and Taiwan. ZALORA’s localised sites offer an extensive collection of top international and local brands as well as our own in-house labels across apparel, shoes and accessories for men and women. ZALORA is part of Global Fashion Group, the world's leader in online fashion for emerging markets.

ZALORA is not obligated to accept resumes from any third parties on behalf of potential candidates for any position (advertised or otherwise) by any means, unless ZALORA has executed a written agreement with such third party and has expressly requested such third party for candidate referrals. Third parties who provide unsolicited resumes of candidate(s) shall waive and forfeit all rights to claim for any placement fees or referral fees in the event that such candidate is eventually engaged or employed by ZALORA or Global Fashion Group

descriptionHtml:
Project Manager – Retail & F&B ConstructionProject Manager – Konstruksi Retail & F&B


Location / Lokasi: Indonesia (Jakarta base, frequent site travel)

Industry / Industri: Restaurant & Retail Fit-Out (Airport & Commercial Buildings)

Employment Type / Status: Full-Time


About the RoleTentang Posisi Ini


EN

We are a construction company specializing in restaurants, cafés, and retail shops, mainly located in airports and commercial buildings across Indonesia.

We are hiring a hands-on Project Manager with strong experience in restaurant or retail fit-out projects, who understands the full lifecycle of building a shop or restaurant, especially MEP coordination, interior works, and materials.

This role is NOT intended for project managers whose main experience is in high-rise buildings, hotels, offices, or residential towers.


ID

Kami adalah perusahaan konstruksi yang berfokus pada pembangunan restoran, kafe, dan toko retail, terutama di bandara dan gedung komersial di seluruh Indonesia.

Kami mencari Project Manager yang hands-on, berpengalaman dalam proyek fit-out restoran atau retail, dan memahami seluruh proses pembangunan restoran/toko, khususnya MEP, interior, dan material.

Posisi ini tidak ditujukan untuk Project Manager dengan latar belakang utama gedung tinggi, hotel, kantor, atau apartemen.


Key ResponsibilitiesTanggung Jawab Utama


1. Project ExecutionPelaksanaan Proyek


EN

  • Manage restaurant & retail construction projects from start to handover
  • Handle interior fit-out works:
  • Flooring, walls, ceilings
  • Custom furniture, counters, joinery
  • Kitchen & back-of-house areas
  • Deliver projects on time, cost, and quality


ID

  • Mengelola proyek konstruksi restoran & toko dari awal hingga serah terima
  • Mengawasi pekerjaan fit-out interior:
  • Lantai, dinding, plafon
  • Furniture custom, counter, joinery
  • Area dapur & back-of-house
  • Memastikan proyek selesai tepat waktu, sesuai anggaran, dan kualitas


2. MEP & Technical Coordination (Critical)Koordinasi MEP & Teknis (Sangat Penting)


EN

  • Coordinate MEP systems specific to restaurants & shops:
  • Electrical loads for kitchen equipment
  • HVAC (kitchen exhaust, fresh air, ducting)
  • Plumbing & drainage (floor trap, grease trap)
  • Fire protection & alarm systems
  • Identify clashes between MEP, interior, and equipment layouts
  • Work closely with MEP consultants and contractors


ID

  • Mengkoordinasikan sistem MEP khusus restoran & toko:
  • Beban listrik untuk peralatan dapur
  • HVAC (exhaust dapur, fresh air, ducting)
  • Plumbing & drainase (floor trap, grease trap)
  • Sistem proteksi kebakaran & alarm
  • Mengantisipasi benturan antara MEP, interior, dan layout peralatan
  • Berkoordinasi aktif dengan konsultan dan kontraktor MEP


3. Authority & Stakeholder CoordinationKoordinasi Otoritas & Stakeholder


EN

  • Liaise with:
  • Airport authorities
  • Mall / building management
  • Consultants and inspectors
  • Manage approvals related to:
  • Fit-out guidelines
  • Fire safety & MEP connections
  • Site regulations & working hours


ID

  • Berkoordinasi dengan:
  • Otoritas bandara
  • Pengelola gedung / mall
  • Konsultan & pihak inspeksi
  • Mengelola proses perizinan terkait:
  • Pedoman fit-out
  • Keselamatan kebakaran & koneksi MEP
  • Aturan lokasi dan jam kerja


4. Cost, BOQ & Procurement ControlPengendalian Biaya, BOQ & Pengadaan


EN

  • Review BOQ, budgets, and shop drawings
  • Control variations and cost changes
  • Coordinate procurement of:
  • Interior materials
  • Kitchen & MEP components
  • Ensure materials meet design, durability, and operational needs


ID

  • Meninjau BOQ, RAB, dan shop drawing
  • Mengontrol pekerjaan tambah/kurang (VO)
  • Mengkoordinasikan pengadaan:
  • Material interior
  • Komponen dapur & MEP
  • Memastikan material sesuai desain, ketahanan, dan kebutuhan operasional


5. Site Management & Quality ControlManajemen Lapangan & Kontrol Kualitas


EN

  • Regular site supervision
  • Ensure quality of:
  • Interior finishing
  • MEP installation
  • Final detailing
  • Resolve site issues quickly and effectively


ID

  • Pengawasan lapangan secara rutin
  • Menjaga kualitas:
  • Finishing interior
  • Instalasi MEP
  • Detail akhir pekerjaan
  • Menyelesaikan masalah lapangan secara cepat dan tepat


6. Handover & Opening ReadinessSerah Terima & Persiapan Operasional


EN

  • Coordinate testing & commissioning (MEP & kitchen systems)
  • Prepare punch lists and defect rectification
  • Support client during pre-opening & handover


ID

  • Mengkoordinasikan testing & commissioning (MEP & sistem dapur)
  • Menyusun punch list dan perbaikan
  • Mendukung klien saat masa persiapan buka & serah terima


Required Experience & ProfileKualifikasi & Pengalaman


Must-Have / Wajib
  • 5+ years experience in restaurant or retail fit-out projects
  • Strong understanding of MEP for F&B
  • Familiar with interior materials & construction methods
  • Experience working in malls, commercial buildings, or airports
  • Comfortable with fast-track projects and tight timelines


Nilai Tambah / Advantage
  • Airport project experience
  • Familiar with international F&B brand standards
  • Able to review and comment on MEP & interior drawings
  • Experience handling multiple projects simultaneously


This Role Is NOT ForPosisi Ini Tidak Cocok Untuk


EN

  • Project managers focused on:
  • High-rise towers
  • Hotels
  • Office buildings
  • Residential developments

ID

  • Project Manager dengan fokus utama:
  • Gedung bertingkat tinggi
  • Hotel
  • Gedung perkantoran
  • Apartemen / residensial


Why Join UsKenapa Bergabung Dengan Kami

EN

  • Clear niche: restaurant & retail only
  • Projects inside major airports & commercial buildings
  • Practical, fast-moving environment
  • Opportunity to grow with a specialized construction company

ID

  • Fokus jelas: restoran & retail
  • Proyek di bandara dan gedung komersial utama
  • Lingkungan kerja praktis & dinamis
  • Kesempatan berkembang bersama perusahaan spesialis fit-out

descriptionHtml:
Process Excellence Analyst


Chandra Asri Group, through its subsidiary PT Chandra Asri Sentral Solusi (CASS), has established a Shared Service Center (SSC) to enhance operational efficiency and support the business growth of its subsidiaries. From finance and HR to procurement, customer operations, and IT, our SSC is the backbone that keeps businesses running smoothly. One of our key areas of support is for Aster Chemicals & Energy (ACE), a leading chemical and energy solutions provider in Singapore and the Asia Pacific. ACE combines the legacy of Singapore’s first oil refinery with cutting-edge petrochemical operations, jointly owned by Chandra Asri Group and Glencore, one of the world’s largest natural resource companies.


Job Summary

The Process Excellence Team plays a critical role in supporting the Transformation Office by driving process improvement, standardization, and data-driven decision-making. The team is responsible for analyzing operational workflows, identifying improvement opportunities, designing optimized processes, and developing dashboards that enhance visibility into key performance indicators across shared service functions such as HR, Finance, Procurement, and Customer Operations.


Job Description

1. Business Process Optimization & Automation

  • Analyze current processes to identify gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities across shared service operations.
  • Identify automation opportunities (AI, RPA, workflow digitalization, system integration).
  • Support the development and implementation of process optimization initiatives that improve productivity, cost efficiency, and service levels.
  • Conduct root cause analysis and recommend corrective/preventive actions.
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to define clear performance indicators and ensure processes are aligned with operational goals.
  • Participate in continuous improvement workshops sessions to promote a culture of operational excellence.
  • Track, monitor, and report on process performance post-implementation to ensure sustainability of improvements.


2. KPI/SLA Management

  • Build and maintain KPI/SLA catalogues, formulas, thresholds, and scripts.
  • Automate KPI/SLA dashboards (Power BI/Tableau).
  • Investigate metric breaches and support corrective actions.
  • Prepare periodic performance reports and coordinate performance reviews.


3. Project Management & Change Management

  • Assist in monitoring and tracking transformation initiatives and ongoing improvement projects.
  • Prepare analysis, reports, and visual summaries to support PMO activities and project updates.
  • Provide data-driven insights to support strategic decision-making and prioritization of improvement initiatives.
  • Coordinate with cross-functional teams to ensure alignment between process improvement activities and overall transformation goals.

4. Business Continuity Planning (BCP)

  • Support BCP risk assessment, scenario modelling, and recovery strategies.
  • Maintain BCP documentation, testing, and employee awareness.


Job Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Industrial Engineering, Business Management, Computer Science, Data Analytics, or a related field.
  • Minimum 2–4 years of experience in process improvement, data analytics, performance reporting, or shared service operations.
  • Strong understanding of business processes across HR, Finance, Procurement, or Customer Operations is an advantage.
  • Proficiency in Power BI or similar visualization tools.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving capability with the ability to convert data into meaningful insights.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to work with stakeholders at multiple levels.
  • Detail-oriented, proactive, and able to work in a fast-paced shared service environment.


If you’re ready to bring your skills to a dynamic environment where your work makes an impact across industries and borders, we’d love to hear from you. Join us at Chandra Asri Group and be part of shaping a smarter, more connected future. Apply today!


Important Notes

Chandra Asri is only releasing official job posting at Chandra Asri Career Site (careers.capcx.com), Linkedin & Jobstreet. The Company will contact shortlisted candidate via official corporate email & phone, and will not send any hardcopy invitation for interview. Please note that the Company doesn’t ask candidates to transfer some amount of money nor cooperate with any travel agent.

BEWARE OF RECRUITMENT SCAM.

Description

Are you interested in System Administrator?

Our companies use many software, hardware and network system details. At any time these things can get interrupted and must be quickly resolved. Therefore we invite you who can maintain and fix the problem to be able to join as System Administrator expert. Before that make sure that you have the ability to quickly analyze and solve all problems.

What are your days like?

Every day you will work to see, maintain and examine our technology infrastructure. You will also connect with many people from different teams in the company. The most definitive part of this job is that you should be able to make sure all the devices are not affected and the work of all users of the device is not hampered.

What can you say to your friends, about your work?

Maybe everyone will think that you work as a computer technician. But that is not right. You can illustrate that your work has a wider scope of work such as networking, hardware and software. Ah, if it is too difficult to explain then say that you become a System Administrator expert.

My Responsibilities

  • You should be able to perform procedures on hardware and software including system configuration and install.
  • You will manage servers and all technological devices.
  • You will manage all accounts and workstations.
  • You can work to maintain the system fit to the company's needs.
  • You can detect problems, perform analysis and find solutions to all technological system problems.
  • You will also check and control all access, firewall and backup.
  • You will also make sure all the latest systems and can run the upgrade system.
  • You will communicate well to provide training to staff about the latest technology.
  • You should be able to create internal wiki with technical documentation, manuals and IT policies.

Responsibilities

So, what are the requirements?

  • You should have experience working as System Administrator, network administrator and other related fields.
  • It is important to work with database, LAN and WAN networks also patch management.
  • Have a strong knowledge of security systems such as intrusion detection systems and data backup / recovery.
  • Can create scripts in Python, Perl or other language.
  • Very important if you can work with various operating systems and platforms.
  • Can solve the problem and be open to provide all the information to the related staff.
  • We would like to work with you who have Bachelor degree in Information Technology, Computer Science and other related field.
  • If you have a profesional certificate such as Microsoft Certified Systems Administrator (MCSA) and other related certificate types then it can be an added value.

So here you are, you will not be able to enjoy this work if you do not make this important step. What is that? Create your online portfolio and send it to us as soon as possible. Give your best potential and let's join the big family of Halo Jasa team.

About us:

FIT HUB is a venture-backed technology driven health and wellness startup based in Jakarta, Indonesia. Founded in 2020, FIT HUB’s mission is to democratize access to Health and Wellness for all Indonesians. We believe that everyone should have access to improving their health and wellness, so we’ve built FIT HUB from the ground up to make exercising friendly, affordable, and fun for new gym-goers and fitness-enthusiasts alike.


The Opportunity:

This role offers high ownership with a direct impact on product growth, member engagement, and commercial performance, while working cross-functionally with Product, Commercial, and Data Engineering teams, and providing the opportunity to shape analytics standards, metric definitions, and scalable reporting foundations across the organization.


What You Will Do:

  • Own end-to-end analytics delivery: from data exploration and SQL analysis to dashboarding and clear executive-ready storytelling.
  • Maintain and improve recurring monthly reporting for Product and Commercial performance (accuracy, consistency, and on-time delivery).
  • Build and maintain key product and business funnels (e.g., in-app transactions, class booking funnels, feature usage funnels) and track conversion performance.
  • Deliver segmentation and cohort analysis to understand member behavior and identify opportunities to improve engagement and retention.
  • Support product experimentation by producing impact readouts using agreed methodology (e.g., A/B test analysis, before-and-after evaluation with clear assumptions).
  • Work closely with Data Engineering to ensure trusted datasets, consistent metric definitions, and reliable dashboards.
  • Partner with Product, UX, Commercial, and Operations stakeholders for ad-hoc analysis and insight generation; translate business questions into structured analysis plans.
  • Provide recommendations based on data findings, and help monitor execution outcomes through clear success metrics.



What We Need:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science, Engineering, or related fields (or equivalent practical experience).
  • 4+ years experience in Data Analyst / Business Intelligence / Product Analytics roles.
  • Strong SQL skills and ability to work with large datasets and event-based data.
  • Hands-on experience with BI tools (Looker Studio / Tableau / Power BI or similar) and building dashboards that stakeholders actually use.
  • Experience producing structured reports for senior stakeholders (clear narrative, key insights, and action recommendations).
  • Strong communication and stakeholder management skills; structured, detail-oriented, and comfortable working cross-functionally.
  • Nice to have: experience with experimentation analysis (A/B testing), product analytics tracking (e.g., GA4/event tables), and basic Python for analysis.

We are looking for a passionate and detail-oriented Formulator Executive to join our R&D team. This role is responsible for developing, optimizing, and maintaining fragrance or personal care formulations that meet quality, safety, regulatory, and cost requirements. As an Assistant Manager–level role, you will work closely with cross-functional teams and contribute both technically and strategically to product development initiatives.

Key Responsibilities

  • Develop, reformulate, and optimize fragrance or personal care products in line with brand, performance, and regulatory standards.
  • Conduct formulation trials, stability tests, and product performance evaluations.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams including Marketing, Regulatory, Quality, Procurement, and Manufacturing during product development and scale-up.
  • Support new product development (NPD) projects from concept to commercialization.
  • Troubleshoot formulation, raw material, and production-related issues.
  • Ensure compliance with local and international cosmetic regulations and safety standards.

  • Act as a technical contributor and provide guidance to junior team members when required.

Requirements

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Pharmacy, Cosmetic Science, or related fields.
  • 5–8 years of experience in formulation development, preferably in fragrance and/or personal care products.
  • Strong hands-on experience in cosmetic or fragrance formulation and laboratory work.
  • Good understanding of cosmetic regulations, safety assessments, and product compliance.
  • Familiar with stability testing, scale-up processes, and manufacturing challenges.
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and documentation skills.
  • Able to work independently while collaborating effectively within a team.
  • Good communication skills in English, both written and verbal.
  • Detail-oriented, structured, and proactive with a continuous improvement mindset.

Grab is Southeast Asia's leading superapp. From getting your favourite meals delivered to helping you manage your finances and getting around town hassle-free, we've got your back with everything. Job Summary

The Data Analyst is responsible for managing data for analysis, and performance evaluation to support management decision-making. This role ensures data accuracy, data integrity, and reliability while delivering actionable insights through dashboards and analytical reports. The position works closely with Maintenance, Finance, and operation teams to improve performance monitoring system and data-driven initiatives.

  • Familiar with mining equipment and processing plant environments is preferred.
  • Expert-level proficiency in Power BI (data modeling, DAX, dashboard development, and visualization).
  • Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint.

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

  • Database Installation and Configuration: As a database administrator, you'll be responsible for setting up and configuring database systems. This involves installing the database software, managing server settings, and ensuring proper connectivity.
  • Data Backup and Recovery: You'll develop and implement strategies for regular data backup and recovery to protect against data loss or system failures. This includes creating backup schedules, testing backup integrity, and restoring data when necessary.
  • Performance Monitoring and Optimization: It's essential to monitor database performance to ensure optimal speed and efficiency. You'll analyze system performance, identify bottlenecks, and optimize database structures, queries, and indexes for improved performance.
  • Security and Access Control: Database administrators play a critical role in maintaining data security. You'll establish security protocols, manage user access permissions, and implement mechanisms to safeguard sensitive data from unauthorized access or breaches.
  • Database Troubleshooting and Maintenance: When issues arise, you'll be the go-to person for troubleshooting and resolving database-related problems. This involves diagnosing errors, resolving conflicts, and applying patches or upgrades to maintain a stable and secure database environment.
  • Collaboration and Support: You'll collaborate with developers, system administrators, and other teams to understand their data requirements and provide support in designing efficient database structures. Additionally, you'll assist users with database-related queries and provide technical guidance when needed.
  • Oversee database operations, backup/recovery, and performance optimization.
  • Approve schema changes, DDL/DML operations, and batch job execution.
  • Monitor and maintain high availability and disaster recovery (RPO/RTO compliance).
  • Lead a team of Database Administrator's and coordinate with application, infrastructure, and vendor teams.
  • Conduct capacity planning and provide regular performance reports.

Requirements

What You Need To Have

  • 5–7+ years of experience in Database Administration.
  • Experience managing high-availability database environments. (PostgreSQL; MySQL; SQLServer; Oracle)
  • Strong understanding of backup strategies, performance tuning, and security best practices.
  • Leadership and team coordination experience.
  • Problem-Solving & Analytical Skills.
  • Good communication and collaboration skill.
  • Updated on technological developments.
  • Having database administration certification is a plus.
  • Banking industry experience preferred.

descriptionHtml:
Lingkup Pekerjaan

  • Riset tren modest wear lokal dan global untuk menghasilkan insight pengembangan koleksi (warna, cutting, material, preferensi pasar, kompetitor).
  • Menyusun konsep koleksi dari nol: tema, moodboard, kategori produk, palet warna, direction visual dasar campaign.
  • Mendesain produk lengkap: sketsa manual/digital, spesifikasi teknis, pemilihan material, trimming, konstruksi, dan tech pack siap sampling.
  • Koordinasi teknis dengan vendor pola/konveksi untuk memastikan interpretasi desain akurat, termasuk review pola dan arahan teknis.
  • Evaluasi proses sampling (fitting, ukuran, warna, kenyamanan, proporsi) dan iterasi sampai final siap produksi massal.
  • Kontrol time efficiency dan cost efficiency pada siklus sampling untuk menghindari over-iteration.
  • Kolaborasi dengan tim produksi, merchandising, dan marketing untuk memastikan desain selaras dengan positioning brand dan target HPP/timeline launching.
  • Dokumentasi seluruh proses desain dan pengembangan produk (arsip desain, tech pack, revisi, spesifikasi bahan) untuk kebutuhan repeat order dan scale produksi.

Kualifikasi Utama

  • Lulusan D3/S1 Fashion Design, Textile, atau bidang relevan.
  • Mampu membuat dan/atau memvalidasi pola manual serta pola CAD (CLO3D/Optitex/Gerber nilai tambah).
  • Menguasai Adobe Illustrator untuk flat sketch dan tech pack.
  • Pengetahuan bahan/modest wear yang kuat dan peka terhadap tekstur, jatuhan, elastisitas, shrinkage, kenyamanan pemakaian.
  • Mampu berkomunikasi teknis secara jelas dengan vendor pola/konveksi dan menjaga kontrol kualitas interpretasi desain.
  • Terbiasa bekerja berbasis deadline pengembangan produk dan target launching koleksi.
  • Mampu berkolaborasi lintas fungsi dan mengkomunikasikan keputusan desain secara jelas dan teknis.

Kualifikasi Penguat

  • Pengalaman 2–3 tahun sebagai Fashion Designer di industri modest wear.
  • Portofolio lengkap mencakup riset, moodboard, desain, tech pack, pola, sample, hingga koleksi final.
  • Menguasai CLO3D atau Marvelous Designer untuk simulasi dan prototyping digital.
  • Memahami dasar merchandising (assortment plan, kuota SKU, perencanaan kategori).
  • Familiar dengan tools kolaborasi digital seperti Figma dan Notion.

descriptionHtml:
Tanggung Jawab Pekerjaan

  • Mengembangkan dan mengimplementasikan strategi pemeliharaan untuk memastikan keandalan mesin dan peralatan.
  • Membuat jadwal pemeliharaan preventif, memastikan kegiatan pemeliharaan dilakukan secara rutin dan tepat.
  • Merancang dan mengembangkan proses serta peralatan baru, guna menciptakan perbaikan langsung dari perspektif teknik untuk mengurangi kerugian dan cacat, sekaligus meningkatkan throughput serta penerapan praktik terbaik di lantai produksi.
  • Mengkoordinasikan instalasi dan commissioning peralatan baru untuk memaksimalkan efisiensi produksi dan kemudahan perawatan. Mengelola dan mengendalikan fungsi pemeliharaan pabrik agar aset tetap dalam kondisi optimal sesuai kebutuhan bisnis.
  • Mengembangkan konsep pemeliharaan dan rencana induk pemeliharaan, serta bertanggung jawab atas implementasi sesuai dengan sistem manajemen Total Productive Maintenance (TPM).
  • Mengawasi pemeliharaan gedung dan area pabrik untuk memastikan fasilitas beroperasi penuh, terawat dengan baik, seluruh utilitas berfungsi dengan baik, termasuk penerapan prosedur keamanan dan kesiapsiagaan darurat.
  • Menganalisis anggaran serta secara berkelanjutan mengelola dan mengendalikan biaya secara efisien dalam batas anggaran perusahaan, baik terkait biaya proyek maupun pemeliharaan peralatan pabrik, gedung, dan infrastruktur.
  • Mengelola dan menganalisis kinerja lini produksi (KPI) serta mengoordinasikan tindakan perbaikan untuk mencapai target kinerja yang telah disepakati.

Persyaratan Pekerjaan

  • Gelar Sarjana di bidang Teknik Mesin, Teknik Elektro, Teknik Industri, atau bidang terkait.
  • Memiliki pengalaman yang solid dalam teknik pemeliharaan, khususnya di industri manufaktur.
  • Memahami cara kerja mesin seperti pompa sentrifugal, pompa dial, pengaduk (agitator), pengelasan, mixer, dan sistem perpipaan.
  • Memiliki pengalaman signifikan pada posisi serupa di bidang pemeliharaan produksi, rekayasa proses, perencanaan operasional, dan lingkungan manufaktur.
  • Memiliki pengetahuan tentang sistem mekanikal, elektrikal, dan otomatisasi (SCADA, PLC, dll.).
  • Memiliki keterampilan kepemimpinan, pemecahan masalah, dan komunikasi yang sangat baik.
  • Penempatan: Pabrik Cikande, Banten.

Apply to email: recruitment@dgw.co.id

Shootday, a global photography, videography, and production platform, is looking for talented event photographers to join our freelance network

Job Overview

As an event photographer, you'll capture memorable moments at various events and deliver high-quality raw images that tell compelling visual stories.

Your Responsibilities

  • Capture high-quality RAW photos on time (we handle the editing)
  • Cover diverse events from corporate functions to product launches and social gatherings
  • Capture key moments, candid shots, and the event ambiance
  • Adapt your approach to each event's unique needs
  • Collaborate with other photographers when needed
  • Use your professional camera gear, including cameras, lenses, and lighting equipment
  • Guide participants and set up shots for the best results
  • Communicate effectively with clients and the Shootday team

What We're Looking For

  • Proven experience in event photography with a strong portfolio
  • Good communication skills and a professional attitude
  • Ability to work in different environments and event types
  • Reliable transportation to get to event locations
  • A team player who works well with others when needed
  • A photography degree or equivalent experience

What We Offer

  • Competitive rates:
    • USD 50/hour for assignments up to 4 hours
    • USD 40/hour for assignments over 4 hours
  • Flexible scheduling: Accept or decline assignments based on your availability
  • Exposure to a wide range of events and networking opportunities
  • Timely payments and a friendly, supportive work environment
  • Loyalty program: Increased assignments and priority booking for consistently high-performing photographers
  • Global platform to showcase your work and expand your professional network
  • Consistent work opportunities across various event types
  • Professional support and clear communication
  • Potential for long-term relationships and career growth
Requirements

  • Be located in or able to commute to the specified location
  • Have legal authorization to work in the specified location
  • Own and maintain your photography gear
  • Upload your CV, and complete the application form

Join Shootday and become part of a global community of talented photographers. Apply now by submitting your portfolio and a brief introduction about yourself.

Shootday values diversity and is committed to creating an inclusive environment for all photographers.

About the Role

Siloam Hospitals Group is looking for a talented Interior Designer to join our Corporate Design & Development team. This role will play a key part in shaping patient-centric, functional, and modern hospital environments across our nationwide network. If you’re passionate about designing meaningful spaces that impact patient care and hospital operations, this role is for you.


What You Will Do

  • Develop interior design concepts for new hospitals, renovations, and expansion projects.
  • Conduct site surveys and translate operational needs into functional space layouts.
  • Produce layouts, 3D renders, mood boards, and detailed construction drawings.
  • Specify materials, finishes, furniture, fixtures, signage, and lighting.
  • Collaborate with Project Management, Engineering, Operations, and Nursing teams.
  • Coordinate with vendors, contractors, and external consultants during execution.
  • Monitor on-site construction to ensure work aligns with design standards.
  • Ensure all designs comply with safety, infection control, and regulatory requirements.
  • Support design standardization across the Siloam Hospitals network.


What We’re Looking For

  • Bachelor’s degree in Interior Design, Architecture, or related field.
  • 4–7 years of experience in commercial, healthcare, hospitality, or corporate interior projects.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, Revit, or similar design software.
  • Strong understanding of materials, lighting, ergonomics, and construction methods.
  • Excellent attention to detail, design sense, and visualization skills.
  • Strong project coordination and communication skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.


Why Join Siloam Hospitals Group?

  • Work with Indonesia’s leading hospital network.
  • Contribute to impactful spaces that improve patient and staff experience.
  • Opportunities for continuous learning and career growth.
  • Collaborative and supportive corporate environment.

About DANA

DANA is a leading Indonesian digital wallet platform committed to making every transaction simple, secure, and accessible. As a homegrown fintech company, we serve millions across Indonesia with cashless solutions—from payments and transfers to investments. We aim to build a trusted and inclusive financial ecosystem, driven by innovation, collaboration, and continuous learning.

Join us and be part of Indonesia’s digital transformation journey!


📌 What We’re Looking For: Automation Data Scientist

We require a Data Scientist to help us automate the process discovery cycle, to empower us to make data driven prioritization decisions in regards to the automation projects and build a process performance monitoring system once the automation has been delivered to production.


What You Will Do :

  • Designing, selecting, and engineering features, and building, evaluating, and optimizing predictive and generative models using state‑of‑the‑art machine‑learning techniques.
  • Developing, deploying, and maintaining machine‑learning models and pipelines in production environments, ensuring scalability, reliability, and low latency.
  • Monitoring model performance, detecting drift, and implementing automated retraining and governance strategies.
  • Researching and prototyping advanced statistical and machine‑learning methods to generate actionable insights and drive product innovation.
  • Collaborating with cross‑functional teams (product, engineering, design, business) to translate business problems into data‑science solutions with measurable impact.
  • Communicating complex technical results and insights to technical and non‑technical stakeholders.
  • Keeping up to date with the latest technology trends in data science, machine learning, and large language models, and actively pursuing continuous learning opportunities.


What You Will Need :

  • 2+ years of practical experience as a Data Scientist.
  • Strong problem‑solving skills with an emphasis on product development and delivery.
  • Practical experience with NLP, large language models (LLMs), computer vision, multimodal modeling, clustering, and decision‑tree algorithms.
  • Hands‑on experience with data‑science and machine‑learning libraries and frameworks such as Python (pandas, NumPy, scikit‑learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch) and related tooling (MLflow, Airflow, Spark) for experimentation and productionization.
  • Excellent programming skills in Python, including writing clean, modular, well‑documented code, adhering to software‑engineering best practices (Git version control, unit testing, code reviews, and CI/CD pipelines).
  • Ability to understand various data structures and common methods in data transformation and analysis.
  • Data‑oriented personality with a passion for empirical, evidence‑based decision‑making.
  • Great written and verbal communication skills, capable of translating complex analyses into clear business recommendations.
  • A self‑starter mindset, able to work independently while proactively collaborating with cross‑functional teams.


🎯 Ready to Apply?

If you're passionate about innovation and eager to make an impact, we’d love to hear from you. Apply now and grow with us at DANA.

Governance:

  • Establish the PMO role and create a Center of Excellence in alignment with Project Management Institute (PMI) guidelines, quality standards and company requirements.
  • Seek implementation efficiencies to meet or exceed the financial expectations established at project initiation.
  • Develop, implement, and govern program management processes, tools, templates, policies and metrics.

As a Regional IT Engineer, you will be the onsite technical expert supporting our regional offices and collaborating closely with Group IT. Your role ensures the reliability, security, and performance of IT systems while driving strategic initiatives such as cloud adoption, ISO 27001 compliance, and M&A integrations.


Key Responsibilities

  • End-User Support: Deliver Level 2 support for hardware, software, and network issues to maintain business continuity.
  • Security & Compliance: Monitor and enforce security standards aligned with ISO 27001 and group policies.
  • Cloud & Identity Management: Administer Microsoft 365, Azure Active Directory, and Exchange Online.
  • Endpoint & Device Management: Configure and manage Intune, Autopilot, and endpoint security tools (Defender, Sentinel One, CrowdStrike).
  • Infrastructure Management: Maintain local servers, networks (LAN/WAN/Wi-Fi), VPN (SonicWall), and Hyper-V environments.
  • Access Control: Manage application access and ensure compliance with security requirements.
  • Documentation & Training: Maintain IT asset records, SOPs, and deliver user training.
  • Project Participation: Support M&A IT integrations, office relocations, and new technology deployments.


Required Skills & Experience

  • 3–5 years in IT support (Level 2 or onsite).
  • Strong knowledge of Microsoft 365 administration, Azure AD, and Exchange Online.
  • Experience with endpoint management (Intune, Endpoint Central) and automated software distribution.
  • Proficiency in Windows 10/11, Windows Server 2016/2019, and Hyper-V.
  • Networking fundamentals: DNS, DHCP, VPN, routing, Wi-Fi (Aruba/Ruckus).
  • Familiarity with ITSM tools (ServiceNow, Jira, ManageEngine).
  • Exposure to ISO 27001 audits/compliance.
  • Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills.


Preferred Skills

  • Experience in hybrid or multi-site environments.
  • Knowledge of cybersecurity frameworks and vulnerability management.
  • Scripting/automation (PowerShell).
  • Familiarity with ITIL 4 principles.


Certifications (Preferred)

  • ITIL 4 Foundation
  • Microsoft 365 Administrator / Modern Desktop Administrator
  • Azure or AWS Cloud Administration
  • CompTIA A+ or Cybersecurity certifications (ISACA, SANS, EC-Council)


What We Offer

  • Opportunity to support a global organization with growth potential.
  • Access to training and professional development.
  • Collaborative, innovation-driven culture.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

At Axross, we build advanced AI-powered HVAC solutions to optimize energy efficiency in

industries such as pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and precision manufacturing. Our

cutting-edge systems help manufacturers better control their production environments while

reducing energy consumption, leading to significant cost reductions and supporting

environmental sustainability.

Role Overview

As an IoT Engineer, you will play a vital role in deploying and maintaining our AI-driven HVAC

solutions onsite. Your responsibilities will include ensuring that our equipment is properly

installed, well-maintained, and functioning effectively. You will address client concerns, perform

onsite repairs, and coordinate closely with our software and technical teams to ensure seamless

integration of hardware and software.

This role also involves testing and validating our in-house apps and software to ensure optimal

performance. We are looking for a Junior IoT Engineer who is passionate about IoT technology,

enjoys problem-solving, and thrives in a collaborative environment. Your work will contribute

directly to creating sustainable solutions that enhance system performance, improve energy

efficiency, and deliver value to our clients.

\ Key Responsibilities:

  • IoT System Development:

○ Design, develop, and test IoT applications for connected HVAC systems.

○ Write and maintain software in Python, C, or C++ for IoT devices and edge

computing.

  • Device Integration:

○ Collaborate with hardware engineers to integrate sensors, actuators, and other

peripherals into IoT systems.

○ Address operating system-level tasks, including driver/kernel development and

hardware-software interfacing.

  • Communication Protocols:

○ Implement and optimize IoT communication protocols like MQTT, HTTP, and

CoAP.

○ Ensure secure and efficient data transmission between IoT devices and cloud or

on-premises systems.

  • System Monitoring & Troubleshooting:

○ Debug and resolve hardware and software issues, including network

communication problems and memory leaks.

○ Monitor and maintain IoT systems to ensure high availability and scalability.

  • Collaboration & Documentation:

○ Work closely with software developers, hardware engineers, and AI specialists

to develop integrated solutions.

○ Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for IoT systems, protocols,

and configurations.

\ Requirements:

  • Education:

○ Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, or a related field.

  • Technical Skills:

○ Proficiency in programming languages like Python, C, C++.

○ Familiarity with IoT communication protocols (e.g., MQTT, HTTP, BLE) and cloud

platforms (e.g., AWS IoT, Azure IoT).

○ Experience with Linux systems, Docker, and embedded programming.

○ Understanding of networking concepts (TCP/UDP) and debugging tools (e.g.,

GDB, tcpdump, valgrind).

  • Problem-Solving:

○ Strong analytical and troubleshooting skills to identify and resolve IoT system

issues.

  • Soft Skills:

○ Excellent communication skills and the ability to work effectively in a

collaborative, dynamic environment.

○ Eagerness to learn and stay updated on new IoT technologies and industry

trends.

Preferred Attributes

  • Hands-on experience with industrial hardware and IoT security best practices.
  • Familiarity with REST APIs, data management, and cybersecurity in IoT systems.
  • Exposure to cloud platform integrations and scalable IoT solution design.
  • Opportunities to work on impactful AI-driven IoT projects in a cutting-edge industry.
  • Mentorship and career growth in IoT development and integration.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment with exposure to high-profile clients.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and professional development opportunities.\ \ What We Offer:
  • Opportunities to work on impactful AI-driven IoT projects in a cutting-edge industry.
  • Mentorship and career growth in IoT development and integration.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment with exposure to high-profile clients.
  • Competitive salary, benefits, and professional development opportunities.

We think you also hate when travel app is giving you a headache, right? A slight misinformation can ruin the trip.

That is exactly what we are tackling as t-fam! Making sure that our 50+ million users have the best experience in crafting their own adventure.

Your Main Duties In Flying With Us

Customer Insight & Analytics

  • Monitor and analyze end-to-end CS metrics (CSAT, automation rate, CTB, FCR, SLA, volume, escalations) across all channels
  • Detect performance shifts early, diagnose root causes, and explain the “why” behind the numbers
  • Translate VoC (Voice of Customer) and operational data into clear, actionable insights and recommendations

Performance Tracking & Reporting

  • Build and maintain dashboards and regular reporting for CS performance, trends, and risks
  • Deliver concise weekly and ad-hoc insights to management, focusing on impact and implications, not just metrics
  • Ensure data accuracy, consistency, and clarity across all reporting outputs

Operational & Cross-Functional Enablement

  • Partner with other CX Departments, Operations, Product, and Technology to turn insights into prioritized improvement actions
  • Support root-cause analysis, solution validation, and post-implementation impact tracking
  • Identify process inefficiencies and automation opportunities using data

People & Team Leadership

  • Structure team roles, manage workload, and set clear expectations for analytical quality
  • Coach and develop team members through regular feedback and performance reviews
  • Build a collaborative, insight-driven team culture focused on problem-solving and stakeholder value

What We’re Looking For

Education & Experience:

  • Bachelor’s degree in a STEM discipline such as Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Data Science, or related quantitative fields
  • 3–5 years of relevant experience in analytics, insights, business intelligence, or performance analysis roles
  • Prior experience in Customer Experience, Customer Service, or Operations environments is a strong advantage
  • Experience in tech-driven or data-intensive industries (e.g. e-commerce, travel tech, marketplace, fintech) is preferred

Skills & Competencies

Analytical & Technical Skills:

  • Strong hands-on ability to query data using SQL to extract, analyze, and validate performance metrics
  • Comfortable working directly with raw or semi-structured data to investigate issues and identify root causes
  • Experience building and maintaining dashboards, reports, and analytical views for operational monitoring
  • Ability to translate analytical findings into clear, practical insights and recommendations for non-technical stakeholders

Ways of Working

  • Highly data-driven, detail-oriented, and consistently on top of key metrics and performance movements
  • Proactive in spotting anomalies, asking the right questions, and following through until root causes are clear
  • Able to collaborate effectively with Operations, Product, and Technology teams to drive impact from data

In the event that you haven’t received any updates after 3 weeks, your data will be kept and we may contact you for another career destination. Meanwhile, discover more about tiket.com on Instagram, LinkedIn, or YouTube.

PIPECARE Group is currently looking for EMAT Data Analyst to join our team in Jakarta Office.

By providing technology and service focused solutions to the international arena of the oil and gas industry, the PIPECARE Group of companies has been helping our customers ensure the integrity of their pipeline and facility assets for over 20 years. Due to our global focus and international growth, PIPECARE is seeking experienced UT/UTCD Integrity Engineer [Level 3] to support our continued growth.

The selected candidate will be working with our project execution teams to ensure the timely and accurate reporting of in-line inspection results, with a focus on our custom-tailored reporting solutions to satisfy our customers’ needs. This includes the review of customer requirement specifications, processing of in-line inspection data, the analysis and identification of pipeline features and anomalies within processed data sets, application of industry accepted anomaly assessment criteria, ensuring the quality and accuracy of the final results, and compiling the results of our inspection activities in a concise, comprehensive custom tailored report for our customers.

Industry/sector: Oil & Gas / In Line Inspection services

Qualification: Certification in EMAT technology [Level 3]

Min years of experience: minimum last 15+ years working as EMAT Data Analyst

Other requirements: solution – oriented attitude; hands on approach; disciplined; team player; self-motivated

Responsibilities include:

  • Checking and approving the tool performance during the PTT
  • Checking the data quality of ILI runs
  • EMAT Data Analysis (Valid or expired ASNT LIII or LII Certificate)
  • Checking and implementing dig verification task at sites and preparing relevant reports
  • Reviewing the software inter phase
  • Reviewing software user manuals
  • Preparing/Reviewing DAD quality documentation
  • To ensure accurate tool sensitivity values are provided to TM in Tool Checklist
  • To prepare a specific Run assessment report
  • To identify obstructions in the pipeline.
  • To produce technically valid Preliminary / Final report
  • To inform HO-DAD about the results and/or to implement the results into the reports
  • To ensure that the coordinates are synchronized with the data
  • To alert the R&D regarding software problems
  • To update the documentation
  • To produce and update standard quality procedures
  • To alert the DA Team Leader / DA Manager regarding software problems
  • Execute all other tasks as requested by DA Team Leader or DA Manager and/or Executive Team within the assigned job role

Qualified Candidates will possess:

  • College degree in engineering or related fields.
  • Database development and implementation experience.
  • Process analysis, requirement / functional specification development experience.
  • Quality assurance of databases, reporting experience.
  • Experience of working on large, complex and multiple databases
  • Proficient in using analytical tools and instruments, for instance Excel, Microsoft Access, Minitab and SPSS
  • High ability to work with numbers.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills.
  • Analytical mind which can process information logically
  • Professional level of English language

Job requirements:

  • Ability to work for extended periods of time in a stationary position at computers and workstations
  • Ability to pass vision acuity and color differentiation examinations
  • Business travel may be required for internal training, internal meetings, site visits, and customer meetings [international travel may be required]
  • Ability to work flexible hours based on business and project needs
  • Ability to work either independently or within a team to ensure project success

Physical and Mental Requirements:

  • Lifting and Carrying: Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds
  • Mobility: Must be able to walk and climb to perform duties, including maneuvering within a refinery or plant environment and accessing elevated platforms via ladders and stairwells
  • Communication: Sufficient clarity of speech and hearing, or other communication capabilities, to communicate effectively
  • Focus and Multitasking: Ability to maintain focus and multitask effectively
  • Safety Equipment: Must be able to wear safety equipment as required by the safety department for personal protection, if/where needed in manufacturing environments.
  • Personal Mobility and Reflexes: Sufficient personal mobility and physical reflexes, with or without reasonable accommodations, to perform office duties and travel to off-site locations when necessary

About PIPECARE Group:

PIPECARE Group offers comprehensive In-Line Inspection Services to identify and size pipeline threats, Utilizing advanced technologies such as Magnetic Flux Leakage, Transverse Field Inspection, Ultrasound, and specialized tools, PIPECARE ensures precise detection and assessment of various pipeline anomalies.

What we do:

In-Line Inspection Services

PIPECARE provides In-Line Inspection Services to locate, identify, and size threats, supporting integrity management requirements.

Check out our AI Technology and other cutting-edge technologies by clicking the following YouTube Links:

PIPECARE Group - YouTube

SMART AI CALIPER - Inspection Experience Like Never Before

Inspection Technologies

Magnetic Flux Leakage (MFL): Detects and sizes general corrosion and metal loss anomalies, especially circumferentially oriented.

Transverse Field Inspection (TFI): Detects and sizes general corrosion and metal loss anomalies, primarily axially oriented.

Ultrasound (UT): Detects and sizes general and other metal loss anomalies with high depth sizing accuracy.

Ultrasonic Crack Detection: Detects and sizes cracks and colonies of cracks.

Caliper (Geometry): Detects and sizes deviations in the ideal circular shape of a pipeline (dents, ovalities, wrinkles, etc.).

Specialized Tools and Technologies

Combo Tools: Use multiple measurement systems in various combinations.

Specialized Tubing Technologies: Designed for Furnace and Downhole Operations.

Are you a dynamic individual that is passionate about driving business planning excellence and cross-functional collaboration? We are seeking a Business Planning Manager to join our team, where you will play a pivotal role in aligning strategy, forecasting, and commercial operations to achieve outstanding business results.

Key Responsibilities

  • Promotion Planning: Develop and manage promotion quantities and plans, ensuring alignment with commercial objectives.
  • Launch Planning: Collaborate with Marketing and other stakeholders to execute successful product launches, with accountability for launch pipe sizing and seamless cross-functional coordination.
  • Forecast Construction: Lead and embed robust business planning processes, guaranteeing a customer-centric and data-driven commercial forecast.

  • Customer Centricity: Serve as a critical stakeholder in delivering best-in-class forecast accuracy and bias reduction at the customer level.

YOU HAVE...

  • Min. 5 years of experience in business planning, RGM, commercial forecasting, or a related field.
  • Strong analytical skills with the ability to anticipate risks and identify growth opportunities.
  • Proven ability to drive cross-functional collaboration and alignment.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Customer-centric mindset and a drive for continuous improvement.

YOU ARE...

  • Entrepreneurial. Every single day, you spot opportunities to shake things up and change the world for the better.
  • Adventurous. You'll embrace challenges and changes with fire in your belly and a great big smile on your face
  • Open. To new ways of doing things. To other people's (sometimes crazy) ideas.
  • Respectful. Whether you're talking to our internal or external stakeholders, consumers, you treat everyone the same
  • Ambitious. You crave for success and we'll support you all the way.
  • Only Human. You'll screw up sometimes but you have no fear of failure because you're smart enough to learn from mistakes.
  • You. You're real. And you're true to yourself. We cherish and celebrate diversity so you'll feel right at home whoever you are

About The Role

Blibli is transforming into a future-ready digital ecosystem where trust, innovation, and care define how we work and grow together. As we continue building better experiences for customers and sellers, our operational excellence behind the scenes is just as critical — starting from the spaces where our people work every day.

Within the Operations team, we ensure that every process, facility, and infrastructure supports speed, reliability, and quality. Our physical workspaces play an essential role in enabling collaboration, productivity, and employee well-being.

As a Property Operations Officer (MEP Engineer) , you will be responsible for managing and improving critical mechanical systems — including HVAC and utilities — across Blibli’s facilities. Your expertise will help create safe, comfortable, and efficient environments where Bliblioneers can perform at their best. By ensuring our facilities meet the highest standards of safety, quality, and reliability, you directly contribute to the success of our people and the company’s ongoing transformation.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop project plans, budgets, and mechanical designs for HVAC and utility systems.
  • Plan and manage MEP projects to ensure safe, comfortable, and reliable working environments.
  • Lead projects end-to-end, ensuring facilities comply with safety regulations and quality standards.
  • Ensure all mechanical and utility systems operate reliably to support daily business activities.
  • Act as a technical partner for internal stakeholders, providing engineering expertise to support operational needs.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and external vendors to ensure facilities effectively meet organizational requirements.
  • Enforce company standards, procedures, and safety policies across all properties.
  • Identify improvement opportunities in facility systems to enhance efficiency, safety, and sustainability.

What You’ll Bring to the Team

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree (S1/S2) in Mechanical Engineering.
  • Minimum 3 years of experience managing MEP (Mechanical, Electrical, Plumbing) projects, with a strong focus on safety and quality.
  • Strong collaboration skills and the ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD or equivalent design software.
  • Strong working knowledge of Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, PowerPoint) and basic understanding of Microsoft Project.
  • High sense of ownership with a people-first approach to facility operations.
  • Experience handling warehouse or retail store projects is a strong advantage.

Why You’ll Love Working Here

We believe growth happens where people feel safe to share ideas, learn from mistakes, and try again. At Blibli, you’ll work alongside supportive teammates, thoughtful leaders, and meaningful challenges that help you grow professionally. Whether you’re improving facilities or enabling better work environments, this is a place where your expertise matters — and where we continue growth, transforming together.

Who are we?

Amar Bank is one of the most technologically advanced digital banks in Indonesia. Our leading

digital lending product, Tunaiku has the distinction of being the first FinTech product in

Indonesia. We are also the first digital bank on the cloud. As the first profitable digital bank, we

managed to get listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange.

How did we manage to do that?

We are changing people’s perception of a bank. We believe we are the innovators who combine

customer focus principles with creating technology-based impact. We incorporate freedom and

flexibility as part of our startup working culture DNA to encourage innovation in creating better

financial solutions for the banking industry. We think of ourselves as, ‘A technology company

with a banking license’. For this reason, we ‘Act like a FinTech, and think like a Bank.’

How did it all start?

Founded on March 15, 1991, in Surabaya as PT Anglomas International Bank (Amin Bank), the

bank was acquired by Tolaram Group and transformed to PT Bank Amar Indonesia (Amar Bank)

in 2014. It has then undergone a significant digital transformation to become one of the

country's forerunning fintech institutions through its award-winning digital lending platform,

Tunaiku.

Our philosophy, mission, and vision

Technology must impact lives, must improve lives. We exist to provide banking to those who

‘need’ and not only to those who ‘want’. Services when provided to those who need at the time

of their need brings smiles. Our vision is to bring 200 million smiles.

More About The Bank With Startup Culture Environment

Consist of 1000+ people, you will meet people who love to grow, dream big, and actually have

fun at the workplace! We provide a great working environment that pushes people to grow

outside their comfort zone. People with high drive and ambition find us a very attractive place to

work as their career growth matches their own drive and not any staid policies. Thus we hold

the honor of being awarded “Best Place to Work in Indonesia”.

Recently Amar Bank was awarded as Inspirational Brand from APEA (Asia Pacific Enterprise

Awards) 2022. Of course, our innovation won't stop here. So if you would love to be a part of it,

have a growth mindset, and are constantly hungry for challenges, we invite you to join us in our

journey to ‘Impact Lives’.

Join us today and create #unlimitedinnovations!

This role focuses on improving operational efficiency, data accuracy, and control reliability through automation and process improvements. The ideal candidate is comfortable working with data, systems, and cross-functional teams to simplify complex workflows and reduce manual effort.


Responsibilities:

  • Design, develop, and maintain automation solutions to support finance and operational processes
  • Analyze existing workflows to identify inefficiencies, manual activities, and improvement opportunities

  • Contribute to continuous improvement initiatives by proactively proposing and implementing solutions

  • Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Finance, Accounting, or a related field
  • Minimum 2–4 years of relevant experience in automation, data operations, finance operations, reconciliation, audit, or process improvement roles
  • Hands-on experience building or maintaining automation solutions using at least one of the following: Google Apps Script, Python, or SQL
  • Strong analytical and logical thinking skills with high attention to data accuracy and validation
  • Experience working with large, complex, or high-volume datasets
  • Comfortable working independently in a fast-paced and evolving environment
  • Strong communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams
  • Fluent in English (oral and written)

  • Solve Meaningful Problems: Work on real-world challenges in safety, compliance, and operations that have a measurable impact on our customers’ businesses and the well-being of their employees.
  • Thrive in a Supportive Culture: Be part of a small, collaborative engineering team where your ideas are heard, your contributions matter, and your growth is supported.

Ideal Profile

Skills You'll Need

To succeed in this role, you'll bring strong technical skills, a problem-solving mindset, and a passion for building great software:

  • Proven Experience in C# and .NET Core: You’re comfortable building and maintaining APIs and backend services using modern .NET technologies.
  • RESTful API Development: You have a solid understanding of API design principles and experience integrating and consuming APIs in real-world applications.
  • Database Proficiency: You can write efficient SQL queries and work with relational databases to ensure data integrity and performance.
  • Version Control Mastery: You’re confident with Git-based workflows and understand how to collaborate effectively through pull requests and code reviews.
  • Bonus – Search Experience: Familiarity with Solr or other search technologies is a plus, but not required.
  • Strong Communication & Collaboration: You’re comfortable discussing technical trade-offs, breaking down complex problems, and working across functions to deliver high-quality solutions.

What's On Offer

  • Excellent career development opportunities
  • Work within a company with a solid track record of success
  • Attractive salary & benefits

  • Mengembangkan rencana penanganan menggunakan metode kimia, biologis, atau teknologi (misalnya precision weeding) untuk menjaga tanaman bebas dari hama dan gulma.
  • Mengevaluasi dan meningkatkan kualitas benih.
  • Menyusun jadwal penanaman dan irigasi, serta membuat anggaran dan timeline kerja.
  • Mencatat informasi terkait pertumbuhan tanaman dan kondisi lingkungan.

  • Detail-oriented, eager to learn, and proactive in supporting project tasks.
  • Clear written and verbal communication.
  • Able to work collaboratively within a team.

PT Softorb Technology Indonesia (STI) adalah perusahaan Teknologi Informasi yang berdiri sejak 2005 dan berfokus pada solusi Smart Card dan RFID. Kami telah terlibat dalam berbagai proyek besar seperti JakLingko, KCI, MRT Jakarta, LRT Jakarta, TransJakarta, Bank DKI, Bank Mandiri, Jasa Marga, dan banyak lainnya.

PIPECARE is currently looking for Senior Project Manager .

The general role for Senior PM includes managing the PIPECARE operational projects at corporate office and PIPECARE subsidiaries. PIPECARE operational projects involve (but not limited to) the mobilization of the resource to the Oil & Gas fields, servicing the Oil & Gas pipelines, arranging field surveys and field verifications, demobilization of equipment upon completion and Reporting. The candidate will lead a project team, producing, executing, and controlling the project budget.

Job Functions, Responsibilities & Authorities:

  • Prepare, sign and submit pigging report, daily report and other relevant reports to Project Manager
  • Discuss equipment and tools requirements including auxiliaries, AGM's, DGPS, magnets, launching trays, spares, tool box and all other required tools for use in the field, etc
  • Report non-compliances, near-misses, etc
  • Attend safety and technical and professional development courses / trainings
  • Study and analyze project information document, operation manuals, pigging procedures and other project-related documents
  • Establish professional contact with client’s field personnel creating friendly working relations
  • Manage and develop the team to execute field work in a safe, effective and efficient manner in line with time, resource and financial planning
  • Attend safety and technical and professional development courses / trainings
  • Study and analyze project information document, operation manuals, pigging procedures and other project-related documents
  • Establish professional contact with client’s field personnel creating friendly working relations
  • Manage and develop the team to execute field work in a safe, effective and efficient manner in line with time, resource and financial planning
  • Is authorized to stop execution of any work at site if it is unsafe or may create unsafe work conditions
  • Coordinate field activities between PIPECARE team, subcontractor, client and other involved parties
  • Visit client’s sites (site kick-off meetings, field surveys, risk assessment review meetings, etc.)
  • Execute all other tasks as requested by POM and/or Executive Team within the assigned job role

Skills/Experience:

  • Degree in Engineering (Mechanical or relevant) plus 5 years of operation planning experience
  • Experience in Oil and Gas sector, preferably with ILI exposure
  • Computer skills in Microsoft word, excel and outlook at an intermediate level
  • Fluency in English, the language of the Territory is an advantage
  • Ability to travel extensively

Physical and Mental Requirements:

  • Lifting and Carrying: Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds
  • Mobility: Must be able to walk and climb to perform duties, including maneuvering within a refinery or plant environment and accessing elevated platforms via ladders and stairwells
  • Communication: Sufficient clarity of speech and hearing, or other communication capabilities, to communicate effectively
  • Focus and Multitasking: Ability to maintain focus and multitask effectively
  • Safety Equipment: Must be able to wear safety equipment as required by the safety department for personal protection, if/where needed in manufacturing environments.
  • Personal Mobility and Reflexes: Sufficient personal mobility and physical reflexes, with or without reasonable accommodations, to perform office duties and travel to off-site locations when necessary

About PIPECARE Group:

PIPECARE Group offers comprehensive In-Line Inspection Services to identify and size pipeline threats, Utilizing advanced technologies such as Magnetic Flux Leakage, Transverse Field Inspection, Ultrasound, and specialized tools, PIPECARE ensures precise detection and assessment of various pipeline anomalies.

What we do:

In-Line Inspection Services

PIPECARE provides In-Line Inspection Services to locate, identify, and size threats, supporting integrity management requirements.

Check out our AI Technology and other cutting-edge technologies by clicking the following YouTube Links:

PIPECARE Group - YouTube

SMART AI CALIPER - Inspection Experience Like Never Before

Inspection Technologies

Magnetic Flux Leakage (MFL): Detects and sizes general corrosion and metal loss anomalies, especially circumferentially oriented.

Transverse Field Inspection (TFI): Detects and sizes general corrosion and metal loss anomalies, primarily axially oriented.

Ultrasound (UT): Detects and sizes general and other metal loss anomalies with high depth sizing accuracy.

Ultrasonic Crack Detection: Detects and sizes cracks and colonies of cracks.

Caliper (Geometry): Detects and sizes deviations in the ideal circular shape of a pipeline (dents, ovalities, wrinkles, etc.).

Specialized Tools and Technologies

Combo Tools: Use multiple measurement systems in various combinations.

Specialized Tubing Technologies: Designed for Furnace and Downhole Operations.

descriptionHtml:
Deskripsi Pekerjaan

  • Memastikan strategi TI dan praktik tata kelola TI selaras dengan tujuan bisnis dan arah strategis perusahaan.
  • Mendukung pengembangan dan implementasi framework, kebijakan, serta prosedur tata kelola TI sesuai dengan kebutuhan bisnis dan regulasi.
  • Mengidentifikasi, menilai, memantau, dan melaporkan risiko terkait TI, termasuk risiko keamanan informasi, operasional, dan kepatuhan.
  • Membantu memantau implementasi strategi TI serta mengukur kinerja TI menggunakan metrik dan Key Performance Indicators (KPI) yang telah ditetapkan.
  • Memastikan proses TI mematuhi regulasi yang berlaku, standar industri, serta ketentuan hukum (ISO 27001, PDP, GDPR, dan lainnya).
  • Melakukan monitoring dan audit internal tata kelola TI, termasuk tindak lanjut atas temuan dan tindakan perbaikan.
  • Menyusun laporan yang akurat dan tepat waktu terkait tata kelola TI, risiko, kepatuhan, dan kinerja untuk kebutuhan internal maupun regulator.
  • Berkolaborasi dengan tim TI dan departemen lain untuk memastikan pelaksanaan inisiatif tata kelola TI berjalan efektif.

Persyaratan

  • Pendidikan minimal S1 di bidang Sistem Informasi, Ilmu Komputer, atau bidang terkait.
  • Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 1 tahun di bidang IT Governance, IT Risk, IT Audit, Information Security, atau area terkait.
  • Memahami framework dan standar tata kelola TI seperti ISO 27001, COBIT, TOGAF, dan ITIL.
  • Memahami regulasi pemerintah dan ketentuan perlindungan data (PDP, GDPR, dan regulasi sejenis).
  • Memiliki pengetahuan dasar mengenai konsep dan solusi keamanan siber (WAF, Firewall, XDR, OWASP, Vulnerability Assessment, Disaster Recovery).
  • Memiliki literasi data dan kemampuan analitis yang baik untuk keperluan monitoring, pelaporan, dan dukungan pengambilan keputusan.

descriptionHtml:
Who are we?

Amar Bank is one of the most technologically advanced digital banks in Indonesia. Our leading

digital lending product, Tunaiku has the distinction of being the first FinTech product in

Indonesia. We are also the first digital bank on the cloud. As the first profitable digital bank, we

managed to get listed on the Indonesian Stock Exchange.

How did we manage to do that?

We are changing people’s perception of a bank. We believe we are the innovators who combine

customer focus principles with creating technology-based impact. We incorporate freedom and

flexibility as part of our startup working culture DNA to encourage innovation in creating better

financial solutions for the banking industry. We think of ourselves as, ‘A technology company

with a banking license’. For this reason, we ‘Act like a FinTech, and think like a Bank.’

How did it all start?

Founded on March 15, 1991, in Surabaya as PT Anglomas International Bank (Amin Bank), the

bank was acquired by Tolaram Group and transformed to PT Bank Amar Indonesia (Amar Bank)

in 2014. It has then undergone a significant digital transformation to become one of the

country's forerunning fintech institutions through its award-winning digital lending platform,

Tunaiku.

Our philosophy, mission, and vision

Technology must impact lives, must improve lives. We exist to provide banking to those who

‘need’ and not only to those who ‘want’. Services when provided to those who need at the time

of their need brings smiles. Our vision is to bring 200 million smiles.

More About The Bank With Startup Culture Environment

Consist of 1000+ people, you will meet people who love to grow, dream big, and actually have

fun at the workplace! We provide a great working environment that pushes people to grow

outside their comfort zone. People with high drive and ambition find us a very attractive place to

work as their career growth matches their own drive and not any staid policies. Thus we hold

the honor of being awarded “Best Place to Work in Indonesia”.

Recently Amar Bank was awarded as Inspirational Brand from APEA (Asia Pacific Enterprise

Awards) 2022. Of course, our innovation won't stop here. So if you would love to be a part of it,

have a growth mindset, and are constantly hungry for challenges, we invite you to join us in our

journey to ‘Impact Lives’.

Join us today and create #unlimitedinnovations!

Responsibilities

  • Develop and maintain high-quality native Android applications using Kotlin and Jetpack libraries
  • Collaborate with designers to ensure technical feasibility and a smooth user experience
  • Integrate with backend services and APIs efficiently and securely
  • Ensure application performance, responsiveness, and stability across devices and OS versions
  • Write clean, maintainable, and testable code with attention to scalability and reliability
  • Identify and fix bugs, optimize performance, and improve application architecture
  • Stay up-to-date with the latest Android technologies and development trends


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field (or equivalent experience)
  • 3 - 4 years of experience in Android Kotlin development
  • Strong understanding of Android SDK, Jetpack Components, MVVM architecture
  • Experience with RESTful APIs, Retrofit, and dependency injection
  • Familiarity with version control (Git) and CI/CD processes
  • Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to work independently in a fast-paced environment
  • Experience in modular app architecture or multi-module projects is a plus


Bonus Point If

  • Speaking English fluently
  • Contributions to open-source projects (A link to GitHub profile)
  • Experienced in domain-driven or high-volume transaction development
  • Have knowledge and experience in mobile iOS development


We exist to innovate and maintain the architecture of Amar Bank's products. As part of our main focus to create through technology we ensure the process and technology we use helps maintain and build human connection at scale.

It’s our job to plan, monitor, and control the technology growth so we can provide a faster, more convenient, and more efficient way of performing business transactions.

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

descriptionHtml:
Deskripsi Pekerjaan

Mendorong praktik terbaik dalam penulisan kode, pengujian, observability, dan keandalan sistem. Menjaga standar keunggulan teknis, keamanan, serta efisiensi biaya untuk membangun sistem backend yang skalabel.

Mempelajari dan memelihara server, database, serta logika bisnis yang mendukung fungsi dan fitur pada platform website penjualan mobil bekas.

Menjadi point of contact utama bagi Product Manager, Arsitek, Desainer, dan stakeholder lainnya. Menerjemahkan kebutuhan bisnis menjadi solusi teknis yang layak dijalankan.

Merancang dan mengimplementasikan API (Application Programming Interface) yang efisien untuk memastikan komunikasi lancar antara frontend dan backend, serta dengan pihak eksternal seperti sistem pembayaran dan layanan lainnya.

Melakukan pengujian dan debugging secara rutin untuk memastikan keamanan, stabilitas, dan performa optimal aplikasi backend, sekaligus mengoptimalkan kinerja agar memberikan pengalaman pengguna yang baik di platform penjualan mobil bekas.

Melakukan code review dan memberikan feedback konstruktif.

Membimbing dan mengembangkan tim developer dalam menyelesaikan masalah teknis yang kompleks.

Persyaratan

Gelar Sarjana dari universitas terkemuka, diutamakan jurusan Teknik Informatika/Sistem Informasi/Teknik Komputer/Manajemen Informatika atau bidang terkait dengan IPK minimal 3,00.

Pengalaman kerja 4 tahun di bidang terkait, dengan minimal 1-2 tahun pengalaman di posisi senior.

Memiliki pengetahuan yang kuat tentang prinsip rekayasa perangkat lunak dan design pattern.

Familiar dengan platform cloud (AWS), termasuk layanan inti untuk komputasi, penyimpanan, dan basis data.

Berpengalaman dalam teknologi kontainerisasi dan orkestrasi (Docker, Kubernetes).

Memiliki pengalaman langsung dengan pipeline CI/CD.

Familiar dengan arsitektur event-driven dan message broker.

Berpengalaman menggunakan alat monitoring dan observability sistem (DataDog, New Relic).

Memiliki pengalaman solid dalam merancang dan membangun RESTful API atau GraphQL serta bekerja dengan arsitektur microservices.

Menguasai minimal salah satu bahasa backend utama (Java, NodeJS, atau PHP).

Memiliki kemampuan analitis dan interpersonal yang baik.Bersedia bekerja di kantor (lokasi: Jakarta).
