descriptionHtml:
Responsibilities

  • Lead the research and development of new fitness supplement products based on market trends, customer needs, and company goals.
  • Design and execute product formulations in various formats (powder, capsule, tablet, RTD, etc.), including sourcing and testing of raw materials.
  • Oversee lab-scale and pilot-scale trials, ensuring alignment with quality, taste, texture, solubility, and stability targets.
  • Collaborate closely with QC, Production, Regulatory, and Marketing teams to ensure successful commercialization.
  • Evaluate and approve new ingredients based on scientific data, supplier documentation, and regulatory compliance.
  • Manage and improve existing product formulas based on customer feedback, cost optimization, or regulation updates.
  • Lead technical presentations, internal product training, and provide R&D insights for brand storytelling or marketing materials.
  • Monitor trends and competitor products to propose innovative product concepts and ensure company stays ahead in the market.
  • Ensure all R&D documentation is accurate and audit-ready, including specifications, trial reports, and SOPs.
  • Build and manage a high-performing R&D team, fostering a culture of innovation, agility, and accountability.

Requirements

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Food Technology, Nutrition, Pharmacy, Biochemistry, or related field.
  • Minimum 5 years of proven experience in R&D, especially in the dietary supplement, nutraceutical, or functional food industry.
  • Strong understanding of supplement formulations including protein blends, BCAAs, vitamins and other active ingredients.
  • In-depth knowledge of food and supplement regulations (BPOM, Halal, GMP, HACCP) and product registration requirements.
  • Experience in product lifecycle management from concept, formulation, pilot scale-up, to market launch.
  • Skilled in analyzing ingredient functionality, product stability, sensory evaluation, and shelf-life studies.
  • Excellent leadership, project management, and cross-functional communication skills.
  • Familiarity with trends in sports nutrition, health supplements, and consumer behavior.
  • Proficient in documentation, technical writing, and preparation of dossiers for regulatory approvals.
  • Strong network with raw material suppliers, laboratories, or external research institutions is a plus.

descriptionHtml:
Before jumping into all the information about the role and what you can bring to the table, let us introduce ourselves real quick.

About Us

Insider One is the #1 platform that brings everything marketing and customer engagement teams need in one place so they can reach their peak potential and become unstoppable.

Our story began with six desks and a vision to create a single platform to make industry-first technologies and emerging channels accessible to marketers worldwide. Today, Insider One is powered by 1,500+ team members representing 50+ nationalities across 30+ offices. With AI at its core and an integrated Customer Data Platform (CDP), Insider One unites data, personalization, and journey orchestration across the most extensive set of natively supported channels, including WhatsApp, SMS, Email, Web, App, and Site Search.

We recently raised one of the largest funding rounds in the industry, a $500M Series E led by General Atlantic. We are backed by top-notch investors, including Sequoia Capital, QIA, Riverwood, and Endeavor Catalyst, and trusted by 2000+ customers from high-growth startups to the most prestigious Fortune 500 companies such as Samsung, Nike, L’Oreal, Singapore Airlines, Nestlé, Nissan, Lenovo, Puma, IKEA, Allianz, Domino's, and the list goes on.

Insider One was congratulated for becoming one of the only woman-founded, women-led B2B SaaS unicorns in the world. Loved by customers, recognized by analysts, we are the only vendor recognized as the #1 leader in all the capabilities marketing and customer engagement teams need. Don’t just take our word for it — see for yourself. We consistently outperform and continue our leadership, and the results speak for themselves.

From day one, Insider One’s mission has not only been to build a world-class product company, but also to create one of the most socially progressive technology communities in the world. Through our social responsibility initiatives like 100 Social Responsibility Projects, AI Training for Teachers, Code Academy, SheCodes, SheLeads, and SheMarkables, our community has committed to scaling its impact on our communities across 30+ countries, driving initiatives in health, education, farming, animal rights, and increasing women’s representation in STEM.

Behind all these achievements is an exceptionally talented, visionary team of overachievers that moves fast and agile, creating cutting-edge products, and focuses on making an impact. If you want to be a part of this journey, just keep reading.

First things first: What is this role about?

You’re probably expecting an eye-catching, mesmerizing job description that will sweep you off your feet, flavoured with the coolest startup jargons. After all, we’re a Sequoia-backed company, with an awarded woman CEO and a team across the globe that takes the word “diversity” very seriously. But that’s exactly why we think that nothing says more than the real experience. We’re underdogs who believe in the power of actions more than anything else. And as a customer-first company, we always walk the extra mile.

What You Will Do

  • Become an expert in Insider One products
  • Make recommendations on supporting sales strategies, integration strategies, enterprise architectures, platforms and application infrastructure required to successfully implement a complete solution, providing “best practice” advice to customers to optimize Insider effectiveness
  • Proactively monitor our partners’ activities, facilitate and provide on-time and around the clock insights and solutions to the partners
  • Provide exemplary pre-sales technical expertise through technical and product presentations, demonstrations, pilot implementations, and ongoing sales consultation
  • Lead account services strategy in generating and developing business growth opportunities, working collaboratively with product, partner success and sales teams across various product pillars to maximize business results with clients
  • Develop a deep understanding of both the customers and competitive landscape, enabling a business dialogue to be conducted with C-level contacts and their teams
  • Outstanding professional, sales, and technical capabilities; comfortable supporting both enterprise (field) and inside sales teams on targeted accounts
  • Demonstrated excellent verbal and written communication skills


What You Will Need

  • Bachelor’s Degree or higher (E.g. Marketing, Business, Psychology, Computer Science, Mathematics, Statistics, or other related field.)
  • Cherish one of our core ethoses: care. You’ll need to care for our partners and make sure they feel at home with our products and our assistance
  • Able to work under tight deadlines
  • Proven ability to learn quickly in a very fast-paced environment
  • Be a self-motivated and savvy tech bug, always in search for savvy solutions and ideas to improve our relationship with our clients
  • High energy, self-starter, be a visionary seller comfortable with ambiguity in entrepreneurial environments
  • Must be a team player - ability to interact with teammates and partners fairly, and respectfully proactive / results-driven / strong problem solving skills. Highly dependable, team player with high energy, positive attitude and with great organization and time management skills
  • Masterful in delivering software demonstrations, whether in-person, or via web presentation
  • Solid understanding of basic web concepts and digital marketing
  • Possess "best of breed" functional sales experience that could be applied across an entire sales area in general or specific functional categories


What We Offer

  • Be part of a diverse team that’s as global as it gets — where every voice is heard and 50+ nationalities build together
  • Level up with internal trainings covering AI fundamentals, coding, foreign languages, and a wide range of personal development skills
  • Feed your curiosity with access to Spotify, LinkedIn Learning, Blinkist, MasterClass, and CloudGuru
  • Become a Shareowner through our eligibility-based “ESOP” and own a piece of what you build
  • Help build the team you want to work with and enjoy rewarding referral bonuses
  • Opportunities to give back to your community through volunteering and purpose-driven social impact projects
  • From global retreats to team-building activities, expect year-round events that turn into lifelong memories


We aren't just hiring for a position; we are hiring for a mission — a mission to build a lasting legacy that will set the benchmark for the most progressive tech companies out there.

To do this, we are looking for exceptional talent to join a community of good-hearted individuals who take high ownership and are relentlessly driven to go the extra mile.

If this sounds like who you are and where you aspire to be, we are excited to meet you.

We provide equal opportunity in a zero-discrimination workplace and not just welcome but also embrace everyone without regard to sex, race, color, nationality, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, disability status, citizenship, or marital status.

Please follow Insider One on LinkedIn, Instagram, X, Facebook and Medium!

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

About the Role

This role is about enabling the Development Teams towards an environment where continuous improvement is the norm and where everyone's common goal is having fun delivering high quality valuable working software continuously.

You will work with 1-3 cross-functional agile product development teams. You are a champion of Scrum and lean principles and always strive to see big picture.

You will work closely with Engineers, product, design, people team and other stakeholders across levels, including top management, collaboratively ensuring quality gets built into the product.

What you will do

With the team:

  • Coaching the team members in self-management and cross-functionality.
  • Helping cross-functional Team focus on creating valuable incremental outcome for the business that meet the Definition of Done.
  • Work on increasing transparency around work and collaboration to help team identify and remove impediments by themselves.
  • Help the team be better at development practices to ease change.
  • Ensuring that all Scrum events take place, are productive and team can learn from it.

With the product & stakeholders:

  • Helping find techniques for effective Product Goal definition and Product Backlog management.
  • Establish and improve towards empirical product planning for a complex environment; and,
  • Facilitating stakeholder collaboration as requested or needed.

With the people team and larger organization:

  • Work to build bridges between stakeholders and Scrum Teams.
  • Work on removing or reducing impediments that prevent Scrum Teams from working well.
  • Leading, training, and coaching the organization in its Scrum adoption.
  • Planning and advising Scrum implementations within the organization.
  • Helping employees and stakeholders understand and enact an empirical approach for complex work.

What you need to have

  • Enjoy reading books.
  • Beginner's mindset: Highly curious in learning new things and applying it in practice.
  • People First mindset: Care for people and highly curious about people development, group dynamics, and coaching.
  • Hands-on experience working with multicultural team in a product development organisation 5-7 years, from either 1 of these 3 backgrounds.
  • Product development.
  • Engineering.
  • Organisation and teams transformation / Scrum Master.

Good to Have:

  • Have a solid understanding of agile principles, values, and hands-on experience implementing agile in a multi team environment preferred.
  • Banking / Fintech domain experience is preferred.
  • Software engineering / Digital Product background is preferred.
  • Exposure to Lean/XP practices (TDD, Pair Programming, Continuous Integration/Delivery for Mobile) is Preferred. At least understand the principles behind it.
  • Exposure to Lean concept and systems thinking is preferred.
  • Immediate joiners Preferred.

Who you'll work with

Multicultural teams across our Tech Hubs (Jakarta, Pune, Singapore, and more hubs to come), building Jago Digital Life Finance Solutions, integrated with one of the largest ride-hailing ecosystem in SEA (South East Asia), and many others to come.

Department: Photo

Location: Indonesia - PTAMI

Description

By applying to this position, your application will be submitted to PT Alpha Magsaysay, one of Princess Cruises official Hiring Partners based Indonesia. A recruiter from PT Alpha Magsaysay will contact you soon if your qualifications align with our requirements for this position.

As the world's leading cruise line, we understand that our guests have high expectations of us, and we have high expectations of our team members.

We appreciate your patience as we carefully review each candidate.

Set a course for adventure with Princess Cruises! The employer of choice in the cruise industry, our fleet of Love Boats offer exceptional facilities and extensive professional development and recreational programs for our valued teammates who hail from more than 60 countries around the globe.

An iconic brand beloved by millions, we love people who love what they do and work together to help our guests create a lifetime of wonderful memories while providing friendly, attentive and authentic service like only Princess can.

As a member of the Princess Family, you’ll enjoy a truly adventurous career with excellent incentives, unlimited opportunities for growth, and ports of call that will leave you breathless.

Key Responsibilities

As a Photographer onboard Princess Cruises, you’ll be part of a vibrant team dedicated to capturing the magic of each voyage. From formal evenings to casual moments around the ship, you’ll attend events and interact with guests to create lasting memories through high-quality photography.

  • You’ll be expected to consistently produce a high volume of well-composed and technically sound images that meet our brand standards. Whether working with natural light or studio setups, your ability to adapt and deliver exceptional results is key. Guest engagement is at the heart of this role — we want every photo session to be fun, relaxed, and memorable.
  • In addition to photography duties, you’ll support the PhotoStudio program by encouraging bookings and explaining the services offered. You’ll also assist in the photo gallery and shop, helping guests select and purchase their images while promoting additional products and services. Sales skills and product knowledge are essential, as is maintaining a clean, organized, and well-stocked retail space.
  • You’ll be responsible for the care and proper use of company-issued equipment, ensuring everything is maintained to the highest standards. Professional appearance is also important, wearing the correct uniform, name badge, and Cruise pin, along with excellent personal grooming, is expected at all times.
  • This role offers a unique opportunity to travel the world, meet people from diverse backgrounds, and grow your skills in photography, sales, and guest service — all while being part of an award-winning cruise experience.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

  • Previous experience as a cruise photographer highly desirable.
  • Degree in photography preferred, but most types of college certificates in photography are acceptable. MUST be able to provide proof of education and verifiable documentation showing what courses were completed and what the final grades were.
  • Hands on experience in professional photography is preferred and must be documented and provable:
  • A website or on-line portfolio that showcases the candidates work is preferred.
  • All work MUST be verifiable as their own original work.
  • A printed portfolio (in case a face-to-face interview is required) is preferred, and must be verifiable as the candidate’s original work.
  • Minimum of two years of event, portrait or wedding photography experience, including experience shooting in large event settings.
  • Demonstrated experience using professional-grade DSLR equipment and accessories
  • Demonstrated experience with studio lighting equipment, light meters and accessories preferred.
  • Intermediate to advanced Windows or Mac-based computer skills, Proficient in Microsoft Office applications, Adobe Photoshop, Illustrator or similar types of programs.
  • Photo Equipment: Nikon DSLR systems, Nikon Flash Systems, Hensel & Godox Studio Flash Systems, and related accessories. Fuji Frontier, Noritsu, and Epson commercial grade printing equipment experience preferred.

Language: Effective communication is a critical part of this job. Photo staff must be able to interact with guests in a positive, upbeat style and therefore they MUST BE FLUENT (or close to fluent) in English and be an effective communicator.

Personality: Personable communicator with outstanding social skills and a warm, friendly, and engaging personality. Ability to continuously surprise and delight guests throughout their cruise experience. Commitment to establish and maintain courteous and professional working relationships in a diverse cultural environment.

Job Benefits

Embark on a career adventure like no other! As part of the Princess Cruises team, you’ll enjoy:

  • A competitive salary package.
  • Your comfortable double cabin - your space to relax and recharge.
  • Company-paid travel to and from the ship, so you can focus on the journey ahead.
  • Access to exclusive areas and benefits onboard (depending on the rank and occupational group).
  • A vibrant recreation and welfare program designed to support your well-being and work-life balance.
  • Access to exceptional learning and development opportunities to grow your skills and advance your career.
  • The chance to travel the world, exploring exciting destinations while doing what you love.
  • A welcoming, inclusive, and dynamic work environment where your contributions are valued.

Join us and become part of a global team that’s passionate about delivering unforgettable experiences—both for our guests and for one another.

descriptionHtml:
About Us

Populix is a consumer insights platform that helps businesses connect with its database of respondents and provides them with insights to understand the preferences of Indonesian consumers better. Populix has a pool of over 1,000,000 diverse, readily accessible, and highly-qualified respondents across Indonesia. Its products range from intensive research studies to simple surveys and can be arranged on a project or subscription basis. Focusing on Indonesian consumers being super sticky to their phones, Populix facilitates a diverse range of data collection methods via its mobile app.

About The Role

We are looking for a new Qualitative Research Personnel who has a high level of self-initiative as well as a technological-savvy mindset to join our Research Team, with responsibilities to execute overall qualitative projects & being a focal person on the client-side.

What will you do:

  • Assist in the development of strong and captivating proposals to meet client needs, competitiveness, and cost-effectiveness based on short research briefs and/or elaborate Request For Proposal, including assisting with costing structure, methodological design, analytical framework, etc.
  • Write the MoM (Minute of Meetings) of kick-off or any meetings with clients
  • Prepare screeners for recruitment
  • Deliver fieldwork briefing to ensure the interviewers are clear about the purposes
  • Collaborate with the Project Manager to ensure the progress of recruitment is well communicated and monitored
  • Design discussion guides to ensure they prompt meaningful findings and are actionable
  • Provide moderation for basic qualitative methodologies, such as focus groups and in-depth interviews
  • Convert the interview's verbatim to Content Grid and create the Content Analysis of the interview
  • Consult with Research Manager (Questionnaire Design, Analysis, Reporting, & Writing).
  • Manage multiple projects simultaneously
  • Reporting to a project lead, you will be responsible for the successful execution of customized qualitative studies, including project costing questionnaire design, project management, execution, analysis, and report writing

What will you need:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in a Qualitative Consumer Insights role
  • Proficient English Language Application for oral & written
  • Minimum Bachelor's in Psychology/Sociology/Social Anthropology or in other related fields
  • Up to date with Qualitative research methods, knowledge, and techniques
  • Knowledge and understanding of online market research is an advantage
  • Experienced in project management and research proposals.

Behavior skills that you will need:

  • Strong analytical skills
  • Good communication and interpersonal skills as needed to closely work with remote teams spread in multiple locations
  • Good in presentation

descriptionHtml:
About the Role

We are looking for a GA & IT Support Manager to manage day-to-day general affairs and basic IT support operations across the organization. This role is critical in ensuring company assets, documentation, facilities, and IT equipment are well managed, properly recorded, and reliably available to support employee productivity.

This position suits someone who is hands-on, organized, and operationally strong, with experience managing company assets and providing basic IT support without needing deep engineering expertise.

What You Will DoGeneral Affairs & Asset Management

  • Manage and maintain company asset records, including laptops, peripherals, office equipment, and other operational assets.

  • Ensure accurate asset documentation, tagging, tracking, and handover processes.

  • Conduct regular stock opname and asset audits to ensure data accuracy and accountability.

  • Manage asset lifecycle processes: procurement coordination, assignment, replacement, return, and disposal.

  • Maintain proper documentation for assets, vendors, and operational records.

Laptop & IT Equipment Management

  • Oversee laptop provisioning, setup, handover, and retrieval for employees.

  • Perform basic laptop hardware diagnostics (e.g. power issues, storage, RAM, peripherals).

  • Coordinate laptop repairs, replacements, and warranty claims with vendors when needed.

  • Ensure laptops and IT equipment are properly inventoried and in good working condition.

IT Support (Basic)

  • Provide basic IT support for employees, including:

    • Network and internet connectivity troubleshooting

    • Printer, peripheral, and basic system issues

  • Support basic network setup and troubleshooting (Wi-Fi, LAN, access points).

  • Escalate complex IT issues to external vendors or specialized teams when required.

  • Coordinate with vendors for IT services, maintenance, and support contracts.

Process & Compliance

  • Develop and maintain SOPs for asset management, IT support requests, and equipment usage.

  • Ensure compliance with company policies related to asset usage, data security, and IT governance.

  • Support audits by providing accurate documentation and asset records.

Team & Vendor Coordination

  • Lead or coordinate GA and IT support staff (if applicable).

  • Manage relationships with vendors for IT equipment, internet services, and maintenance.

  • Monitor service quality, cost efficiency, and SLA compliance.

What You BringEducation & Experience

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Management, Engineering, or related field.

  • 3–6 years of experience in General Affairs, IT Support, or Office Operations roles.

  • Experience managing company assets, documentation, and stock opname processes.

Technical & Operational Skills

  • Strong experience in laptop management and asset tracking.

  • Ability to perform basic laptop hardware diagnosis and troubleshooting.

  • Basic understanding of network connectivity and IT support (non-engineering level).

  • Familiarity with asset documentation, inventory systems, or spreadsheets.

  • Comfortable using Google Workspace or similar tools for tracking and reporting.

Personal Attributes

  • Highly organized and detail-oriented.

  • Hands-on and solution-driven.

  • Able to prioritize tasks and respond quickly to operational needs.

  • Good communication skills and service mindset.

  • Able to work independently while coordinating with multiple teams.

Nice to Have

  • Experience managing IT assets in a growing or multi-location company.

  • Familiarity with ticketing systems or IT request workflows.

  • Experience coordinating with external IT vendors or service providers.

About Us

PT Anugerah Pharmindo Lestari (APL) a Zuellig Pharma company, is a leading healthcare solution in Indonesia, and our purpose is to make healthcare more accessible to the communities we serve.

We provide world-class distribution, commercialization, and clinical trial support to support the growing healthcare needs in this region. The company was started forty years ago and has grown to become a billion-dollar business covering 514 cities with over 2,500 employees.

Our people serve more than 60,000 direct and indirect medical facilities and work with over 50 clients, including the top 20 pharmaceutical companies in the world.

The purpose of an IT Specialist is responsible for maintaining, supporting, and optimizing an organization’s information technology systems to ensure smooth, secure, and efficient operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Install, configure, and maintain hardware, software, networks, and IT systems

  • Manage user accounts, access rights, and system permissionsEnsure cybersecurity best practices, including system updates and antivirus protection
  • Maintain documentation for IT procedures, systems, and configurations
  • Support IT projects, system upgrades, and new technology implementations

  • Ensure compliance with company IT policies and data protection standards

Must Have

  • At least 2 Year(s) of working experience in the related field is required for this position.
  • Required Skill(s): troubleshooting, cybersecurity best practices, data integrity, user accounts management
  • Preferably Staff (non-management & non-supervisor) specialized in IT
  • Willing to work in Sudirman, Jakarta Area

Why Join APL

  • We are committed to fostering an inclusive environment where our employees can learn, grow, and achieve shared success.
  • We champion diversity, equity, and inclusion, ensuring every individual feels valued, respected, and treated fairly.
  • As a leading multi-market healthcare solutions provider, we empower our employees to gain comprehensive knowledge and expertise in the dynamic healthcare industry across the region.
  • Enjoy the flexibility to effectively balance your work and personal life while taking charge of your career journey through our empowering growth opportunities.
  • Our Total Rewards program is designed to support your overall well-being in every aspect.

descriptionHtml:
Who are we?


Kulu is an AI startup, backed by some of the world’s leading investors including Antler (backers of Lovable and Airalo) and Redbus (backers of Cleo). We are building AI agents for software companies that run video calls with their users to get them onboarded. Imagine joining a Zoom call with an AI to help you get set up using a new piece of software - just share your screen and speak with the AI as it guides you through configuration.


Kulu is led by a rockstar founding team: Ed (CEO) - 1st PM at Teya ($1b+ valuation in 2 years) and one previous exit. Rio (CTO) - PhD in AI, specialising in computer vision. Oscar (CCO) - Former Head of Sales at multiple VC-backed companies.


Kulu has two offices: London - Commercial Office, and Bali - Product & Engineering Office. The founding team works from both locations.


Why this role exists


This role exists to own product quality and maintain exceptional standards across Kulu. This role will take a holistic view on quality. Yes you will be responsible for ensuring no bugs slip through to production however many important product issues are not strict bugs — they are moments where the experience feels confusing, unnatural, or misaligned with how real users behave in their tools and workflows. This role will take ownership of all of these areas, ensuring our product is reliable, bug-free, intuitive and suitable for our customers.


This role will systematically test the product end-to-end, try to break it, surface experiential issues, and identify capability gaps where the product cannot adequately support real-world user behaviour.


This role is based in Bali, with a relocation package available, and will start as a contract role with a clear path to full-time based on impact.


Tasks

1. Manual & exploratory QA testing


Continuously and creatively test the product by actively imagining and simulating scenarios that could break it or degrade the user experience.


This includes testing across:



  • Core user flows

  • Edge cases and failure scenario

  • Long-running or unusual usage patterns (e.g. extended sessions, repeated interactions)

  • Different configurations, tools, environments, and devices (e.g. desktop vs mobile)


You are expected to:



  • Think adversarially about how real users might use the product in unexpected ways

  • Ask “what happens if…” questions and test those scenarios in practice

  • Push the product beyond happy paths to uncover hidden weaknesses

  • Actively try to break assumptions, not just verify expected behaviour

  • Test both before and after releases to identify unintended side effects and behavioural drift


Examples include (but are not limited to):



  • Staying in a live session for extended periods

  • Asking the AI to handle complex, ambiguous, or high-stakes tasks (e.g. data migration, table or cell-level reasoning)

  • Using the product in noisy, degraded, or imperfect conditions

  • Switching devices or contexts mid-flow


2. Regression & release testing



  • Validate new features and agent capabilities before they go live

  • Re-test existing functionality after changes to ensure nothing degrades

  • Verify that previously fixed issues do not reappear in new releases


3. Clear issue reporting


Document issues in a way that makes them easy to understand and act on, including:



  • Clear reproduction steps

  • Expected vs actual behaviour

  • Supporting evidence such as screenshots, videos, logs, or audio recordings where relevant


Categorise issues clearly, for example:



  • Bug

  • Regression

  • UX / product issue

  • AI behaviour issue


Work closely with engineering and product to ensure issues are well-understood, properly scoped, and actionable.


Additional responsibility: product & AI experience quality


Alongside traditional QA work, this role helps maintain a high bar for product clarity and human-like AI behaviour.


This includes:



  • Flagging UX issues that are confusing, unclear, or unintuitive (even if technically working)

  • Testing AI behaviour for: unnatural phrasing or tone, awkward timing or interruptions, and over- or under-explanation

  • Calling out moments where “this technically works, but a real human wouldn’t do this”


Additional responsibility: capability gap discovery


While testing the product across different tools, integrations, and real-world setups, you will:



  • Observe how users in different tools typically: onboard, configure products and learn features.

  • Identify cases where our product cannot adequately support these real-world workflows

  • Document capability gaps, focusing on: The user’s real behaviour and expectations, where the product falls short, and the impact on onboarding success or usability


Capability gaps are:



  • Logged separately from bugs

  • Summarised periodically (e.g. weekly)

  • Reviewed with product leadership


Requirements

Must-have



  • Proactive, highly motivated working style

  • Ownership mindset - think of yourself as owning product quality

  • Able to work independengly and drive value for the company with minimal guidance or supervision

  • Strong attention to detail and patience

  • Strong product and UX taste

  • Curiosity and a desire to break things in realistic ways

  • Clear written and verbal communication (English and Bahasa Indonesian)

  • Ability to explain why something feels broken, confusing, or insufficient


Nice-to-have



  • QA or product testing experience

  • Experience with SaaS or AI-powered products

  • Technical literacy (but not required to code)


Benefits

We offer a competitive salary, high autonomy, and a team that moves fast and ships relentlessly.


You’ll work directly with founders + senior operators, with real ownership from Day 1.


This is not a “clock in / clock out” role. It’s a high-trust, high-output environment where we expect:



  • strong judgment

  • speed + attention to detail

  • high standards

  • deep ownership of outcomes

  • and the willingness to do whatever it takes to win


In return, you’ll get the chance to build a product that can genuinely impact millions of people, and grow your skills faster than almost anywhere else.


Our Operating Principles:



  • Always Be Hustlin’ – Move fast, outwork the competition, stay scrappy.

  • Relentlessly Curious - Reason from first principles, question assumptions and explore better ways.

  • Super Pumped – Show relentless enthusiasm and drive.

  • Make Magic – Create experiences that delight customers.

  • Obsess Over the Details – Perfect the product experience, no matter how small.

  • Big Bold Bets – Think big, take risks and go after huge, transformative opportunities.

  • Ownership is Key - Own the outcome, not just the task.


If you want to work at one of the most exciting technology companies in Bali, surrounded by A-players at the top of their game, please apply. We would love to meet you!


- Team Kulu 🚀

descriptionHtml:
About Progrez

Progrez is an IT consulting company specializing in DevOps and ITSM solutions. We are passionate about driving organizations to adapt and unlock new possibilities through innovative technology solutions. By partnering with our customers, we help them streamline their IT operations,enhance efficiency, and achieve their business goals.

At Progrez, we believe in fostering a growth oriented and collaborative environment. We encourage open communication at all levels and empower our employees to contribute their ideas and expertise. As a growing company with a team dedicated professionals, we value teamwork, continuous learning, and a shared passion for technology.

We are committed to staying at the forefront of the IT industry, constantly exploring new technologies and methodologies to deliver cutting-edge solutions to our customers. Our mission is to be a trusted advisor and partner, guiding our customers on their digital transformation journey and helping them achieve sustainable success.

Job Summary

As a Customer Applications Support, you will be responsible for handling application-related support for customers, ensuring smooth system operations and a high level of service quality. You will apply your knowledge of software and related technologies to troubleshoot issues, provide timely resolutions, and support day-to-day customer operations. Acting as Level 1 & Level 2 Support for our external customers, you will use strong problem-solving and communication skills to clearly understand customer needs, provide accurate updates, and deliver effective, high-quality solutions.

Qualifications

  • Candidates should have a Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, or a related field, with 3–5 years of relevant experience.
  • Possess strong communication skills, with the ability to clearly convey technical information to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Willing to work overtime when necessary to ensure timely and effective problem resolution.
  • Demonstrate the ability to work collaboratively as part of a team.
  • Have a strong technical foundation, with a solid understanding of data, platforms, and modern technologies.
  • A fast learner who can quickly adapt to new tools, systems, and working environments.
  • Strong knowledge of Software Development and IT Service Management (ITSM) is considered an advantage.
  • Experience or familiarity with Atlassian tools (such as Jira, Confluence, etc.) is a plus.

Responsibilities

  • Ensure all assigned tickets are monitored and resolved in accordance with agreed Service Level Agreements (SLAs).
  • Act as Level 1 Support, providing prompt responses to customer inquiries and ensuring timely and clear communication throughout the resolution process.
  • Act as Level 2 Support, performing in-depth troubleshooting, identifying root causes, and implementing temporary workarounds while delivering permanent and effective solutions.
  • Develop and maintain a Knowledge Base by documenting recurring issues, resolutions, and best practices to support continuous improvement.
  • Conduct meetings with customers to gather detailed requirements, clarify issues, and ensure the delivery of appropriate and effective solutions.
  • Manage and maintain IT assets, ensuring they are properly inventoried, securely stored, and kept in a clean and safe condition.
  • Perform post-sales support activities for external customers, including solution follow-ups, issue resolution, customer satisfaction assurance, and ongoing technical assistance.

descriptionHtml:
As one of the leading Design firms in Indonesia, we seek a dynamic and results-oriented Finance and Administrative professional with various experience in standard corporate finance and transaction services. The role is extended to the standard HR role who understands local Indonesian Employment laws and can maintain a well organised system.

We Invite Initiative, Progressive And Experienced Professionals To Join As a Member Of Our Company To Continue, Enhance And Accomplish Our Goal Of Maintaining The Architectural Design Quality And Good Administration Professionalism. The Following Position Is Stated Below

FINANCE & ACCOUNTING

Duties & Responsibilities

  • Contracts & Fee Proposals
  • Prepare detailed contracts and fee proposals in coordination with the design and management teams, ensuring alignment with project scope, timelines, deliverables, and resource allocation.
  • Billing & Invoicing
  • Generate and issue client invoices based on contract milestones, project progress, or time-billing schedules.
  • Monitor accounts receivable, ensure timely follow-ups on outstanding invoices, and coordinate closely with clients’ finance departments to ensure smooth payment processes.
  • Finance & Accounting Operations
  • Manage all daily operations and procedures related to Finance and Accounting.
  • Maintain an up-to-date, documented system of accounting policies and internal control procedures to ensure accuracy and compliance.
  • Budgeting & Financial Planning
  • Lead the preparation of the company’s annual budget and financial projections, working closely with all departments.
  • Monitor and track cash flow and expenditure, ensuring budget discipline across all functions.
  • Provide regular reports and updates to management on actual vs. budget performance.
  • Financial Analysis & Forecasting
  • Prepare and present monthly financial statements, including profit & loss, balance sheets, and cash flow reports.
  • Conduct ongoing financial analysis to assess the company’s financial condition, identify trends, and support data-driven decisions.
  • Perform short-term and long-term financial forecasting for all income streams, including project-based revenues, retainers, and additional services.
  • Tax Compliance & Reporting
  • Ensure full compliance with local and national tax regulations (e.g., VAT, withholding tax, corporate income tax).
  • Prepare, file, and manage timely tax reports and payments, in coordination with appointed tax consultants or auditors.
  • Maintain organized documentation for tax-deductible expenses, financial audits, and regulatory compliance.
  • Banking & Financial Institutions
  • Maintain strong working relationships with banking partners and financial institutions.
  • Stay updated on latest banking services, promotions, or financial products that could benefit the firm.
  • Manage day-to-day banking activities including payments, transfers, credit facilities, and reconciliations.
  • Market Awareness & Financial Updates
  • Take initiative to monitor and report on relevant financial news, economic updates, or changes in Indonesian tax laws that could impact the firm's operations or strategy.
  • Recommend adjustments or precautions in response to regulatory changes or financial risks.
  • Client & Stakeholder Coordination
  • Maintain effective communication and professional relationships with the client’s finance representatives to support billing, tax documentation, and payment coordination.
  • Respond promptly to client queries related to financial documents, payment schedules, and reporting requirements.
  • General Support & Ad-Hoc Duties
  • Perform other finance-related duties as assigned by Senior Management, External Finance Consultants, or Office Manager.
  • BOD Personal Banking & Financial Administration
  • Assist in managing banking transactions for personal purposes related to company roles (e.g., BOD travel allowance, bonuses, reimbursements).
  • Coordinate with banks and financial institutions on behalf of BOD members for personal financial matters when delegated.

Required Skills And Qualifications

Gender : Female

Age : 25 - 42 years old

Education : Preferable S1 Accounting/Business Administration from reputable university

Experience background : Min. 3 years in Finance & Administration field

Other Qualifications

  • Minimum 3 years experience in Finance & Accounting area.
  • Familiar with SAP and other accounting program
  • Outstanding computer and technical skills, strong knowledge in MS Excel, Word, Powerpoint
  • Familiar with Google Platform System (Mail, Drive, Docs, Sheet, Slides, etc) and other Online sharing platform systems.
  • Familiar to scheduling software to set up appointments, deadlines and work tasks.

Preferred Character

  • Mature, pay attention to details, display leadership qualities and behavior
  • Strong sense of setting schedule for work, finance scheduling, thinking ahead to solve potential problems or issues
  • Strong analytical skill and ability to work with tight deadline
  • Good multi-tasking skills, handle and prioritize multiple tasks at the same time
  • Able to work independently and in a team
  • Firm, accountable and good problem solving
  • Hard-working, detail oriented, well organised, fast, initiative and active
  • Cooperative and have a good communication skill
  • Command of English is a MUST
  • Has a good, humble attitude with a zest to learn and continual attitude to progression
  • Has a good, clear communication skill with related Clients and external Auditor or staff
  • Able to differientiate between confidential matters and general matters and to be private about certain confidentiality matters
  • Having experience with Architecture/Interior firms will be value added

ATI Business Group is looking for an IT Operations Specialist to support our production team on-site with daily IT operations. In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining IT infrastructure services, troubleshooting operational issues, and ensuring smooth day-to-day IT support. This position requires strong analytical skills, technical knowledge, and effective communication.

Your Main Objective

To manage and maintain daily IT operations, ensuring infrastructure services run smoothly while contributing to the execution and improvement of IT procedures, policies, and goals.

Your Main Responsibilities

  • You will handle day-to-day IT operations and maintain IT infrastructure services (LAN, WLAN, servers, firewall, CCTV, IP telephony, access door, etc.).
  • You will maintain productivity benchmarks according to the team’s minimum standards.
  • You will follow instructions and established guidelines to perform assigned tasks accurately.
  • You will ensure all work complies with the team’s standards and contribute to IT procedures and process improvements.
  • You will report issues or system limitations to your direct supervisor

Be Part of the ATI Journey

Our aim at ATI Business Group in working with our Clients is to support their continued growth by providing cost-effective technology and talented & scalable people resources on demand. ATI’s singular focus on providing services to the travel and hospitality business communities across the globe has been a remarkably successful one. Since commencing in 2002, we now have over 1,300 employees providing services to our clients worldwide.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computing, Information Technology, or a related field.
  • Excellent communication skills in both Bahasa Indonesia and English (written & spoken).
  • Proven experience and strong knowledge of networking (hardware, software, etc.).
  • Time management skills with experience handling multiple projects simultaneously.
  • Excellent analytical and numerical skills.
  • Ability to work effectively under the guidance of team leaders and collaborate with team members.
  • Nice to have: Experience with common enterprise technologies and concepts such as Campus LAN, WLAN, WAN, basic infrastructure security, and ITSM.

descriptionHtml:
Blibli is transforming into a future-ready e-commerce ecosystem where business growth and customer experience go hand in hand. We’re reimagining how we serve customers and empower sellers, building smarter ways to drive loyalty, efficiency, and impact. Because of that, it is important for us to be able to create insightful analysis based on our consumers' needs.

In Commercial, you’ll help our customers and partners to fulfill their needs based on the strategy you created. Your work supports business growth, business planning, and business decisions that are important and engaging, and keep our customer coming back to Blibli.

As Data Insight Sr. Officer you’ll dive deep into market sizing, demographics, and consumer behavior, turning big numbers into clear strategies that help us win in a competitive landscape. If you’re passionate about data-driven decision-making, skilled in SQL, and thrive on solving complex business challenges, we’d love to meet you.

What We’ll Work On Together

  • Analyze large-scale datasets to uncover trends in market sizing, demographics, and market behavior.
  • Translate insights into strategic recommendations (e.g., segment targeting, product/offer positioning, channel optimization).
  • Use SQL to extract, clean, join, and aggregate data from multiple sources (data warehouses, CRM, campaign tools).
  • Develop frameworks, segmentation, and scoring models to evaluate customer potential and market opportunities.
  • Create dashboards and reports that communicate findings to non-technical stakeholders.
  • Present insights clearly, with narratives tied to business objectives and measurable outcomes.
  • Partner with other teams and business stakeholders to define metrics, hypotheses, and experiment designs.

Qualification

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Data Science, Computer Science, Economics, Business Analytics, or related field.
  • 4–6 years of experience in data analysis/business intelligence/market analytics, ideally within consumer/business market contexts.
  • Confident with SQL: joins, CTEs, aggregations, window functions, performance-aware queries.
  • Solid experience with data visualization tools (tableau or similar).
  • Experience in FMCG, e-commerce, fintech, telecom, or retail analytics (plus point).

descriptionHtml:
PIPECARE Group is currently looking for UT/UTCD Data Analyst [Level 3] to our office in Jakarta.

By providing technology and service focused solutions to the international arena of the oil and gas industry, the PIPECARE Group of companies has been helping our customers ensure the integrity of their pipeline and facility assets for over 20 years. Due to our global focus and international growth, Pipecare is seeking experienced UT/UTCD Data Analyst [Level 3] to support our continued growth.

Selected candidate will be working with our project execution teams to ensure the timely and accurate reporting of in-line inspection results, with focus on our custom-tailored reporting solutions to satisfy our customers’ needs. This includes the review of customer requirement specifications, processing of in-line inspection data, the analysis and identification of pipeline features and anomalies within processed data sets, application of industry accepted anomaly assessment criteria, ensuring the quality and accuracy of the final results, and compiling the results of our inspection activities in a concise, comprehensive custom tailored report for our customers.

Industry/sector: Oil & Gas / In Line Inspection services

Qualification: DA in UT/UTCD technology [Level 3]

Min years of experience: minimum last 15+ years working as UT/UTCD Data Analyst

Other requirements: solution – oriented attitude; hands on approach; disciplined; team player; self-motivated

Responsibilities include:

    • Checking and approving the tool performance during the PTT
    • Checking the data quality of ILI runs
    • UTWM Data Analysis
    • UTCD Data Analysis
    • EMAT Data Analysis
    • Checking and implementing dig verification task at sites and preparing relevant reports
    • Reviewing the software inter phase
    • Reviewing software user manuals
    • Preparing/Reviewing DAD quality documentation
    • To ensure accurate tool sensitivity values are provided to TM in Tool Checklist
    • To prepare a specific Run assessment report
    • To identify obstructions in the pipeline; to produce technically valid Preliminary / Final report (if applicable)
    • To produce technically valid Preliminary / Final report
    • To inform HO-DAD about the results and/or to implement the results into the reports
    • To ensure that the coordinates are synchronized with the data
    • To alert the R&D regarding the software problems
    • To update the documentation
    • To produce updated standard quality procedures
    • To alert the DA Team Leader / DA Manager regarding the software problems
    • Execute all other tasks as requested by DA Team Leader or DA Manager and/or Executive Team within the assigned job role
Qualified Candidates will possess:

  • Minimum 4-year technical or engineering degree from an accredited university (experience in the analysis of in-line inspection data may be considered in lieu of education on case by case basis)
  • Prior certification as ILI PQ LIII Data Analyst in one or more of the following in-line inspection technologies: UTWM, UTCD, EMAT; or the ability to become certified
  • Minimum 15 years of experience in the analysis of in-line inspection data
  • Ability to learn proprietary software platforms; proficiency in Microsoft based applications is a must
  • Proficiency in English, both verbal and written
  • A professional, detail-oriented focus and attention to detail and high quality
  • Ability to communicate effectively to all organizational levels, prepare and make presentations to management and customers on all levels

Job requirements:

  • Ability to work for extended periods of time in a stationary position at computers and workstations
  • Ability to pass vision acuity and color differentiation examinations
  • Business travel may be required for internal training, internal meetings, site visits, and customer meetings [international travel may be required]
  • Ability to work flexible hours based on business and project needs
  • Ability to work either independently or within a team to ensure project success

Physical and Mental Requirements:

  • Lifting and Carrying: Ability to lift and carry up to 50 pounds
  • Mobility: Must be able to walk and climb to perform duties, including maneuvering within a refinery or plant environment and accessing elevated platforms via ladders and stairwells
  • Communication: Sufficient clarity of speech and hearing, or other communication capabilities, to communicate effectively
  • Focus and Multitasking: Ability to maintain focus and multitask effectively
  • Safety Equipment: Must be able to wear safety equipment as required by the safety department for personal protection, if/where needed in manufacturing environments.
  • Personal Mobility and Reflexes: Sufficient personal mobility and physical reflexes, with or without reasonable accommodations, to perform office duties and travel to off-site locations when necessary

About PIPECARE Group:

PIPECARE Group offers comprehensive In-Line Inspection Services to identify and size pipeline threats, Utilizing advanced technologies such as Magnetic Flux Leakage, Transverse Field Inspection, Ultrasound, and specialized tools, PIPECARE ensures precise detection and assessment of various pipeline anomalies.

What we do:

In-Line Inspection Services

PIPECARE provides In-Line Inspection Services to locate, identify, and size threats, supporting integrity management requirements.

Check out our AI Technology and other cutting-edge technologies by clicking the following YouTube Links:

PIPECARE Group - YouTube

SMART AI CALIPER - Inspection Experience Like Never Before

Inspection Technologies

Magnetic Flux Leakage (MFL): Detects and sizes general corrosion and metal loss anomalies, especially circumferentially oriented.

Transverse Field Inspection (TFI): Detects and sizes general corrosion and metal loss anomalies, primarily axially oriented.

Ultrasound (UT): Detects and sizes general and other metal loss anomalies with high depth sizing accuracy.

Ultrasonic Crack Detection: Detects and sizes cracks and colonies of cracks.

Caliper (Geometry): Detects and sizes deviations in the ideal circular shape of a pipeline (dents, ovalities, wrinkles, etc.).

Specialized Tools and Technologies

Combo Tools: Use multiple measurement systems in various combinations.

Specialized Tubing Technologies: Designed for Furnace and Downhole Operations.

Your day at NTT DATA

They act as a liaison among stakeholders in order to understand the structure, policies, and operations of an organisation, and to recommend solutions that enable the organisation to achieve its goals. They take guidance from more senior Business Analysts.

What You'll Be Doing

Key Roles and Responsibilities:

  • Acts as a bridge between the business problems and the technology solutions.
  • Supports the analysis, transformation and ultimately works towards resolving business problems with the help of technology.
  • Works with internal clients and applies best practice methodologies to determine business requirements and to define solutions to address business, process, information and system problems, improvements or change.
  • Delivers business projects in line with sponsor requirements and enterprise architecture.
  • Proactive development and deployment of enhanced services and platforms, covering all the functional aspects from service/product definition through to build and deployment.
  • Ensures the identification and documentation of operational gaps including user guides, templates, test cases and related user training.
  • Assists with the resolution of issues pertaining to the service.
  • Adheres to and follow the relevant development and support processes.
  • Communicates and escalates if any issues arise or deliverables cannot be met and request assistance to ensure closure of issues.
  • Takes responsibility for delivery of project elements under relevant guidance and supervision.

Knowledge, Skills and Attributes:

  • Demonstrated understanding of business practices and processes
  • Team player who displays good client service orientation with well-developed administrative and organisation skills
  • Developing expertise in specific systems, processes and technologies that they will be required to analyse
  • Meticulous attention to detail whilst working under pressure
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills
  • Ability to listen empathetically
  • Ability to build rapport and engage effectively with a variety of stakeholders
  • Knowledge of project management methodology
  • Good analytical skills with the ability to convert business requirements into operational deliverables (functional requirements) to meet business objectives
  • Good documentation skills, in particular, functional requirements, test cases, system user documentation, processes and procedures and presentations
  • Very good working knowledge of Microsoft Exchange, Word, Excel Project, PowerPoint and Visio
  • Understanding of systems generally used in a services organisation e.g. ServiceNow, Siebel, Remedy, SAP, EMS would be advantageous

Academic Qualifications and Certifications:

  • Relevant Bachelor’s degree or equivalent with related demonstrable experience
  • Project management certification would be advantageous
  • IIBA Membership required
  • PMI PBA
  • Relevant technology certification(s) required, such as ITIL

Required Experience:

  • Moderate level experience as a Business Analyst gained within a technology services environment
  • Moderate level experience as a system administrator or developer would be advantageous
  • Developing experience in and with all operational aspects of a Services business, preferably with a Systems Integrator
  • Developing experience in the business requirement gathering, use case definition, process mapping and implementing new services and systems
  • Understanding of and experience with ITIL (IT Infrastructure Library) and the application of ITIL tools within a service integrator

Workplace type:

On-site Working

About NTT DATA

NTT DATA is a $30+ billion trusted global innovator of business and technology services. We serve 75% of the Fortune Global 100 and are committed to helping clients innovate, optimize and transform for long-term success. We invest over $3.6 billion each year in R&D to help organizations and society move confidently and sustainably into the digital future. As a Global Top Employer, we have diverse experts in more than 50 countries and a robust partner ecosystem of established and start-up companies. Our services include business and technology consulting, data and artificial intelligence, industry solutions, as well as the development, implementation and management of applications, infrastructure, and connectivity. We are also one of the leading providers of digital and AI infrastructure in the world. NTT DATA is part of NTT Group and headquartered in Tokyo.

Equal Opportunity Employer

NTT DATA is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer with a global culture that embraces diversity. We are committed to providing an environment free of unfair discrimination and harassment. We do not discriminate based on age, race, colour, gender, sexual orientation, religion, nationality, disability, pregnancy, marital status, veteran status, or any other protected category. Join our growing global team and accelerate your career with us. Apply today.

descriptionHtml:
当社は、超精密加工技術を核とした「機械（メカニクス）」と「電子（エレクトロニクス）」の技術を融合させ、社会のニーズに応える革新的な製品を創出する世界唯一の「『相合』精密部品メーカー」です。

この度、当社の未来を担う次世代製品開発を加速させるため、情熱を持って挑戦していただける電気系エンジニアを募集いたします。

＜募集背景＞

当社は、祖業であるボールベアリング事業で培った超精密加工技術を基盤に、M&Aを通じて事業領域を拡大し続けてまいりました。近年では、ミツミ電機との経営統合を軸にM&Aを加速させています。アクセス製品事業ではユーシンやホンダロック（現ミネベア アクセスソリューションズ）を、アナログ半導体事業ではエイブリックやオムロンのMEMS事業、そして2024年には日立パワーデバイス（現ミネベアパワーデバイス）を、さらにコネクタ事業では本多通信工業や住鉱テック（現ミネベアコネクト）をグループに迎え入れました。

これらの戦略的な経営統合により、当社のコア事業である「8本槍」（ベアリング、アナログ半導体、モーター、センサー、アクセス製品、コネクタ、電源、無線通信ソフトウェア）は、その製品ラインナップと技術力を一層強固なものとしています。現在、これらの多様な製品・技術を組み合わせ、計測制御・通信技術、AIやIoT技術を実装することで、車載、産業機器、医療・ヘルスケアといった分野でお客様の課題を解決する、高付加価値な次世代製品の開発を強力に推進しています。この変革をさらに加速するため、新たな価値創造に共に挑んでいただける電気系エンジニアを求めています。

＜業務内容＞

FA・ロボティクス、車載、医療、住設といった幅広い分野をターゲットとした、次世代新製品の電気回路設計/評価をご担当いただきます。当社の強みである精密機械部品、モーター、アクチュエータ、センサー、半導体、無線技術といった多様なコア技術を組み合わせた、これまでにない製品開発プロジェクトに参画していただきます。

ご経験やご希望に応じて、下記のいずれかのフェーズ、または複数フェーズに横断的に携わっていただくことが可能です。

・マーケットリサーチ、製品企画

・要件定義、仕様策定

・アーキテクチャ設計、詳細設計、実装、テスト

・要素技術開発、先行開発

・量産化に向けた事業部への技術移管

＜業務の魅力・やりがい＞

・世界トップレベルの技術力に触れることができる

世界シェアNo.1を誇る製品群 を支える「超精密加工技術」や最先端の「エレクトロニクス技術」を駆使した、当社でしか実現できないものづくりに携われます。

・「相合」による新たな価値創造

メカとエレキ、ハードとソフトなど、異なる分野の技術や知見を組み合わせ、新たな価値を創造する「相合」のプロセスを体感できます。

例えば、当社の複数技術を融合させて実現した「機電一体型モーター」のように、お客様の抱える社会的課題の解決において新たな価値を提供する製品開発に挑戦できる環境です 。

・社会課題解決への貢献

手掛ける製品は、EV化・自動運転、スマートシティ、次世代医療、省エネルギーといった社会的に意義のある分野で活用されます 。ご自身の技術が、持続可能で豊かな社会の実現に直接貢献するやりがいを感じていただけます。

・グローバルな開発環境

世界28カ国に拠点を持ち、約10万人の多様なバックグラウンドを持つ仲間と協働する機会があります 。グローバルな視点での製品開発に携わることが可能です。

・挑戦を後押しする企業文化

当社は社員一人ひとりの「情熱」を何よりも大切にしています 。出身や経歴に関わらず、意欲ある人材が思う存分に挑戦できる風土が根付いており、自律的なキャリア形成を支援します 。

・下記何れかの製品開発経験

  • アナログ回路設計/検証
  • デジタル回路設計/検証
  • 通信・CPU制御設計/検証

＜歓迎要件＞

必須要件に加え、以下のご経験をお持ちの方は、即戦力としてご活躍いただけます。

▼プロジェクト推進スキル

・開発プロジェクトのマネジメント、または開発チームリーダーの経験

・電気HW/SW、計測制御、機構系など各分野技術クロスファンクションチームでの開発経験

・市場性検討や競合分析、技術戦略の立案など、ビジネス視点での先行開発経験

▼専門技術スキル

・量産立ち上げの経験

・新製品開発業務経験（目安5年以上）

・メカトロ系の製品開発経験

・小型家電製品、産業用機器等の電気回路、機能安全設計経験

・モータ駆動回路設計経験（ステッピングモータ、ブラシレスモータなど）

・デジタル回路設計経験（組み込みマイコン、周辺回路、FPGAなど）

・アナログ回路設計経験（AD/DA、センサー、通信系PHYなど）

・回路系CADの経験（OrCAD Capture/PCB Designer, LTSPICEなど）

・組込マイコンのプログラミング経験

・電源回路設計経験

・信頼性試験の経験（環境試験、EMC試験、電気的試験など）

・評価データ処理などツール（Python、VBAなど）の使用経験 ◆勤務時間：

・所定労働時間：8:45 ‐ 17:30(休憩1時間 / 実働7時間45分)

・フレックスタイム制あり：コアタイム 10:00 - 15:00

※試用期間中は対象外

◆完全週休2日制（当社カレンダーによる）、祝日 ※年間休日121日

◆年末年始休暇、年次有給休暇、慶弔休暇、ライフサポート休暇、特別休暇

◆社会保険完備（雇用、労災、健康、厚生年金）

◆確定企業年金、確定拠出年金、財形貯蓄、従業員持株会

◆交通費全額支給

◆社員食堂、カフェテリア（17:30以降は社内居酒屋として営業） 、保養所

◆育児・介護・妊娠・傷病の事由による在宅勤務制度

※試用期間中は対象外

◆昇給年1回、賞与年2回（6月、12月）

◆試用期間3ヶ月

◆定年65歳 ミネベアミツミ株式会社 東京クロステックガーデン

・住所：東京都港区東新橋1-9-3

・最寄り駅：各線 汐留駅／各線 新橋駅

※受動喫煙対策：敷地内全面禁煙

NEX Entertainment is a dynamic digital entertainment company, revolutionizing the landscape of live streaming, content creation and talent management. We are dedicated to bringing a fast-forward, next-level experience for talented individuals seeking to make their mark in the digital world.


Our mission is to democratize entertainment content and monetize talents through a unique combination between technology and human connections.


We envision building the next generation content creation platform, offering a platform that not only showcases talent but also provides an unparalleled entertainment experience for audiences worldwide.


Currently, we’re looking for a Data Analyst / Data Engineer who is passionate about turning marketing and platform data into powerful insights to drive campaign performance, audience growth, and business impact.

What You’ll Do:

  • Lead data analytics initiatives to support TikTok Go marketing, creator, and live commerce strategies

  • Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, or a related quantitative field
  • 4+ years of experience in data analytics, data engineering, or related roles, preferably in digital marketing, performance marketing, or high-growth tech
  • Strong SQL skills and experience with BI tools (Lark Base, Power BI, Tableau, Redash, or similar)
  • Experience with cloud data platforms such as BigQuery or Snowflake (GCP preferred)
  • Familiarity with marketing attribution models, funnel analysis, and customer lifecycle analytics
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to translate data into business and campaign insights
  • Fluent in English

descriptionHtml:
Location: Jakarta, Indonesia

Only candidates with the legal right to work in Indonesia will be considered. Please note that applicants without this eligibility will not be considered.


Why join Rolls-Royce?

At Rolls-Royce we are proud to be a business that has truly helped to shape the modern world and are committed to always being a force for progress; powering, protecting and connecting people everywhere.

By joining Rolls-Royce, you'll have the opportunity to work on world-class solutions, supported by a culture that believes individuality is our greatest strength, and all perspectives, experiences and backgrounds help us innovate and enable our high-performance culture.


Position Summary

We are looking for an Application Engineer to support the growth of our PowerGen and Sustainable Solutions business in Indonesia.


In this role, you will act as a technical subject matter expert (SME) partnering closely with the sales team to develop technically sound, competitive, and customer-aligned solutions. You will provide customer-facing support across the full spectrum of technical activities ranging from sizing, configuration, and system integration to technical proposal development and tender support.


This position is ideal for candidates with strong experience in power generation systems, technical sales support, and application engineering especially in the 1–3MW diesel and gas generator range, including system integration and supporting documentation.


What you will be doing:

  • Act as the technical subject matter expert, partnering with the sales team to support customer solutioning and technical engagement.
  • Work closely with sales managers to identify customer requirements and propose suitable technical solutions.
  • Provide technical expertise in sizing, application, configuration, and system integration of equipment and complete system solutions.
  • Develop and deliver technical proposals for bids and tenders, including drawings, calculations, and supporting documentation in compliance with client specifications.
  • Support bid and tender processes by contributing to solution shaping and supporting pricing strategies through technical documentation and equipment selections.
  • Participate in meetings, site visits, customer presentations, and negotiations, communicating technical solutions in clear, business-focused language.
  • Build and maintain strong working relationships with customers, consultants, and contractors.
  • Provide application guidance including load assessments, sizing recommendations, and ensuring compliance with local regulations, standards, and codes relevant to system integration and installation.
  • Coordinate with engineering and project teams to validate feasibility, technical risks, scope alignment, and cost implications.
  • Act as the key technical liaison during the sales cycle, ensuring customer confidence and technical credibility.
  • Support product demonstrations, factory witness tests (when required), and customer technical training sessions.
  • Stay updated on market trends and competitor offerings within energy and power solutions, including controls systems and emissions requirements.
  • Support internal and external audits and ensure activities align with company policies, quality standards, compliance requirements, and HSE practices.
  • Support additional technical assignments as required by the business.


Position requirements:

  • Minimum 5 years of experience in generator sales support, application engineering, power generation solutioning, or related roles.
  • Strong knowledge of diesel and gas generator technologies, ideally in the 1–3MW range, including awareness of switchgear and electrical systems integration.
  • Strong technical understanding of power generation systems, including system interfaces, interactions, and integration requirements.
  • Proven track record of supporting technical sales processes from lead stage to order closure.
  • Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to translate technical details into customer value and benefits.
  • Strong stakeholder management skills, comfortable engaging customers and internal teams across different levels.
  • Strong team player with a proactive and solution-oriented mindset.
  • Strong problem-solving capabilities and ability to work effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
  • Ability to manage multiple technical proposals and deadlines with strong attention to detail and responsiveness.
  • Strong customer focus and relationship-building capabilities.


Education & Tools

  • Bachelor’s degree in electrical engineering, Mechanical Engineering, Power Engineering, or a related discipline.
  • Proficient in written and spoken English.
  • Proficiency in AutoCAD layouts and Microsoft Office tools.
  • Familiarity with SAP is preferred.


Preferred Background

Candidates with experience in any of the following will be highly relevant:

  • Generator OEM environment and/or exposure to major brands (e.g., Cummins, Caterpillar, MTU, Kohler, or similar).
  • Power generation solutioning for industrial plants, mission-critical infrastructure, or complex customer installations.
  • Experience supporting tender documentation and technical proposal development in an EPC, consultant-led, or contractor-led environment.


About mtu Power Systems

Power Systems is the Rolls-Royce business which provides world-class power solutions and complete life-cycle support under our product and solution brand mtu. Through digitalization and electrification, we strive to develop drive and power generation solutions that provide answers to the challenges posed by the rapidly growing societal demands for energy and mobility.

We deliver and service comprehensive, powerful and reliable systems, based on both gas and diesel engines, as well as electrified hybrid systems. These technologically advanced solutions serve our customers in the marine and infrastructure sectors worldwide.


Our vision is to ensure that the excellence and ingenuity that shaped our history continues into our future. Our multi-year transformation programme aims to turn Rolls-Royce into a high-performing, competitive, resilient and growing company. Join us, and it can be your future vision too.


Rolls-Royce is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to any protected characteristics.

Relocation assistance is not available for this position.

descriptionHtml:
Title

Architectural Designer

KBR’s Sustainable Technology Solutions (STS) group is looking for a Architectural Designer to to support the largest offshore oilfield in Qatar, Bul Hanine. This will play a vital role in the country’s oil production portfolio. The expansion project is part of Qatar’s broader strategy to sustain and enhance its oil output while simultaneously investing heavily in its liquefied natural gas (LNG) production growth. This role will perform global analyses of offshore structures.

The Principal Architectural Designer shall be familiar with Architectural works for oil & gas facilities (onshore and/or offshore), producing 2D drawings and 3D models for the detailed design of buildings and architectural systems. This role requires the candidate to able to work independently, self-check the correctness of the work produced and submit the deliverables via the document control system. The candidate shall be able to incorporate and coordinate with other disciplines on the Structural building frames and the Electrical/Instrumentation/Telecoms layout requirements

Responsibilities

Discipline and Technical Delivery:

  • Produce 2D detailed design drawings of buildings (e.g., control buildings, electrical and instrumentation buildings, workshops, warehouses, laboratory, blast resistant modules, TR shelters).
  • Produce layouts, GA drawings, sections/elevations, door/window/finishes/furniture schedules and bill of quantities.
  • Produce drawings showing blast and fire zoning layouts, fire & life safety egress plans, acoustic/thermal provisions, and architectural interfaces with HVAC, electrical, instrumentation, and piping.
  • Produce REVIT and E3D models of all buildings and architectural elements.
  • Attend 3D model review and clear clashes and punch lists.

Multi-Discipline Coordination

  • Coordinate with Structural, Civil, Piping/Layout, Mechanical/HVAC, E&I, Telecoms, Fire & Safety to resolve clashes.
  • Oversee BIM/3D model (Navisworks/Revit) integration and ensure model to drawing consistency.
  • Incorporate comments for architectural material submittals (doors, cladding, roofing, flooring, ceilings, insulation, coatings, blast rated assemblies).
  • Update as-built drawings.

Required Qualifications

  • Diploma or bachelor’s in architecture (or equivalent).
  • At least 15 years of experience as architectural designer within oil & gas / petrochemical / energy projects, including detailed design on EPC/EPCI contracts.
  • Strong track record of multi-discipline coordination and BIM-enabled delivery.
  • Proficiency with: AutoCAD, Revit (preferred), E3D, Navisworks, BIM 360/ACC, Bluebeam, and office tools.
  • Familiar with 3D model reviews, clash detection and clearing of clashes and punch lists.
  • Working knowledge of material systems: insulated panels, blast-rated doors, architectural finishes suitable for corrosive environments.

Decarbonization – Energy Transition – Sustainability

Job Summary

The Chief Engineering is responsible for overseeing the overall engineering operations, maintenance, and technical performance of all hotel assets. The role ensures that all building systems—mechanical, electrical, plumbing (MEP), HVAC, and safety—operate efficiently, sustainably, and in compliance with regulatory standards. The Chief Engineering leads preventive and corrective maintenance strategies, optimizes operational costs, and supports hotel business continuity by ensuring high asset uptime and guest satisfaction.

What you will do:

  • Collect and validate performance data for utilities (electricity, water, HVAC, genset, solar, etc.).
  • Conduct root cause analysis (RCA) for downtime and recurring issues.
  • Assess equipment condition to prioritize maintenance or replacement.
  • Develop standardized cost estimation frameworks for MEP activities.
  • Support CAPEX and OPEX budgeting with accurate cost projections.
  • Review and analyze maintenance and project cost elements.
  • Monitor preventive and corrective maintenance execution (preventive, corrective, and predictive) to ensure timely and effective execution.
  • Integrate site data into centralized dashboards for performance visibility.
  • Identify opportunities for energy efficiency and cost optimization.
  • Collaborate with the Chief Engineer on planning, budgeting, and system upgrades.
  • Overseeing all activities related to technical operations.

You will fit in this job if you:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Mechanical, Electrical, or Industrial Engineering (or related field).
  • Minimum 8–10 years of experience in engineering management, preferably in hospitality or property management industries., with at least 3 years in a supervisory or managerial role.
  • Proven track record in operating and maintaining building systems (HVAC, MEP, BMS, etc.).
  • Strong understanding of preventive maintenance planning and asset management systems (e.g., CMMS).
  • Excellent knowledge of safety, compliance, and sustainability standards.
  • Leadership experience in managing technical teams across multiple sites.
  • Strong analytical, budgeting, and project management skills.
  • Excellent communication and collaboration skills with cross-department stakeholders.
  • Ability to work under pressure and respond quickly to operational emergencies.
  • Willingness to travel for site supervision and audits.
