Company Description

  • Grand Seminyak Lifestyle Boutique Bali Resort is located in the heart of Bali's dynamic Seminyak, Grand Seminyak is your gateway to an extraordinary escape. Nestled in the desirable Seminyak area, the resort is just a

30-minute drive from Ngurah Rai International Airport.

Tucked away amidst verdant tropical gardens with expansive views of the Indian Ocean, Grand Seminyak embodies the essence of the boutique resort experience. Unwind in artfully crafted suites, indulge in contemporary dining experiences, rejuvenate by the shoreline infinity pool, and bask on your private balcony, capturing the mesmerizing horizon.

Dive deep into the vibrant tapestry of Bali. Engage with Seminyak’s eclectic boutique culture and pulsating nightlife, or journey inward to the island’s soulful core, dotted with quaint villages, cascading terraced rice fields, and a mosaic of art, dance, and age-old crafts. Find serenity along hidden coastal enclaves where the symphony of waves and nature’s allure promise a therapeutic retreat.

Job Description

Operation & Maintenance

  • Ensure all building systems, including HVAC, electrical, plumbing, and mechanical, operate at optimal efficiency.
  • Develop and implement preventive maintenance schedules to minimize equipment downtime and extend asset life.
  • Respond promptly to guest and operational maintenance requests while maintaining minimal disruption to services.
  • Oversee repairs, upgrades, and daily operational checks of hotel facilities.

Safety, Compliance & Sustainability

  • Maintain compliance with local building codes, fire safety regulations, and health & safety standards.
  • Conduct regular inspections and safety drills in coordination with relevant departments.
  • Drive the hotel’s sustainability initiatives, including energy and water conservation programs.
  • Maintain accurate documentation of compliance records, inspections, and certifications.

Budgeting & Cost Management

  • Prepare and manage the annual engineering budget, including capital expenditure planning.
  • Monitor energy consumption and implement cost-saving strategies without compromising service quality.
  • Source, negotiate, and manage vendor contracts for equipment and services

Project Management

  • Lead engineering projects, renovations, and refurbishments, ensuring timely and cost-effective delivery.
  • Collaborate with internal and external stakeholders to plan and execute capital projects aligned with the hotel’s long-term strategy.
  • Ensure all work meets quality and safety standards.

Team Leadership

  • Lead, mentor, and develop a skilled engineering team, fostering a culture of accountability and continuous learning.
  • Set clear performance goals, conduct regular evaluations, and provide coaching to team members.
  • Ensure proper staffing and training to support operational needs.

Collaboration & Reporting

  • Work closely with other department heads to support operational needs and special projects.
  • Submit regular reports on maintenance activities, energy management, and project progress to the General Manager.
  • Participate in management meetings and contribute to the hotel’s strategic planning initiatives.

Qualifications

  • A minimum 3 years in the similar role, preferable in the a luxury 5* hotel/ resort.
  • Strong preventive maintenance plan, time management, problem solving skill and technologically savvy.
  • Have the experience in project or renovation management will be advantage.
  • Highly motivated, passionate, energetic with excellent interpersonal skill.
  • Excellent leadership, interpersonal, communication and computer literacy skills.
  • Position applicable for Indonesian nationality only and preferably Bali domicile.

Additional Information

Competencies

  • Creative & strategic thinker with a strong eye for detail.
  • Strong leadership and interpersonal skills, capable of inspiring a team.
  • Ability to multitask and manage multiple projects in a fast-paced environment.
  • Self-motivated and goal-oriented with a proactive approach.

Overview

Microsoft’s Cloud Operations & Innovation (CO+I) is the engine that powers our cloud services. As a CO+I Mechanical Engineer, you will perform a key role in delivering the core infrastructure and foundational technologies for Microsoft's online services including Bing, Office 365, Xbox, OneDrive, and the Microsoft Azure platform.

Our infrastructure is comprised of a large global portfolio of more than 200 datacenters in 32 countries and millions of servers. Our foundation is built upon and managed by a team of subject matter experts working to support services for more than 1 billion customers and 20 million businesses in over 90 countries worldwide.

With environmental sustainability and optimization at the forefront of our datacenter design and operations, we continue to grow and evolve as we meet the ever-changing business demands that hold Microsoft as a world-class cloud provider.

Microsoft’s mission is to empower every person and every organization on the planet to achieve more. As employees we come together with a growth mindset, innovate to empower others, and collaborate to realize our shared goals. Each day we build on our values of respect, integrity, and accountability to create a culture of inclusion where everyone can thrive at work and beyond.

Responsibilities

Responsibilities:

  • A strong desire and capability to learn, grow, and develop new skills
  • Empower a culture of safety, security, and compliance in all aspect of data center activities
  • Understand the design and functionality of your datacenter
  • Work alongside a team of industry professionals across the Information Technology (IT) and Critical Environments (CE) spectrum to support 24x7x365 on-site datacenter operations and mechanical infrastructures.
  • Act as the technical authority for on-site operations of large-scale mechanical systems and designs.
  • Collaborate with the Operations and Design team to develop data center (DC) mechanical designs, starting from project conception to issue for construction (IFC) for new DC projects build outs and major infrastructure upgrades.
  • Establish and coordinate maintenance & safety procedures, maintaining redundant high-capacity cooling systems; to operating and supporting datacenter backup electrical systems (diesel generators, rotary UPS, etc.)
  • Steward vital infrastructure supporting deployments of Microsoft's online services.
  • Assist with supplier selection and overseeing mechanical supplier execution
  • Learn, live, and coach the One Microsoft culture and values.? Lead through change by bringing clarity, generating energy, and delivering success

Qualifications

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in mechanical engineering or related discipline; has minimum working experience at least 5 years. Having experience in data centre field is point plus.
  • Must have prior experience in operations and maintenance in a mission‑critical facility or organization.
  • Willingness to operate in a 24/7 data centre environment, including cross‑functional collaboration with CE Technicians, Electrical Engineers, and operational staff.
  • Awareness of Critical Environment (CE) qualification expectations, CE operational standards, and the importance of strict compliance in live facilities.
  • Advance understanding of HVAC/cooling systems, air flow, and mechanical reliability fundamentals used in mission‑critical facilities.

This position will be open for a minimum of 5 days, with applications accepted on an ongoing basis until the position is filled.

Overlooking the scenic South China Sea, an hour away by ferry from Singapore, Mövenpick Resort & Spa Bintan Lagoon will introduce Swiss-inspired hospitality to Bintan in celebration of Mövenpick's rich culinary legacy. The resort is set to be the new beach getaway destination for all generations with standout facilities, including 420 rooms & suites, two golf course, three lagoon swimming pools, unique restaurant concepts, a two-storey beach club, spacious event spaces. Wellness will also be an integral part of the resort experience, with a vast wellness and recreation village that will feature a gym, a spa, and Kid Club.

Job Description

  • Oversee daily security operations and manage a team of security personnel
  • Develop and implement security protocols and procedures tailored to the unique challenges of Baghdad
  • Conduct regular risk assessments and update security measures accordingly
  • Liaise with local law enforcement and relevant government agencies
  • Train and mentor security staff on best practices, emergency procedures, and use of security equipment
  • Monitor and maintain security systems, including CCTV, access control, and alarm systems
  • Investigate and report security incidents, providing detailed documentation and recommendations
  • Ensure compliance with company policies and local security regulations
  • Coordinate security for special events or high-profile visitors
  • Conduct regular security drills and emergency response exercises
  • Stay informed about the local security situation and adjust strategies as needed

Qualifications

  • 2-5 years of experience in security management, preferably in high-risk environments
  • Excellent knowledge of security operations, risk assessment, and emergency response procedures
  • Proficiency in operating and maintaining modern security technologies and surveillance systems
  • Outstanding communication skills, both verbal and written
  • Demonstrated ability to make quick, sound decisions in high-pressure situations

About this role:

This role is based in our Jakarta office, and you will be a member of our wider Singapore team. The portfolio from this team includes projects from major hotel operators, clubhouses, show flats, etc. across China, Southeast Asia, Japan, Korea and India.

Job Summary:

The FF&E Designer at HBA’s Jakarta office will play a key role in developing and executing FF&E design concepts for high-profile hospitality. This role requires a creative and detail-oriented individual with a strong understanding of materials, finishes, and furnishings, as well as the ability to collaborate effectively with cross-functional teams to bring design visions to life.

Key Responsibilities:

Assist in the creation of innovative FF&E concepts, mood boards, and material palettes that align with project goals and client expectations.

  • Develop detailed FF&E specifications, including furniture layouts, custom designs, and finish schedules.
  • Source and select furniture, fixtures, lighting, and accessories that meet design, quality, and budgetary requirements.
  • Work closely with interior designers, architects, and procurement teams to ensure seamless integration of FF&E elements into overall design schemes.
  • Participate in design presentations and client meetings, providing support in communicating FF&E concepts.
  • Assist in the preparation of design documentation, including drawings, schedules, and budgets.
  • Liaise with vendors, suppliers, and manufacturers to source materials, obtain quotes, and ensure timely delivery of FF&E items.
  • Conduct quality checks on FF&E samples and prototypes to ensure they meet design standards.
  • Assist in overseeing the installation of FF&E items on-site, ensuring design intent is maintained.

Address and resolve any FF&E-related issues during the installation phase.

We promise you a career in the world of luxury design as you would be working in a hospitality design firm that is ranked No.1 in the world. You would expect to work with the best and develop your skills and career along the way. That is why we are also looking to recruit the most talented in the industry to join us!

Below are the minimum qualifications that we expect from you:

  • Bachelor’s degree in interior design, Architecture, or related field.
  • Minimum 3–6 years of experience in FF&E design, preferably within the hospitality or related sector.
  • Proficiency in design software such as AutoCAD, SketchUp, Adobe Creative Suite, and FF&E specification tools.
  • Strong knowledge of materials, finishes, and furnishings, with an eye for detail and quality.
  • Fluent in English is a must.

To be successful in the role you should also have:

  • Ability to work collaboratively in a fast-paced environment and manage multiple priorities.
  • Strong sense of responsibility.
  • Excellent organizational and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple tasks simultaneously.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work effectively in a team environment.

Does this sound like you? Are you ready to embark on a fruitful career in luxury hospitality design with us?

If the answer is yes, simply send us your CV and design portfolio (in PDF format less than 15MB). We are only interested in your best projects so be selective and make sure you convey your artistic sense as a designer through the portfolio too!

Don’t forget to connect and follow us on LinkedIn, Instagram and WeChat. Remember to check our career page from time to time to get the latest updates on job opportunities with HBA!

We are seeking a mid-level Data Engineer & Analyst who owns the end-to-end data lifecycle—from building reliable data pipelines to delivering meaningful insights. This role combines hands-on data engineering with analytical problem-solving to support business and operational decision-making.

Key Responsibilities

Data Engineering

  • Build, maintain, and optimize ETL/ELT pipelines from multiple data sources
  • Manage and improve data warehouse and data models for analytics use cases
  • Ensure data quality, accuracy, and consistency across datasets
  • Monitor and troubleshoot data pipeline performance and failures
  • Collaborate with product and engineering teams to support data needs

Data Analytics

  • Translate business questions into SQL-based analysis and metrics
  • Develop dashboards and recurring reports for business stakeholders
  • Define, track, and maintain KPIs and core metrics
  • Perform ad-hoc analysis to identify trends, risks, and opportunities
  • Communicate insights clearly with actionable recommendations

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Statistics, or related field
  • 3–5 years of experience in data engineering, data analytics, or hybrid roles
  • Strong proficiency in SQL
  • Proficiency in Python for data processing and analysis
  • Experience with data warehousing concepts and dimensional modeling
  • Hands-on experience with at least one BI tool (e.g. Tableau, Power BI, Looker)

We are seeking a motivated Junior Team Lead to support and oversee data collection projects. The role involves coordinating field teams, ensuring project milestones are met, and leveraging knowledge of the local market to drive effective participant recruitment and data quality. This is an excellent opportunity for an early-career professional to develop leadership skills while contributing to impactful research and operational initiatives.

Primary Responsibilities

  • Assist in planning and execution of data collection projects, including timelines, resource allocation, and reporting
  • Supervise and guide small field teams, ensuring adherence to project protocols and deadlines
  • Use knowledge of the local market to support participant recruitment strategies and optimize outreach
  • Monitor data quality, troubleshoot issues, and escalate challenges to senior management when needed
  • Coordinate with internal teams (research, operations, project management) to align fieldwork with project goals
  • Contribute to training sessions for field staff and provide feedback to improve team performance
  • Prepare status updates and project documentation for management review


Requirements

  • Bachelor’s degree in Business, Social Sciences, Market Research, or related field
  • 1–2 years of experience in data collection, field operations, market research, or team coordination
  • Strong knowledge of the local market and cultural dynamics relevant to participant recruitment
  • Excellent organizational and communication skills
  • Ability to multitask and manage small teams effectively under tight deadlines
  • Proficiency with MS Office/Google Workspace


Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as a team coordinator, project assistant, or junior lead in data-driven environments
  • Familiarity with survey tools, participant databases, or digital recruitment platforms
  • Fluency in multiple local languages is an asset


We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

About Product Designer

Product designers are responsible for the look and feel of the furniture we use every day. They’re tasked with creating new pieces that are both aesthetically pleasing and functional, while also ensuring that these designs can be mass-produced at a reasonable cost.Furniture designers must have an eye for detail and an understanding of human anatomy and physiology. They must also be able to work well in a team environment—they rely on engineers, woodworkers, metal workers, fabricators, etc., to help bring their ideas to life.

What You Will Do

  • Carry out research to help develop ideas.
  • Produce new designs, or improve existing ones
  • Creating sketches and drawings of new designs using software such as AutoCAD or SolidWorks.
  • Meeting to discuss needs and preferences and recommending materials, colors, and styles that will meet their goals.
  • Take into account size, shape, ergonomics and production methods when producing design ideas.
  • Meeting with suppliers to select materials that meet the designer’s requirements for quality and cost.
  • Developing a thorough understanding of current trends in style so new designs will be desirable to consumers.
  • Reviewing existing furniture designs to identify opportunities for improvement or change.
  • Creating models of new designs for testing in physical simulations such as ergonomic studies such as sitting positions in chairs.

What You Will Need

  • Bachelor’s degree in furniture design, industrial design, or related field
  • 5 years professional experience in furniture design.
  • creativity and practical ability.
  • Proficient in AutoCAD, SolidWorks, 3ds Max, or similar software
  • Strong portfolio of previous work.
  • Excellent communication, presentation, and interpersonal skills.
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team.

descriptionHtml:
Requirements

Qualifications and Skills

Required

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or a related field, or equivalent experience.
  • 5+ years of hands-on experience administering enterprise-level Windows Server environments and Active Directory.
  • Expert-level knowledge of Active Directory, Group Policy, DNS, and DHCP.
  • Strong experience with Windows security hardening, patch management, and vulnerability remediation.
  • Proficiency in PowerShell scripting for automation.
  • In-depth experience with virtualization technologies (Hyper-V or VMware).
  • Solid understanding of core networking concepts (TCP/IP, VLANs, firewalls, VPN).
  • Experience with backup and disaster recovery methodologies and tools.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Strong communication and documentation skills.

Preferred (A Plus)

  • Relevant industry certifications (e.g., Microsoft Certified: Azure Administrator Associate (AZ-104), Microsoft 365 Certified: Enterprise Administrator Expert (MS-100/101), CompTIA Security+, CISSP).
  • Hands-on experience with Microsoft Azure cloud services (Azure AD, Azure VM, Sentinel, Defender suite).
  • Experience with identity management and single sign-on (SSO) solutions (e.g., SAML, OAuth, Okta).
  • Knowledge of SIEM systems and security monitoring.
  • Experience with compliance frameworks (NIST, CIS, ISO 27001).

Responsibilities

Key Responsibilities

Active Directory And Identity Management

  • Design, administer, and maintain a complex Microsoft Active Directory Domain Services (AD DS) environment, including domain controllers, forests, domains, and trusts.
  • Manage Group Policy Objects (GPOs) for security hardening, software deployment, and user configuration across the enterprise.
  • Administer Azure Active Directory (Azure AD) and hybrid identity solutions (Azure AD Connect).
  • Implement and manage identity and access management (IAM) solutions, including user provisioning, de-provisioning, and role-based access control (RBAC).
  • Troubleshoot and resolve complex AD replication, authentication, and DNS issues.

Windows Server Management

  • Install, configure, patch, and maintain Windows Server operating systems (2016, 2019, 2022).
  • Manage core infrastructure services including DNS, DHCP, DFS, and File/Print services.
  • Implement and manage Hyper-V or VMware virtualization platforms.
  • Perform system monitoring, performance tuning, and capacity planning.

Security And Compliance

  • Harden Windows servers and Active Directory according to industry benchmarks (e.g., CIS Benchmarks, NIST guidelines).
  • Develop and execute a rigorous patch management strategy for all Windows systems.
  • Implement and manage endpoint security solutions (Microsoft Defender for Endpoint, CrowdStrike, etc.).
  • Configure and manage security tools such as Microsoft Defender for Identity, and Azure Sentinel for threat detection and response.
  • Conduct regular security audits, access reviews, and vulnerability assessments.
  • Respond to security incidents, participate in investigations, and implement remediation plans.
  • Ensure compliance with organizational policies and relevant regulations (e.g., SOX, HIPAA, GDPR).

Automation And Scripting

  • Automate repetitive administrative tasks using PowerShell scripting.
  • Utilize DevOps principles and infrastructure-as-code (IaC) tools like Ansible, Terraform, or DSC for configuration management.

Backup, Disaster Recovery, And High Availability

  • Design, test, and maintain robust backup and disaster recovery solutions for critical infrastructure.
  • Implement high-availability configurations like Failover Clustering.

Collaboration And Support

  • Serve as an escalation point for help desk and other IT teams for complex issues.
  • Create and maintain detailed system documentation, network diagrams, and operational procedures.
  • Collaborate with network, security, and application teams on projects and initiatives.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan

  • Menyusun rencana proyek (termasuk ruang lingkup, timeline, sumber daya, dan anggaran) bersama tim terkait.
  • Mengelola dan memantau progres proyek untuk memastikan kesesuaian dengan rencana yang telah disetujui.
  • Mengoordinasikan aktivitas tim lintas fungsi, termasuk tim internal serta vendor/mitra.
  • Mengidentifikasi, menganalisis, dan mengelola risiko serta isu proyek.
  • Menyusun dan mempresentasikan laporan status proyek secara berkala kepada manajemen.
  • Memastikan seluruh deliverable proyek memenuhi standar kualitas dan kebutuhan bisnis.
  • Mengelola perubahan ruang lingkup (change request) serta menilai dampaknya terhadap proyek.
  • Mendokumentasikan proses, keputusan, dan hasil proyek sebagai referensi untuk inisiatif selanjutnya.
  • Mendukung proses handover serta melakukan evaluasi pascaproyek (post-project review).

Persyaratan

  • Minimal lulusan S1 Teknik Informatika atau Sistem Informasi.
  • Memiliki pengalaman kerja minimal 4 tahun di bidang terkait.
  • Memahami siklus manajemen proyek secara menyeluruh, mulai dari inisiasi hingga penutupan.
  • Terbiasa menggunakan tools manajemen proyek (seperti Jira, Trello, Asana, Microsoft Project, atau sejenisnya).
  • Memiliki kemampuan komunikasi dan koordinasi yang baik dengan berbagai stakeholder.
  • Mampu bekerja secara mandiri maupun kolaboratif dalam tim.
  • Memiliki kemampuan pemecahan masalah yang kuat serta manajemen waktu yang efektif.
  • Memiliki pengalaman dalam lingkungan proyek IT, digital, atau operasional menjadi nilai tambah.
  • Sertifikasi manajemen proyek (seperti PMI, CAPM, PMP, Agile/Scrum) menjadi nilai tambah.
  • Note: Posisi ini juga terbuka untuk level junior dengan pengalaman kerja 2 tahun.

This Senior Data Scientist directly supports Amar Bank’s strategic goals of scaling data-driven lending, improving model governance, and increasing acceptance in new customer segments.

Responsibilities

  • Develop, maintain, and improve credit scoring and risk models using Python and SQL
  • Conduct feature engineering and data analysis to improve model performance
  • Collaborate with business, risk management, and IT to ensure models are deployed successfully
  • Document models and processes according to regulatory and internal standards
  • Contribute to process improvements and adoption of new tools (e.g., Vertex AI)
  • Support knowledge transfer across multicultural teams

  • Proven track record in predictive model development and deployment, ideally in credit risk
  • Strong skills in Python and SQL
  • Understanding of the banking and credit risk domain
  • Experience with cloud platforms (Vertex AI or similar)
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills
  • Ability to work independently and take ownership of projects
  • Fluent English, ability to work in a multicultural environment


Bonus Point

  • Experience with regulatory model governance
  • Prior exposure to Asian financial services markets

Company Description

Mercure Serpong Alam Sutera

Located in the heart of Alam Sutera, Mercure Serpong Alam Sutera is situated between EMC Hospital and Living World Shopping Mall, at the center of the lifestyle, entertainment, and gastronomical hub. Our 171 stylish rooms and modern facilities make our hotel ideal for both business and leisure traveler.

Discover Alam Sutera, well known as the best town for cycling and jogging with a green and healthy environment. Explore the culinary indulgence, entertainment, and shopping experiences, such as Flavor Bliss, Living World, IKEA, and Mall @Alam Sutera.

Job Description

Duty Engineer – Summary of Responsibilities

The Duty Engineer ensures the efficient operation, safety, and maintenance of all hotel engineering systems. The role responds to technical issues and emergencies, carries out preventive maintenance, and coordinates with other departments to support smooth hotel operations and guest comfort.

Key Responsibilities – Duty Engineer

  • Ensures the smooth and continuous operation of all hotel engineering systems, including electrical, mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, fire safety, and building services.
  • Responds promptly to maintenance requests, technical issues, and emergencies to minimize disruption to hotel operations and guest comfort.
  • Conducts routine inspections and preventive maintenance according to schedules and engineering standards.
  • Monitors equipment performance and reports faults, defects, or safety hazards to the Chief Engineer.
  • Ensures compliance with safety regulations, fire life safety standards, and statutory requirements.
  • Supervises contractors and external service providers during repair and maintenance works.
  • Maintains accurate maintenance logs, work orders, and shift handover reports.
  • Coordinates closely with Front Office, Housekeeping, and other departments to support daily operations.
  • Ensures proper use, care, and storage of tools, equipment, and spare parts.
  • Acts as the engineering point of contact during assigned shifts and assumes responsibility in the absence of the Chief Engineer.

Qualifications

  • Diploma or vocational certification in Engineering (Electrical, Mechanical, or related field).
  • Minimum 1–2 years of experience in hotel engineering or a similar hospitality environment.
  • Sound knowledge of electrical, mechanical, plumbing, HVAC, and building maintenance systems.
  • Familiar with fire life safety systems and preventive maintenance practices.
  • Ability to respond effectively to emergencies and work shifts as required.
  • Good communication skills and ability to coordinate with internal departments and contractors.
  • Basic computer skills for maintenance, reporting, and documentation.
  • Knowledge of safety regulations and statutory requirements is an advantage.

Additional Information

Diversity & Inclusion for Accor means welcoming each and everyone and respecting their differences by giving priority only to qualities and skills in extending employment and development opportunities. Our ambition is to provide meaningful employment, a warm and welcoming culture, excellent working conditions and to promote the development of all people, including those with disabilities.

When applying, do not hesitate to let us know of any specific needs you may have so that we can consider them.

descriptionHtml:
Responsibilities

In particular, the e-commerce industry has seen tremendous growth in recent years and has become a hotly contested space amongst leading Internet companies, and its future growth cannot be underestimated. With millions of loyal users globally, we believe TikTok is an ideal platform to deliver a brand new and better e-commerce experience to our users.

As a project intern, you will have the opportunity to engage in impactful short-term projects that provide you with a glimpse of professional real-world experience. You will gain practical skills through on-the-job learning in a fast-paced work environment and develop a deeper understanding of your career interests.

Applications will be reviewed on a rolling basis - we encourage you to apply early. Successful candidates must be able to commit to at least 3 months long internship period.

FMCG, Fast Moving Consumer Goods team focuses on acquiring and managing brands and sellers from FMCG Industry. Within this team, you'll experience how data, creativity, and strategy come together to shape successful brand moments. As an intern, you'll support real business initiatives, work closely with multiple internal stakeholders.

Responsibilities

  • Assisting the team in the process of data tracking, campaign submission and helping the team recap daily alignment.
  • Managing sellers accounts. Tasks include seller education, problem solving, campaign status update and other operation related tasks.
  • Communicating with sellers to ensure that all of their needs are understood and addressed.
  • Assisting the sellers during the onboarding process, tasks included educating the sellers, problem troubleshooting, campaign status update.
  • Other admin-related work and troubleshooting.

Qualifications

Minimum Qualifications

  • Actively enrolled university student
  • An outstanding appreciation for accuracy of information and clean, perfect formatting
  • Highly motivated to learn about social commerce, enthusiastic and shows initiative
  • Strong analytical skills with good knowledge of Microsoft Office & Google Workspace tools

Preferred Qualifications

  • Familiar with Capcut and Video editing is a plus.
  • Prior internship experience in e-commerce is a plus.

By submitting an application for this role, you accept and agree to our global applicant privacy policy, which may be accessed here: https://careers.tiktok.com/legal/privacy.

If you have any questions, please reach out to us at apac-earlycareers@tiktok.com

Job Information

About TikTok

TikTok is the leading destination for short-form mobile video. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. TikTok's global headquarters are in Los Angeles and Singapore, and we also have offices in New York City, London, Dublin, Paris, Berlin, Dubai, Jakarta, Seoul, and Tokyo.

Why Join Us

Inspiring creativity is at the core of TikTok's mission. Our innovative product is built to help people authentically express themselves, discover and connect – and our global, diverse teams make that possible. Together, we create value for our communities, inspire creativity and bring joy - a mission we work towards every day.

We strive to do great things with great people. We lead with curiosity, humility, and a desire to make impact in a rapidly growing tech company. Every challenge is an opportunity to learn and innovate as one team. We're resilient and embrace challenges as they come. By constantly iterating and fostering an "Always Day 1" mindset, we achieve meaningful breakthroughs for ourselves, our company, and our users. When we create and grow together, the possibilities are limitless. Join us.

Diversity & Inclusion

TikTok is committed to creating an inclusive space where employees are valued for their skills, experiences, and unique perspectives. Our platform connects people from across the globe and so does our workplace. At TikTok, our mission is to inspire creativity and bring joy. To achieve that goal, we are committed to celebrating our diverse voices and to creating an environment that reflects the many communities we reach. We are passionate about this and hope you are too.

About Igloo

Igloo (formerly Axinan) is the first full-stack insurtech firm to emerge from Singapore. With offices across Singapore, Indonesia, Thailand, the Philippines, Vietnam, Malaysia, China and India, Igloo is fueled by a mission of making insurance accessible and affordable for all. Igloo's innovation solutions empower companies to eliminate operational risk, drive new revenue streams and optimise and enhance their existing products and services. With a successful Pre-Series C fund round of US$36 million in Dec 2023, Igloo has now raised over US$100 million. The leading regional insurtech firm looks to expand regionally with strategic acquisitions and hiring great talent.

As a passionate team building meaningful solutions to make an impact, we are looking for like-minded individuals to join us at Igloo. At our core, we prioritise teamwork and foster a culture built on strong collaboration and we are looking for talented people like you.

Role Summary: The Technical Owner

The Regional Solutions Architect is the foundational technical resource responsible for the design, integrity, and successful deployment of Igloo Tech Solutions for our enterprise clients across the Asia Pacific region. This role acts as the technical bridge, translating complex client needs (especially from financial services and insurance giants) into deployable solutions using our modular, AI-powered platform.

You will play a direct role in commercial growth by winning the technical argument and ensuring a clean handoff to delivery, taking ownership of the solution from the first demo through to the initial project phase.

Key Responsibilities & Functions

A. Technical Sales & Solution Design 

  • Solution Blueprinting: Lead technical discovery sessions to deeply understand client pain points (e.g., related to legacy systems, operational inefficiency, or distribution gaps) and design the optimal technical solution blueprint leveraging Igloo's platform (Turbo, UIP, UCP, etc.)
  • High-Fidelity Demos: Conduct compelling, tailored product demonstrations and technical workshops for executive (CTO, Head of Digital) and technical audiences, focusing on architecture, integration, security, and scalability
  • RFP & Proposal Leadership: Strategically manage the technical component of all Requests for Proposals (RFPs), Requests for Information (RFIs), and commercial proposals, ensuring absolute accuracy and a clear technical rationale for the proposed solution
  • Technical Vetting: Serve as the technical point-of-contact, addressing all due diligence questions related to system integration, API architecture, data security (e.g., PII handling), and cloud deployment models
B. Project Execution & Delivery Support (Startup Ownership)

  • Project Scoping & Handoff: Own the transition from sales to implementation. Provide the Project Management team with detailed, signed-off technical specifications, effort estimates, and risk logs to ensure a smooth, low-friction technical kickoff
  • Project Support: In a startup capacity, provide necessary technical support during the early delivery phase, guiding the client and internal teams on architectural decisions, integration sequencing, and initial configuration
  • Mitigation & Troubleshooting: Proactively identify potential technical blockers or scope risks during the pre-sales process (e.g., as learned from projects like CIMB PH and AmMetLife MY) and work with technical teams to define mitigation strategies before they impact delivery timelines
C. Product Strategy & Market Intelligence

  • Requirements Loop: Systematically capture, structure, and prioritize client feedback and functional gaps identified during the GTM process
  • Roadmap Influence: Act as the voice of the APAC client and market, collaborating closely with Product Managers to translate commercial opportunities and competitor intelligence (GTM and product features) into actionable input for the core product roadmap, especially around AI and data capabilities (e.g., AI Claims assistance, AI Sales assistance)
  • Enablement: Develop and maintain technical collateral, including architecture diagrams, integration guides, and internal competitive battlecards to enable the wider Commercial team


Requirements

A. Experience

  • Minimum 5+ years in a client-facing technical role (Solutions Architect, Technical Solutions Engineer, or Principal Consultant) within an Enterprise B2B SaaS company
  • Deep domain expertise working with Financial Services and Insurance carriers in the APAC region
  • Proven track record of success supporting a sales team to achieve targets in complex, multi-stakeholder enterprise deals
B. Technical & Architectural Skills

  • Strong conceptual understanding of modular SaaS platforms that are configurable (not custom-coded) and delivered via a robust API-first strategy
  • Proficient in discussing system integrations, data models, cloud environments, AI implementations, and enterprise security protocols
  • Familiarity with the insurance value chain (distribution, policy admin, claims) and how technology (like Igloo's Tech Solutions) can be implemented alongside or parallel to legacy core systems
C. The Startup Mindset (Critical for Success)

  • Owner-Operator: Demonstrated history of taking end-to-end ownership of technical solutions from initial concept to successful project handoff
  • Proactivity & Bias for Action: Must be a self-starter with the curiosity to constantly learn about new market trends (e.g., embedded insurance, digital banks) and emerging technology (AI/ML) to develop new solution ideas
  • Exceptional Communication: Highly articulate and able to bridge the communication gap between business (commercial team, client executives) and deep technical teams (engineers, security team)
  • Agile Acumen: Experience working within an agile or fast-paced delivery environment, understanding the balance between architectural perfection and speed-to-market

Company Description

Cermati is a financial technology (fintech) startup based in Indonesia. Cermati simplifies the process of finding and applying for financial product by bringing everything online so people can shop around for financial products online and can apply online without having to physically visit a bank.

Our team hailed from Silicon Valley Tech companies such as Google, Microsoft, LinkedIn and Sofi as well as Indonesian startups such as Doku, Touchten. We have graduates from well known universities such as Universitas Indonesia, ITB, Stanford, University of Washington, Cornell and many others. We are building a company with the same culture of openness, transparency, drive and meritocracy as Silicon Valley companies. Join us in our cause to build a world class fintech company in Indonesia.

  • Good knowledge in network, hardware, software and printer troubleshooting.
  • Able to work overtime and shifting.
  • Have a good problem solving skills.
  • Have a good communication skills.
  • Fresh graduate are welcome to apply.

Industry: Manufacturing

Location: Batam, Indonesia

We are supporting a manufacturing organization in identifying a Plastic Molding Engineer who will take ownership of injection molding process performance across tooling, production, and quality. This role is suited for someone who enjoys being hands-on on the shop floor while also driving structured process improvements.

What The Role Is About

This position focuses on ensuring injection molding processes run consistently, efficiently, and to specification. The engineer will be involved from early mold trials through mass production, acting as a technical problem-solver and a bridge between tooling, production, and quality teams.

Key Focus Areas

  • Drive stability and repeatability of injection molding processes for existing and new products
  • Analyze and resolve molding-related issues such as dimensional variation, cosmetic defects, and cycle inefficiencies
  • Define optimal machine parameters and validate processes using data-driven and scientific molding approaches
  • Support mold trials and provide technical input on mold design, performance, and maintenance requirements
  • Partner with Quality to ensure parts meet functional and regulatory standards, including process control implementation
  • Provide day-to-day technical guidance to production teams to reduce downtime and scrap
  • Document processes, analyze production trends, and contribute to continuous improvement and cost reduction initiatives


What Were Looking For

  • A degree in Mechanical Engineering, Manufacturing Engineering, or a related field
  • At least 3 years of practical experience in plastic injection molding within a structured manufacturing setup
  • Strong understanding of thermoplastic materials, mold behavior, and injection molding machines
  • Experience supporting validation activities and controlled manufacturing processes is highly valued
  • Ability to read technical drawings and collaborate effectively with tooling and design teams
  • A proactive, solution-oriented mindset with the ability to communicate clearly across functions


Work Context

  • Factory-based role with direct exposure to molding machines and tooling operations
  • Requires flexibility to support production during critical periods or trials

Meratus Group is a leading integrated maritime and logistics operator in Indonesia, pioneering innovative solutions that drive efficiency and sustainability in the industry. Populix is a consumer insights platform that helps businesses connect with its database of respondents and provides them with insights to better understand the preferences of Indonesian consumers. Responsibilities

  • Melakukan instalasi, konfigurasi, patching, dan upgrade pada sistem Data Platform (Data Warehouse, Big Data, dan MDM).
  • Mengelola user, role, serta akses kontrol pada berbagai lingkungan data.
  • Menjamin ketersediaan, keamanan, kepatuhan, serta recovery sistem.
  • Monitoring performa sistem (aplikasi, database, query, dan infrastruktur) serta melakukan tuning.
  • Menangani backup, restore, dan prosedur disaster recovery.
  • Melakukan troubleshooting serta menyelesaikan insiden pada sistem Data Warehouse, Big Data, dan MDM.
  • Mengelola data model, metadata, dan reference data dalam platform MDM.
  • Mendukung tim Data Governance dalam memastikan kualitas data, data stewardship, lineage, dan kepatuhan.
  • Bekerja sama dengan tim DBA, Data Engineer, Application, serta stakeholder lintas fungsi.
  • Membuat dan memelihara dokumentasi teknis (konfigurasi, prosedur, penanganan insiden).
  • Melakukan capacity planning untuk kebutuhan compute, storage, dan network.
  • Mengembangkan infrastruktur Big Data dengan automation dan tools modern.
  • Mendukung integrasi antar sistem (ETL/ELT, REST/SOAP APIs, Kafka, MQ, dll).
  • Menyediakan laporan, dukungan audit, serta monitoring operasional.
  • Siap standby 24/7 bila diperlukan untuk mendukung operasional kritis.

Requirements

  • Minimal S1 di bidang Ilmu Komputer, Sistem Informasi, atau bidang terkait.
  • Memiliki pengalaman 3–5 tahun sebagai System Administrator / Application Administrator / Data Platform Administrator (Data Warehouse, Big Data, MDM).
  • Menguasai Linux/Windows Server administration dan shell scripting.
  • Penguasaan SQL serta pengalaman dengan database relasional (Oracle, SQL Server, PostgreSQL, MySQL).
  • Pengalaman langsung dengan:

Data Warehouse: Oracle, Teradata, Snowflake, Redshift, BigQuery, Informatica, Talend, SSIS, dbt.

Big Data: Hadoop ecosystem (HDFS, Hive, HBase, Spark, YARN), Kafka, Cloudera, Kubernetes.

MDM: Informatica MDM, IBM InfoSphere MDM, SAP MDG, atau setara.

  • Familiar dengan cloud platform (AWS, Azure, GCP) dan container environment.
  • Pengalaman menggunakan monitoring tools (Zabbix, Prometheus, Grafana).
  • Pengetahuan konsep data governance, hierarchy management, dan golden record.
  • Familiar dengan sistem storage, IAM, VPN, firewall, dan konsep high availability.
  • Mampu menulis dan memahami script (Shell, Python, Java, Perl, Ruby).
  • Memiliki kemampuan problem solving, analitis, dan komunikasi yang baik.
  • Dapat bekerja kolaboratif dengan tim lintas fungsi (Data Governance, DBA, Application Support, Security).
  • Memiliki sertifikasi profesional (Informatica, Cloudera, AWS, GCP, Azure) menjadi nilai tambah.

You will work side by side with Analysts and Machine Learning Engineers and take full ownership of your work – from the initial idea-generation phase to the implementation of the final product. Our ideal candidate is result-focused, innovative, has a solid quantitative background and a good business understanding.

  • Working in a multi-disciplined team where you’ll take full ownership of turning discoveries and ideas into machine learning models.

  • Exposure to RDBMS (i.e. MySQL, PostgreSQL) and No-SQL platforms (i.e. S3).

The Role

About This Role

We’re seeking a Graphic and Presentation Designer to create compelling visual content that helps us fulfill our mission to be the most helpful creative platform in the world. This role focuses on designing engaging presentation decks and other creative assets while collaborating closely with clients and internal teams.

This is part of our active talent pool. We review applications continuously, and strong candidates are kept under consideration and may be fast-tracked once a matching opportunity becomes available.

Work Hours: 9:00 AM – 6:00 PM PST/EST

Location: Remote, open to candidates in Argentina, Mexico, Colombia, Peru, the Philippines, Malaysia, Indonesia, or India.

What You’ll Do

  • Develop and design engaging and professional digital/print assets and slide decks that align with client brand guidelines and storytelling requirements using various design tools such as Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop, InDesign, Canva, PowerPoint, Google Slides, and Figma
  • Handle multiple design projects per day across various industries.
  • Engage regularly with Customers, Team/Production Coordinators, Art Directors, Quality Specialists, and other Creatives.
  • Engage with Design Pickle's customers, understanding their queue and overall process, and address graphic design-related concerns effectively.
  • Collaborate closely with the Team Coordinator, Quality Specialists, and other team members to ensure design quality adheres to brand guidelines.

Do you have a passion for digital innovation and the curiosity to explore how technology can make a meaningful difference in the lives of patients? If you have the passion and the drive to accelerate growth and make people’s lives better - then AstraZeneca is the place for you.


ABOUT ASTRAZENECA

AstraZeneca is a global, science-led, patient-focused biopharmaceutical company that focuses on the discovery, development and commercialization of prescription medicines for some of the world’s most serious diseases. But we’re more than one of the world’s leading pharmaceutical companies.


At AstraZeneca, we unlock the power of what science can do. Empowered to explore, everyday we work towards our ultimate aim – treating, preventing, modifying and even curing complex diseases.


What you’ll do

General Accountabilities:

  • Project Coordination: Support planning, scheduling, and execution of IT and AI-related projects; maintain project plans, RAID logs (risks, assumptions, issues, dependencies), and status reports.
  • Stakeholder Management: Liaise with cross-functional teams in Indonesia and global stakeholders; coordinate meetings, track actions, and ensure timely follow-ups.
  • Documentation & Governance: Prepare project documentation (charters, meeting minutes, change requests), ensure adherence to PMO standards, and assist with compliance and audit readiness.
  • Progress Tracking & Reporting: Consolidate metrics, create dashboards, and present updates on scope, timelines, and budget to project leads.
  • Resource & Vendor Coordination: Help align internal resources and external partners/vendors; support procurement, SOWs, and onboarding processes.
  • Process Improvement: Identify bottlenecks, propose improvements to workflows, and contribute to playbooks and templates.
  • AI Innovation Support: Coordinate pilots and proof-of-concepts for AI solutions (e.g., automation, data/ML platforms, GenAI use cases), track success criteria, and document learnings.
  • Change & Communications: Draft internal comms, training materials, and guides to support change management and user adoption.


Essential for the role

  • Education: Currently pursuing or recently completed a bachelor’s degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or related fields.
  • AI/Data Exposure: Interest in AI/ML, data analytics, or automation; ability to learn quickly in emerging tech environments.
  • Communication: Strong written and verbal communication in English and Bahasa Indonesia; comfortable engaging with local and international stakeholders.
  • Organization: Excellent coordination, attention to detail, and time management; proactive, resourceful, and comfortable in fast-paced settings.


This vacancy is open for fresh graduates or final-year students with no classes to attend.


Why AstraZeneca?

Here you’ll have the opportunity to make a meaningful difference to patients’ lives. With science at its heart, this is the place where breakthroughs born in the lab become transformative medicines – for the world’s most complex diseases. Answer unmet medical needs by pioneering the next wave of science, focusing on outcomes and shaping the patient ecosystem.

With our ground-breaking pipeline, the outlook is bright. Be proud to be part of a place that has achieved so much, yet is still moving forward. There’s no better time to join our global, growing enterprise as we lead the way for healthcare and society.


So, what’s next?

  • Are you already imagining yourself joining our team? Good, because we can’t wait to hear from you.
  • Are you ready to bring new ideas and fresh thinking to the table? Brilliant! We have one seat available and we hope it’s yours.
  • If you’re curious to know more then please reach out to Evita Marsha Steffiani Rinaldy. We welcome your application.


Where can I find out more?

Our Social Media, Follow AstraZeneca on LinkedIn

Follow AstraZeneca on Facebook

Follow AstraZeneca on Instagram

Job Title: Data Scientist

Location: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

Company: Axross Pte Ltd

Type: Full-Time

About Us

At Axross, we’re building advanced HVAC AI solutions to optimise energy efficiency in industries like pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and precision manufacturing. Our systems help manufacturers better control the production environment while reducing energy consumption, contributing to cost reductions and environmental sustainability.

We are looking for a Data Scientist who is passionate about applying data science, machine learning, and AI techniques to real-world industrial challenges. Join us in pushing the boundaries of innovation by developing intelligent systems that can drive significant energy and operational efficiencies.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement advanced machine learning models (e.g., reinforcement learning, supervised learning) for real-time optimization of HVAC systems.
  • Work with dynamic simulation models to predict and optimise the performance of industrial systems.
  • Analyse large datasets, including plant and environmental data such as temperature, humidity, and energy consumption metrics.
  • Build and refine predictive models for energy demand forecasting and optimise control strategies across different industrial applications.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (AI engineers, product managers) to deploy models in production environments.
  • Design and evaluate experiments to test and validate model performance, ensuring alignment with energy efficiency goals.
  • Continuously enhance models to improve prediction accuracy and system control.
  • Present findings, analysis, and insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Have at least 2 years experience with ETL processes and model optimization techniques like feature selection, hyper-parameter tuning, and model validation.
  • Proficient in programming languages like Python, R, or Java, with a strong foundation in designing algorithms using various data structures.
  • Solid understanding of dynamic simulation models and / or digital twins for system optimization.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Azure, AWS) for deploying AI models.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex data insights to a diverse audience.
  • Deep understanding and hands-on experience with predictive modelling algorithms like logistic regression, neural networks, decision trees, and heuristic models.
  • Ability to work efficiently with different teams and independently learn new concepts or techniques.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience in energy optimization, manufacturing, or industrial IoT projects is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning and control theory is highly desirable.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with real-world impact.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing industry focused on sustainability and innovation.

If you’re excited about using data science and AI to solve industrial challenges and drive sustainable solutions, we’d love to hear from you!

Responsibilities

About The Role

At Tentang Anak, we move super fast because we work for the needs of 80 million Indonesian children & families that can’t wait. We seek people who are hungry to solve the problem, accountable & bring speed in everything they do.

The Child Health Manager will be pivotal in positioning Tentang Anak as the leading expert-driven company championing interdisciplinary excellence. Serving as both manager and individual contributor, this role strengthens the organization’s impact through integrated, evidence-based research initiatives while ensuring accuracy, credibility, and societal relevance across all outputs. Acting as the evidence backbone, the Manager provides the research, data, and analysis that underpin strategic decisions and external positioning.

Scope Highlights

  • Research & Evidence Generation – Lead literature reviews, study design, data collection & analysis (quantitative, qualitative, epidemiological, or clinical), translation of findings into practical recommendations.
  • Scientific Rigor & Compliance – Ensure research outputs meet high standards of credibility, validity, and ethical compliance.
  • Innovation & Forward Thinking – Explore and evaluate new tools, digital health technologies, and methodologies to advance child health outcomes.
  • Knowledge Translation – Synthesize and translate research findings into actionable knowledge products (publications, briefs, reports, guidelines).
  • Integration & Dissemination – Embed research evidence into organizational strategies, products, and interventions; present findings at professional forums.
  • Innovation & Forward Thinking – Identify, test, and evaluate innovative tools, methodologies, or digital health solutions to improve child health outcomes.
  • Capacity Building – Mentor junior researchers to foster a culture of innovation and evidence-based practice.

Requirements

Qualifications

  • Education: Medical Doctor (MD) degree is mandatory. A Master’s degree in Public Health, Epidemiology, Child Development, or a related field (PhD preferred) will be considered an advantage.
  • Experience: 4+ years of applied research in health, epidemiology, child development, or social sciences, including study design, data analysis, and publication. Proven ability to conduct systematic reviews or meta-analyses.
  • Research Rigor & Ethics: Demonstrated expertise in designing and managing research projects (quantitative, qualitative, epidemiological, or clinical studies) with methodological rigor and full ethical compliance.
  • Knowledge Translation & Impact: Strong skills in translating research into actionable knowledge products (briefs, reports, guidelines) and integrating evidence into programs, products, or interventions.
  • Collaboration & Interdisciplinary Work: Experience working across disciplines (healthcare, education, technology, policy) and managing multi-stakeholder collaborations. Excellent stakeholder engagement and partnership-building skills.
  • Innovation & Forward Thinking: Proven ability to identify, test, and scale innovative tools, methodologies, or technologies to improve child health outcomes.
  • Leadership & Mentorship: Ability to mentor junior staff or interns, fostering a culture of evidence-based practice and proactive problem-solving.
  • Communication: Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to present complex research clearly to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Job Title: Data Scientist

Location: Kuala Lumpur, Malaysia

Company: Axross Pte Ltd

Type: Full-Time

About Us

At Axross, we’re building advanced HVAC AI solutions to optimise energy efficiency in industries like pharmaceuticals, semiconductors, and precision manufacturing. Our systems help manufacturers better control the production environment while reducing energy consumption, contributing to cost reductions and environmental sustainability.

We are looking for a Data Scientist who is passionate about applying data science, machine learning, and AI techniques to real-world industrial challenges. Join us in pushing the boundaries of innovation by developing intelligent systems that can drive significant energy and operational efficiencies.

Roles And Responsibilities

  • Develop and implement advanced machine learning models (e.g., reinforcement learning, supervised learning) for real-time optimization of HVAC systems.
  • Work with dynamic simulation models to predict and optimise the performance of industrial systems.
  • Analyse large datasets, including plant and environmental data such as temperature, humidity, and energy consumption metrics.
  • Build and refine predictive models for energy demand forecasting and optimise control strategies across different industrial applications.
  • Collaborate with cross-functional teams (AI engineers, product managers) to deploy models in production environments.
  • Design and evaluate experiments to test and validate model performance, ensuring alignment with energy efficiency goals.
  • Continuously enhance models to improve prediction accuracy and system control.
  • Present findings, analysis, and insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Requirements

  • Have at least 2 years experience with ETL processes and model optimization techniques like feature selection, hyper-parameter tuning, and model validation.
  • Proficient in programming languages like Python, R, or Java, with a strong foundation in designing algorithms using various data structures.
  • Solid understanding of dynamic simulation models and / or digital twins for system optimization.
  • Experience with cloud platforms (e.g., Microsoft Azure, AWS) for deploying AI models.
  • Strong analytical thinking, problem-solving skills, and attention to detail.
  • Excellent communication skills with the ability to convey complex data insights to a diverse audience.
  • Deep understanding and hands-on experience with predictive modelling algorithms like logistic regression, neural networks, decision trees, and heuristic models.
  • Ability to work efficiently with different teams and independently learn new concepts or techniques.

Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Data Science, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
  • Experience in energy optimization, manufacturing, or industrial IoT projects is an advantage.
  • Knowledge of reinforcement learning and control theory is highly desirable.

What We Offer

  • The opportunity to work on cutting-edge AI projects with real-world impact.
  • A collaborative and innovative work environment.
  • Competitive salary and benefits.
  • Career growth opportunities in a fast-growing industry focused on sustainability and innovation.

If you’re excited about using data science and AI to solve industrial challenges and drive sustainable solutions, we’d love to hear from you!

descriptionHtml:
Cove started with renting coliving spaces. Now we’ve expanded to more than just coliving spaces, providing flexibility for comfortable and enjoyable long term or short term stays in our beautiful properties. With over 8000 rooms across APAC, we’re living our mission and growing our homes in Singapore, Indonesia, South Korea and Japan.

Believing in the power of a team, we aim to build the leading tech flexible living platform in Asia Pacific, providing high quality and community-centric accommodations. Here we also encourage authenticity and fun to fully embrace being human in a driven and result focused environment to make things happen and ensure the dream becomes a reality.

Working in our Singapore office at Pearl’s Hills terrace, means being surrounded by a unique blend of traditional charm and modern energy. With historic landmarks, cozy cafes, and cultural spots nearby, our office offers an inspiring environment that enhances creativity and productivity.

Come enjoy the journey with us and become a Cove Superstar!

What you’ll be doing: You will be the technical engine behind our Design Team, ensuring that our vision for flexible living comes to life efficiently and accurately. You won't just be drafting; you will be leveraging the latest AI technology to speed up workflows and optimize space planning for our expanding portfolio. This role will be supporting our Singapore team (fully remote).

  • High-Fidelity Modeling: Translate conceptual designs and 2D sketches into detailed LOD 300/400 Revit models for interior fit-outs, including MEP coordination and joinery details.
  • AI-Driven Workflow Integration: Utilize AI-powered Revit plugins and generative design tools (e.g., Veras, TestFit, Hypar, or proprietary scripts) to automate rapid feasibility studies, space planning, and "test-fits" for new potential properties.
  • Documentation & Standards: Generate accurate documentation sets, including floor plans, elevations, sections, and schedules. Maintain and update the Cove BIM Library/Family to ensure brand consistency across thousands of rooms.
  • Visualization: Produce quick, AI-enhanced renders and 3D visualizations to assist stakeholders in decision-making during the early design stages.
  • Clash Detection & Quality Control: Run clash detection reports to identify design conflicts early and ensure all models adhere to Singapore BIM standards and regulatory requirements.
  • Process Optimization: Continuously research and implement new AI tools or Dynamo scripts to automate repetitive drafting tasks, tagging, and room data sheet generation.

What makes you a great fit: You are tech-savvy, precise, and excited about the intersection of architecture and artificial intelligence. You understand that "doing it the way we’ve always done it" isn't enough to scale to the next level.

  • Technical Mastery: 3+ years of professional experience in Interior Design or Architecture with expert-level proficiency in Autodesk Revit.
  • AI & Automation Skillset: Demonstrated experience or strong familiarity with AI tools for architecture (e.g., Midjourney for mood boarding, Veras/EvolveLab for rendering) and visual programming (Dynamo or Grasshopper).
  • Drafting Precision: Strong knowledge of construction detailing, joinery, and local building codes (BCA standards).
  • Software Proficiency: Competency in AutoCAD, SketchUp, and Adobe Creative Suite.
  • Problem Solver: You enjoy troubleshooting technical Revit issues and finding "hacks" or scripts to make work faster.
  • The "Cove" Attitude: You are adaptable, eager to learn, and thrive in a fast-paced startup environment where we work hard but keep the atmosphere fun and authentic.

Our team is built on collaboration, with a strong spirit of camaraderie. Whether you're an experienced professional or new to the industry, you'll find a supportive, welcoming team eager to help you succeed. Together, we push boundaries, break barriers, and achieve success as one.

About The Role

The Business Analyst (BA) acts as a bridge between business stakeholders and technology teams by analyzing business needs, defining requirements, and ensuring solutions deliver measurable business value. The role involves understanding business processes, translating them into functional and non-functional requirements, and supporting the successful delivery of systems, products, or process improvements.

Key Responsibilities

  • Gather, analyze, and document business requirements through workshops, interviews, and data analysis
  • Translate business needs into clear functional specifications, user stories, and acceptance criteria
  • Collaborate with stakeholders, product owners, developers, QA, and operations teams
  • Analyze and map business processes, identify gaps, and recommend improvements
  • Support solution design, UAT planning, execution, and defect resolution
  • Ensure requirements traceability throughout the project lifecycle
  • Assist in change management, impact analysis, and stakeholder communication
  • Produce and maintain documentation such as BRD, FRD, process flows, and system diagrams

Required Qualifications

  • Bachelor’s degree in Information Systems, Business, Computer Science, or a related field
  • Proven experience as a Business Analyst or similar role
  • Strong understanding of SDLC, Agile/Scrum, or Waterfall methodologies
  • Ability to create clear documentation (BRD, user stories, wireframes, process diagrams)
  • Strong analytical, problem-solving, and communication skills
  • Experience working with cross-functional technical and business teams

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience in specific industries (e.g., fintech, banking, insurance, e-commerce)'
  • Familiarity with APIs, databases, and system integrations
  • Experience with tools such as Jira, Confluence, SQL, BPMN, or UML
  • Experience in data analysis, reporting, or product analytics platforms
  • Ability to work in a fast-paced, dynamic environment

We are looking for a QA Intern who is eager to gain hands-on exposure to both Manual and Automation Testing in a real production environment. Job Title : Avionics AME Lead

Position Type : Permanent Full Time

Location : 13-475 Airport Road, Sault Ste. Marie Airport

Posting Expires : When suitable candidates are selected

Job Purpose

Our continuous growth creates a demand for heavy maintenance leads. We service the Dash 8 Q400, Dash 8 100/300 aircrafts, along with, the CRJ100/200/700/900 aircrafts, Boeing 737 (all series) and Embraer E170/175 aircraft.

We expect applicants to be ready to work in a fast-paced work environment. Our role requires individuals to have excellent communication skills with a team player attitude!

Job Description

Reporting to the Production Managers, the AME Avionics Lead is responsible for providing mentorship and guidance to the team responsible for servicing, repair and certification of aircraft electrical and electronic systems in accordance with the policy and procedures defined in both the JD Aero Maintenance Policy Manual (MPM), the applicable Regulations.

Responsibilities And Competencies

  • Actively participate in the JD Aero Safety Management System and Quality Assurance programs
  • Lead and mentor junior team members, including planning and organizing works tasks
  • Review work scope, estimate materials and labour, submit requests for materials to stores
  • Perform all avionics maintenance on aircraft pitot static, communication, navigation, autopilot, flight director, flight management, and ELT in accordance with Transport Canada Regulations and Standards
  • Perform modifications to previously mentioned avionic systems in accordance with manufacturers service bulletins, engineering instructions, airworthiness directives or Transport Canada approved supplementary type certifications
  • Ensure the proper certification of all components installed on aircraft
  • Ensure timely and accurate Technical Record entries are completed as required
  • Identify defects and ensure Service Difficulty Reports are submitted for avionics in accordance with the regulatory requirements
  • Ensure all applicable equipment is properly maintained and facilities are clean, safe and appropriately equipped
  • Provide mentorship and supervision of non-licensed personnel ensuring that critical knowledge and workmanship is transferred to them
  • Lead by example and be a positive role model for others to follow
  • Perform other related activities, as necessary or as assigned by management
  • Respect and uphold all the Company policies, procedures & performance expectations Communicate any discrepancies, process gaps or noticeable trends to Executive Management
  • Adhere to and participate in the Company SMS program
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of the Department
  • Other duties as assigned

Qualifications

  • Valid Transport Canada Aircraft Maintenance Engineer ‘E’ License required
  • Post-Secondary education in recognized Aircraft Maintenance/Avionics Engineer Program
  • Minimum three (3) years of experience working as an Aircraft Maintenance Engineer in Avionics
  • Previous experience as a team lead or supervisor considered an asset
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Outlook, Word, Excel) and familiarity with ERP systems
  • Positive ‘can-do’ attitude as well as proven expertise in performing Avionics maintenance and repairs in accordance with their training, regulatory requirements and company procedures.
  • Knowledge of avionics materials and parts and a strong understanding of the regulations governing their acceptance for certified aircraft and the process of quarantine action.
  • Proven success in performing under pressure and the ability to multitask while paying close attention to details and the surrounding environment
  • Exceptional communication skills, both verbal and written to ensure safe and compliant outcomes
  • Strong attention to detail and organizational skills
  • Ability to perform physical tasks, including lifting and moving items weighing up to 50 pounds

Why JD Aero Technical

JD Aero Technical was established in 2007 and we are in our sixteenth year of operation as the chosen heavy maintenance provider for several of North America’s regional aircraft operators. We are looking to add to our group of over 100 employees who have all worked hard to build our diversified and experienced workforce. We offer competitive wages with good opportunities for overtime while maintaining a healthy work life balance.

Successful candidates will receive a competitive salary. Based on your commitment and dedication, there is the opportunity for training and room to grow.

Typical Benefits Include

  • Competitive Wages
  • Life Insurance
  • Extended Health & Dental Care
  • Health & Wellness Benefits
  • Paid vacation in accordance with Federal Government Requirements

Working Hours

Working hours are mainly 7:00 am to 3:30 pm and 8:00 am to 4:30 Monday to Friday with rotating weekend shifts. Extra hours may be required to support operation at critical times.

How To Apply

If you are interested in this job opportunity and possess the required qualifications, please email your resume and references to careers@jdaeromaintenance.com

We appreciate all interested applications; however only those selected for an interview will be contacted.

Please quote the job title you are applying for in the email subject line.

PwC Indonesia is an inclusive and equal-opportunity employer that does not discriminate based on physical disabilities, gender, race, religion, or age. Your application will be treated fairly and assessed solely based on job requirements and competencies.

At PwC, our people in strategy consulting focus on providing strategic guidance and insights to organisations. They analyse market trends, assess business performance, and develop recommendations to help clients achieve their goals. These individuals work closely with clients to identify opportunities for growth, optimise operations, and enhance overall business performance.

As a corporate and business strategy consultant at PwC, you will analyse client needs, provide consulting services across different strategic areas, and offer guidance and support to help clients develop and implement effective strategies that align with their business objectives and drive growth.

The Strategy & Operations Internship at PwC offers undergraduate and graduate students the opportunity to work with industry-leading teams on strategic consulting engagements. Interns will gain firsthand experience and insights into the consulting profession, working closely with our professionals in developing innovative solutions to complex business challenges.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Support engagement teams in conducting research, analyses, and problem-solving related to client needs and business strategies.
  • Assist in the preparation of reports, presentations, and proposals for clients.
  • Participate in meetings and workshops with both internal teams and clients to discuss project progress and findings.
  • Collaborate with team members to design efficient business processes and develop actionable insights.
  • Facilitate the development of recommendations to drive client business performance and growth.
  • Help maintain project documentation and ensure effective communication across teams.

Benefits of the Internship:

  • Direct experience working within a global consulting framework.
  • Exposure to senior leaders and industry experts.
  • Development of skills and competencies relevant to consulting and advisory roles.
  • Networking opportunities with PwC professionals during firm-wide events.
  • Potential consideration for future full-time positions upon successful completion of the internship.

Requirements:

  • A final year students and/or fresh graduates from reputable universities, majoring in Business Administration, Economics, Finance, Management, Engineering, Computer/Technology sciences.
  • A minimum GPA is 3.5 (out of 4.00) or equivalent
  • Strong analytical and quantitative skills, with the ability to think strategically and solve complex problems.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively within a team environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite (e.g., Excel, PowerPoint, Word).
  • Knowledge of business process improvement methodologies is a plus.
  • Enthusiasm for learning and the ability to adapt quickly in a dynamic environment.
  • Added value if you have strong skills in data science, technology-related, other relevant certifications (i.e: CFA)
  • Able to join full time for a minimum period of 3 months

ONLY SHORTLISTED CANDIDATES WILL BE CONTACTED FOR FURTHER RECRUITMENT PROCESS

descriptionHtml:
Responsibilities

We are seeking a dedicated GDS Helpdesk Support Specialist to assist our client in delivering high-quality operational and customer support. In this role, you will serve as the main point of contact between service providers and customers, offering timely and accurate assistance.

You will handle issues of moderate complexity, requiring sound judgment, problem analysis, and adherence to established procedures. The ideal candidate is detail-oriented, organized, proactive, and capable of delivering excellent service in a fast-paced environment.

Key Responsibilities

  • Provide helpdesk support to customers through email, chat, or phone.
  • Troubleshoot and resolve issues using the client’s GDS platform and tools.
  • Analyze customer inquiries and determine appropriate actions within defined guidelines.
  • Maintain accurate records of customer interactions and support activities.
  • Collaborate with internal teams and service providers to escalate or resolve issues as needed.
  • Ensure timely follow-up and meet established service level standards.

Requirements

Qualifications & Skills

  • Experience with GDS systems (e.g., Amadeus) is highly preferred.
  • Prior experience in helpdesk, customer support, or technical support roles.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
  • Detail-oriented with strong organizational and record-keeping abilities.
  • Ability to work independently with minimal supervision.

Be Part of the ATI Journey

Our aim at ATI Business Group in working with our Clients is to support their continued growth by providing cost-effective technology and talented & scalable people resources on demand. ATI’s singular focus on providing services to the travel and hospitality business communities across the globe has been a remarkably successful one. Since commencing in 2002, we now have over 1,300 employees providing services to our clients worldwide.
