We have established strategic partnerships with leading telecommunication companies and banks to design and develop branchless banking platforms, server-based e-money systems, and internal enterprise information systems. Our solutions empower various business sectors to scale and expand their market reach across cities throughout Indonesia.Role OverviewThe development of reliable applications and systems must be supported by a robust and secure infrastructure, with database infrastructure being a critical component. As a Database Engineer, you will be responsible for managing database systems from an infrastructure and security perspective. This role involves supporting the installation, configuration, optimization, and deployment of database servers to ensure system reliability, performance, and data integrity.Responsibilities

  • Installation, configuration, and maintenance of MySQL/Percona/MariaDB databases.
  • Database performance monitoring (CPU, memory, disk, IOPS, connections, query latency).
  • Analysis and optimization of slow queries, indexing, SPs, and database structures.
  • Database backup and restore management (logical and physical) and periodic recovery testing.
  • Implementation and maintenance of replication/high availability (Master-Slave, Galera/PXC).
  • Layer 2/Layer 3 database incident handling (performance drops, replication lag, corruption).
  • Database security implementation: user and privilege management, audit logs, secure access.
  • Support for Disaster Recovery Plan (DRP) and information security audit requirements.
  • Documentation of SOPs, runbooks, and regular database health reports.
  • Collaboration with Developers, SysOps, DevOps, and IT Security regarding application requirements.

Requirement

  • Bachelor’s degree (S1/D3) in Computer Science, Information Systems, or equivalent.
  • 3–4 years of hands-on experience managing MySQL databases in production environments.
  • Strong knowledge of MySQL (InnoDB, indexing, transactions, locking).
  • Experience with database backup, restore, performance tuning, and troubleshooting.
  • Proficient in Linux command line (Red Hat–based).
  • Experience with monitoring tools (Prometheus, Grafana, Zabbix, or equivalent).
  • Basic understanding of networking and system security.
  • Familiar with automation (Shell Script/Ansible) and cloud databases (AWS RDS or Cloud SQL) is a plus.
  • Strong problem-solving skills, attention to detail, ownership mindset, and effective cross-team communication.

This role is ideal for an engineer who enjoys owning product design from early concept discussions through validation, testing, and handover to production, while working closely with customers and internal stakeholders.

What The Role Is About

This position sits within the R&D Engineering function and reports into senior product engineering leadership. The engineer will be actively involved in customer-facing design discussions, product trials, and technical problem-solving across the product lifecycle.

Key Responsibilities

  • Lead product design activities from concept development through final release
  • Engage directly with customers on design discussions, technical alignment, and project progress updates
  • Support prototype builds, sample trials, and product testing activities
  • Investigate and resolve design, process, and performance-related issues
  • Manage product development tasks to meet technical, quality, and timeline requirements

  • Familiarity with environmental and regulatory requirements such as RoHS and REACH
  • Proficient in CAD tools, particularly SolidWorks or Creo (mandatory)

  • Knowledge of quality systems such as IATF/TS 16949, ISO 9001, or ISO 13485 is an advantage


Work Context

  • R&D-focused role based in Batam with close interaction across engineering, production, and customers
  • Hands-on involvement throughout development, testing, and industrialization phases

descriptionHtml:
We are seeking a talented Python Developer to join our team and help build cutting-edge AI-based solutions, including intelligent chatbots and conversational AI systems. You'll work on developing innovative applications that leverage Large Language Models (LLMs) and modern AI technologies to solve real-world problems.

Key Responsibilities

  • Design and develop AI-powered chatbots and conversational interfaces
  • Integrate Large Language Models (OpenAI, Anthropic Claude, etc.) into production applications
  • Build and maintain REST APIs for AI services
  • Implement RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) systems and vector databases
  • Design scalable and maintainable backend architectures
  • Collaborate with stakeholders to understand requirements and translate them into technical solutions
  • Optimize AI applications for performance, cost, and user experience
  • Ensure security best practices in all implementations

Mandatory Requirements

Core Programming Skills

  • Strong proficiency in Python 3.x with deep understanding of best practices
  • Solid grasp of object-oriented programming (OOP) principles and design patterns
  • Understanding of asynchronous programming concepts and when to apply them
  • Experience with code organization, modularity, and writing maintainable code

AI & LLM Expertise

  • Understanding of how Large Language Models work (tokens, context windows, limitations)
  • Knowledge of prompt engineering principles and techniques
  • Understanding of when to use RAG vs fine-tuning vs prompt engineering
  • Awareness of AI limitations, hallucinations, and mitigation strategies

Backend Development

  • Experience building REST APIs with Python frameworks
  • Strong understanding of API design principles
  • Knowledge of database design fundamentals (SQL and/or NoSQL)
  • Understanding of authentication and authorization mechanisms

System Design

  • Ability to design scalable and maintainable system architectures
  • Understanding of performance considerations and optimization strategies
  • Knowledge of security best practices and data protection

Soft Skills

  • Strong problem-solving and debugging abilities
  • Excellent communication skills
  • Ability to break down complex problems systematically
  • Self-motivated with ability to work independently

Preferred Qualifications (Advantages)

  • Experience with LLM frameworks (LangChain, LlamaIndex, Haystack)
  • Hands-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, or Django
  • Familiarity with vector databases (Pinecone, Weaviate, ChromaDB, FAISS)
  • Experience with NLP libraries (spaCy, NLTK, Hugging Face Transformers)
  • Knowledge of cloud platforms (AWS, Google Cloud, or Azure)
  • Experience with Docker and containerization
  • Understanding of CI/CD pipelines
  • Previous chatbot development experience (Rasa, Botpress, or similar)
  • Experience with ML frameworks (scikit-learn, TensorFlow, PyTorch)
  • Portfolio of AI/chatbot projects

  • Experience in fraud detection, risk analysis, compliance, or similar field
  • Strong analytical skills, high attention to details, and high standard of integrity & ethics
  • Ability to make quick, data-informed insights and decisions
  • Prior experience in logistic industry is an advantage

About Company


Hyundai Motor Asia Pacific – Regional Office (HMAP HQ) operates as the regional arm of Hyundai Motor Company, committed to advancing the future of mobility and fostering an EV ecosystem across the region.

Extending across Southeast Asia and the Pacific, HMAP HQ actively supports and collaborates with its subsidiaries in promoting and selling a diverse range of vehicles.

Our regional network includes sales subsidiaries, manufacturing plants, and distributor partners.


About Role


The role is responsible for establishing and executing comprehensive project plans, including the management of progress, schedules, costs, quality, and risks, while ensuring successful delivery and full accountability for project outcomes. The role involves coordinating data integration and analysis across internal systems, leading and implementing data-related projects, and identifying inefficiencies to drive continuous improvement and operational excellence.


Job Description:

  • Define project goals, scope, schedules, and methods
  • Ensure the availability of necessary resources (e.g., human, material, budget) and oversee the entire project lifecycle to keep it on track, on time, and within budget
  • Identify and manage risks. Address issues quickly to minimize impact and keep the project aligned with its goals
  • Closely work with key stakeholders (Business Users, HQ, Dealers, Partners, etc.) to ensure smooth communication and alignment on system requirements, improvements and goals
  • Analyze deliverables to confirm alignment with project objectives and identify unmet areas, outlining plans for improvement or follow-up action
  • Analyze the data, especially sales data to improve performance and ensure data accuracy across multiple systems (e.g. DMS, CRM, ERP, etc.)
  • Promote the use of analytics tools (e.g. PowerBI, Tableau, etc.) among business users and support business monetization through data-driven insights
  • Support global data integration and alignment across regional teams


Requirements:

  • Must have at least 5 year of work experience in the same or related role as an IT Project Manager and Data Analytics
  • Integrated an analytical thinking ability (problem recognition/analysis/solution)
  • Strong experience in managing multiple cross-functional IT projects, system integrations, and process improvements. Also, ensuring timely delivery within scope and budget
  • Expertise in project management methodologies, product lifecycle management, and IT system implementations
  • Strong ability to analyze business requirements and translate them into actionable IT solutions
  • Excellent leadership, communication, and problem-solving skills with the ability to engage effectively with both technical and non-technical stakeholders
  • Actively contribute to system evaluation, testing, bug tracking, and improvements to enhance product performance and end-user satisfaction
  • Excellent written and verbal communications in English
  • Domain knowledge in Sales, Customer, Product, Manufacturing, Service, and Quality data
  • Comprehensive understanding of IT systems and data architecture, including development frameworks, processes, system and data structures
  • Have experience and knowledge about data platforms or data analytics tools (e.g. PowerBI)

Join Hostinger, and we’ll grow fast! 🚀

We’re shaping the future of online success - powered by AI and driven by people. With 900+ talented professionals and over 4 million clients in 150 countries, we help creators and entrepreneurs bring their ideas to life faster and easier than ever before.

Our mission: To provide tools that help individuals and small businesses succeed online faster and easier.

Our culture: Guided by 10 company principles.

Our formula for success: Customer obsession, innovative products, and talented teams.

Your role at Hostinger

System Administrator Manager in the Product team. As part of Hostinger's Product team, you'll lead the SysAdmin Indonesian team. While you are technically credible and know the details of what engineers work on, your time will be spent safeguarding your team’s health, hiring world-class people, and putting them in the best position to succeed. You will own the delivery of product commitments and always look to improve productivity. In this role, you'll collaborate closely with Lithuanian and Brazilian SysAdmin teams, developers, engineers, and product managers.

Curious to learn more? Connect with your team: Eimantas Šerpenskas, Engineering manager

Your skills and experience:


  • You have been supporting enterprise-level Linux environments, resolving technical system problems, including product, database, and linux optimization, for 3+ years;
  • You have been technically leading and mentoring an engineering team for 1+ years;
  • You understand the on-premises infrastructure and cloud-based systems;
  • Your English skills are C1 - C2;
  • You are a constant learner who loves Linux and is truly passionate about IT, engineering, and people




Your day-to-day:


  • Keep Hostinger’s Web Hosting Monitoring team in an always-ready state;
  • Provide long-term engineering solutions for Hostinger’s Web Hosting services;
  • Coach, onboard new team members and provide day-to-day team leadership and supervision;
  • Foster technical decision-making on the team but make final decisions when necessary;
  • Analyze system performance and solve technical issues;
  • Plan and deliver team KPIs and find ways to increase team efficiency and performance;
  • Coordinate and automate deployment, monitoring, maintenance, and support of systems and services;
  • Identify service problems from the client’s side and advise colleagues on difficult cases;
  • Monitor and optimize Hostinger service performance using Grafana, Kibana, Elasticsearch, Prometheus, Ansible, and other tools;
  • Ensure uptime of core services;
  • Make sure retention strategies and downtime handling procedures are followed;




Benefits for you:


  • 🚀 360 Growth: We provide limitless learning opportunities: access to platforms like Reforge and CoachHub, global conferences, physical and digital libraries, and feedback culture. Advance your career with internal mobility and grow with a team eager to share knowledge and support your success
  • 🎯 Freedom & responsibility: Work on your terms: from a modern office in Yogyakarta or your home office. Enjoy flexibility in managing your schedule and bring your ideas to life in a fast-paced, dynamic environment
  • 💪 Wellness simplified: Your health comes first with private insurance, Headspace subscriptions, recharge leave, and regular health checks. Join sports, arts, and hobby clubs or simply enjoy the balance of a lifestyle that prioritizes wellness
  • 🎉 Work hard - play hard: Recognize hard work with company events, Town Hall, Meet the Client initiatives, team-buildings, and workations. Celebrate life’s big moments with milestone gifts for weddings, new parenthood, and graduations




Get ready to take your personal and professional growth to new heights! Join Hostinger today and be part of our journey 🚀

About the Company

We are an emerging Web3 venture portfolio building next-generation blockchain products spanning DeFi, tokenized assets, digital infrastructure, and crypto-native financial services. Our team consists of global founders, engineers, and strategists exploring high-impact applications of decentralized technologies in real-world markets. We are now seeking a Head of Product & Technology to lead the technical vision, product roadmap, and development culture across multiple Web3 initiatives.


Role Overview

As the Head of Product & Technology, you will drive the conceptualization, architecture, and implementation of innovative blockchain products. You will bridge high-level strategy with deep technical execution — defining the roadmap, guiding engineering teams, and ensuring product and protocol security.

The ideal candidate combines hands-on blockchain engineering expertise (in Rust and Solidity) with broad product leadership experience across smart contract systems, DeFi protocols, and tokenized financial infrastructure.


Key Responsibilities

  • Define and lead the technical and product vision across the organization’s Web3 portfolio.
  • Oversee architecture, development, and integration of smart contract systems across multiple networks (EVM and non-EVM).
  • Build, mentor, and manage engineering and product teams — fostering excellence in blockchain development and security practices.
  • Drive end-to-end product design from ideation to deployment, balancing user needs, scalability, and compliance considerations.
  • Ensure rigorous smart contract auditing, testing, and operational security standards.
  • Collaborate with founders, investors, and external partners on ecosystem integrations, tokenomics design, and cross-chain interoperability.
  • Maintain a forward-looking perspective on blockchain frameworks, protocol innovation, and technical governance models.


Qualifications

  • 8–10+ years of experience in software engineering, with at least 4+ years in blockchain or decentralized protocol development.
  • Proficiency in Rust and Solidity, with proven experience in building and deploying smart contracts or blockchain-based systems.
  • Deep understanding of Web3 architecture, including consensus mechanisms, on-chain/off-chain data flows, wallet infrastructure, and decentralized security.
  • Demonstrated success leading technical teams or building products from concept to launch.
  • Strong grasp of protocol security, formal verification, and best practices in decentralized systems.
  • Excellent communication and leadership skills, with the ability to align business objectives with technical roadmaps.


Preferred (Nice to Have)

  • Experience with Substrate, Cosmos SDK, Layer 2 scaling, or ZK-based protocols.
  • Familiarity with front-end Web3 integration frameworks (e.g., ethers.js, wagmi, or wallet SDKs).
  • Prior startup or venture studio experience, ideally in a multi-project environment.
  • Exposure to token economics design and decentralized governance models.


Why Join

  • Shape the technical direction of an ambitious Web3 venture portfolio.
  • Work hands-on with emerging blockchain technologies while mentoring world-class engineers.
  • Competitive compensation package with upside potential in multiple projects (e.g., tokens or equity).
  • Based in Jakarta, one of Southeast Asia’s fast-growing digital innovation hubs, with a flexible and globally connected culture.

descriptionHtml:
We deliver the best GIS solutions in the world, with the brightest minds on the map.

What are the issues that matter most to you? Climate change, national security, disaster response?

At Esri Indonesia you'll work with people at the forefront of these issues, connect them with the best tech and solutions and get an inside look into the real-world challenges that shape our future.

We turn problems into opportunities, and that takes two things:

  • The most powerful GIS technology and solutions.
  • Driven, talented, and passionately curious people.

Here we connect them, and that’s how we achieve incredible things for communities, economies, and for your career.


About the Role

As a Data Scientist in the Solution Engineering department, you will support and collaborate with Solution Engineers to design and develop GeoAI models, as well as train and experiment with various data types.

As data scientist you will be responsible for key tasks such as:

  • Design and implement scalable GeoAI with a strong emphasis on geospatial use cases.
  • Manage the end-to-end GeoAI lifecycle: data preparation, model development, model evaluation, inferencing, accuracy assessment, model deployment, and model management.
  • Integrate AI and GIS workflows within enterprise systems to enhance mapping processes and generate actionable insights.
  • Work with large-scale geospatial datasets (satellite, aerial imagery, drone imagery, LiDAR, IoT, sensor data, and spatial databases).
  • Collaborate with Solution Engineering teams to design data-driven solutions that address business needs and industry challenges.
  • Collaborate with Implementation teams to deliver GeoAI-enabled projects for customers and partners.
  • Support solution deployment in enterprise environments, including cloud services, containers, and scalable infrastructure.
  • Document methodologies, workflows, and technical processes in a clear and structured manner.
  • Explore and evaluate Esri product capabilities and innovations, stay current with new features and best practices, and participate enablement programs to share knowledge with internal teams, customers, and partners.


About You

We are looking for an experienced Data Scientist with knowledge in GIS, particularly in Image Processing, along with a strong understanding of Big Data, IoT, Machine Learning, and Artificial Intelligence concepts to drive successful development of a scalable GeoAI solutions.

  • Min. bachelor’s degree in IT, Computer Sciences, Mathematics, Statistics, or any related fields.
  • Min 2 years of professional experience as Data Scientist, Machine Learning Engineer, or equivalent role.
  • Strong experience with Machine Learning & Deep Learning frameworks (TensorFlow, PyTorch, Scikit-learn).
  • Proficiency in Python for data science, AI model development, and automation.
  • Familiarity with Big Data, IoT, and statistics as applied to geospatial AI.
  • Knowledge of model deployment techniques (containers, APIs, cloud platforms like AWS/Azure/GCP).
  • Familiarity with REST APIs and solution integration approaches.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with the ability to structure complex challenges.
  • Excellent communication skills to present technical insights to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to write clear, well-structured technical documentation.
  • Understanding of GIS concepts and practical experience in geospatial analysis and image processing, is an advantage.

OceanX

About OceanX:

OceanX is a nonprofit working to unlock the ocean's sustainable potential. Through a dual focus on science and education, we're building a new paradigm where humanity and the ocean mutually thrive. Our approach is fueled by exploration, leveraging advanced research, multimedia educational programs, cross-sector partnerships, and advanced technology to help transform how people understand and value the ocean. Our work strives to fortify biodiversity and increase the sustainable use of ocean resources to help ensure the ocean remains a foundation for human wellbeing and potential. OceanX is a nonprofit operating program of Dalio Philanthropies.

For more information, visit www.oceanx.org and follow OceanX on Facebook, Instagram, X (formerly Twitter), TikTok, LinkedIn, and YouTube.

Position Summary:

OceanX is seeking an APAC Science Partnerships Associate to support the organization's work across Science, Education, Partnerships, and Missions by coordinating and facilitating partnerships, research, and regional programs throughout the Asia Pacific. This role focuses on enabling strategic engagement with government agencies, universities, and NGOs, supporting program implementation, and ensuring alignment with OceanX's broader regional and mission objectives.

The Associate will serve as a local point of contact in Southeast Asia for operational and research initiatives, contribute to data collection and analysis, and help translate scientific priorities into actionable programs that advance OceanX's mission in the region.

OceanX is an entrepreneurial environment which values team players who can manage priorities and workstreams simultaneously. To thrive and succeed within our unique culture and work environment, you must demonstrate humility, innate curiosity, and openness to new ideas/approaches. You also must be hard working, composed and goal oriented. All employees are expected to be honest, excited about providing and receiving objective feedback, constantly striving for self-improvement, and committed to the pursuit of excellence.

Note:

While the role will work closely with the OceanX team in support of OceanX initiatives, it will be formally employed and managed by a third-party staffing partner.

Position Location:



This is a remote position open to professionals legally authorized to work in Indonesia.

Duties and Responsibilities:

  • Support engagement with government ministries, regional research agencies, and local NGOs to advance OceanX programs in Southeast Asia.
  • Facilitate meetings, workshops, and stakeholder dialogues to strengthen partnerships and ensure program alignment.
  • Assist in identifying regional priorities, opportunities, and constraints to inform OceanX's program strategy.
  • Monitor policy and scientific developments relevant to OceanX's mission, providing timely insights to internal teams.
  • Collect, compile, and analyze environmental, policy, and scientific data to support program design and evaluation.
  • Prepare reports, briefs, and presentation materials for internal and external stakeholders.
  • Support expedition and project planning, including logistics, documentation, and coordination with internal teams and external partners.
  • Track program progress, monitor deliverables, and maintain accurate records of initiatives, partnerships, and commitments.
  • Assist in organizing events, workshops, and knowledge-sharing forums across multi-stakeholder groups.
  • Contribute to research on ecosystem services, conservation initiatives, and regional environmental priorities.
  • Willingness for travel, primarily within the region and to the vessel.
  • Willingness to work flexible hours, including early mornings or late evenings, to support cross-time zone collaboration.
  • Adaptable to varying workloads, balancing periods of focused execution with lighter operational phases.
  • Additional duties as assigned.

Qualifications:

  • Professional Experience:
    • Bachelor's degree in environmental science, policy, economics, or a related field.
    • Minimum 3 years of experience in environmental research, policy, or program coordination.
    • Demonstrated experience engaging with government agencies, NGOs, and local stakeholders.
    • Strong organizational and project management skills with keen attention to detail.
    • Proven ability to collect, analyze, and synthesize data to inform decision-making.
    • Experience supporting multi-stakeholder or regional environmental programs is highly desirable.
    • Familiarity with ocean, water, or climate-related programs in Southeast Asia.
    • Experience contributing to multi-year, multi-stakeholder environmental or scientific initiatives.
    • Ability to work and thrive in an entrepreneurial, rapidly evolving environment, with significant ambiguity
    • Ability to communicate effectively in written and oral communications
    • Proven track record in taking initiative and be able to multi-task, interface with various members of the team and conduct him/herself with the utmost professional manner when working with internal and external colleagues
  • Personal Attributes:
    • Determined, resourceful and practical. An independent, self-starter, with a "roll up your sleeves" attitude and strong work ethic
    • Agility, with a track record of getting things done
    • Organized, reliable, and meticulous
    • Ability to prioritize, meet tight deadlines, anticipate needs, and maintain high quality work
    • Strong interpersonal and communication skills (written and verbal)
    • Comfortable with ambiguity
    • Maintains high standards
    • Highly collaborative
    • General curiosity and passion for the Ocean
Compensation:

Compensation for the role includes a competitive salary based on relevant experience, education, and skillset, along with a comprehensive benefits package.

Please note that we do not provide immigration sponsorship for this position.

All correspondence will remain confidential.

At the DFO, we believe our biggest asset is our people. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer, hiring and developing individuals from diverse backgrounds and experiences to add to our collaborative culture. The DFO treats all candidates and employees with respect and does not discriminate in our recruiting, hiring, and promoting processes and general treatment during employment, including on the basis of actual or perceived race, creed, color, religion, sex, age, sexual orientation, gender identity and/or expression, alienage or national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, marital status, veteran status, or disability.

Deskripsi Pekerjaan:

  • Mengawasi seluruh kegiatan operasional dispatch, termasuk dispatch operation, dispatch analyst, serta tim hardware & network engineer untuk memastikan operasional dispatch berjalan lancar dan efisien.
  • Mengatur, mendukung, dan mengembangkan tim dispatch agar mampu mengelola main fleet (dump truck, excavator, shovel, dll.) dan support fleet (grader, dozer, water truck, dll.) secara efektif.
  • Membangun dan menjaga komunikasi yang aktif dan produktif antara tim dispatch dengan departemen terkait seperti produksi, maintenance, dan engineering.
  • Bertanggung jawab atas pelaksanaan dan keberhasilan implementasi sistem Fleet Management System (FMS) di site.
  • Memastikan semua perangkat FMS (hardware & software) berfungsi optimal, serta melakukan koordinasi dengan pihak vendor bila diperlukan.
  • Memantau performa alat berat secara real-time dan melakukan tindakan cepat untuk mengurangi idle time dan meningkatkan produktivitas.
  • Menyusun SOP, pelatihan, serta pengembangan skill bagi tim dispatch.
  • Menyediakan laporan performa harian, mingguan, dan bulanan terkait efektivitas dispatch dan utilisasi fleet.


Kualifikasi:

  • Pendidikan minimal D3/S1 di bidang Teknik Pertambangan, Teknik Industri, Sistem Informasi, atau setara.
  • Memiliki pengalaman minimal 3 tahun di bidang dispatcher, fleet management, atau sejenisnya di industri pertambangan.
  • Memiliki pengetahuan dan pengalaman dalam menggunakan FMS
  • Mampu menganalisis data operasional dan membuat laporan performa fleet.
  • Menguasai konsep cycle time, productivity, fleet allocation, dan pemahaman alat berat tambang.
  • Terbiasa bekerja dengan tim multi-disiplin dan mampu mengambil keputusan cepat di lapangan.
  • Mampu memimpin tim kecil dan melakukan coaching/pelatihan.
  • Komunikatif, tegas, dan memiliki integritas tinggi.
  • Memiliki pengalaman dalam implementasi awal sistem FMS akan menjadi nilai tambah
  • Menguasai tools analitik seperti Excel tingkat lanjut, Power BI, atau software reporting lainnya akan menjadi nilai tambah
  • Memiliki kemampuan dasar troubleshooting hardware/network FMS akan menjadi nilai tambah
  • Lokasi bekerja di Morowali, Sulawesi Tengah

descriptionHtml:
Join the revolution in hospitality tech!

Liven is a leading global data, technology, and customer experience provider for the hospitality industry. From humble beginnings, we have grown to serve over 6,000 venues and millions of diners across Australia, the USA, and Southeast Asia, processing over 120 million transactions worth more than $3 billion (AUD) annually.

At Liven, our platform is built to help hospitality businesses save more and work smarter by seamlessly integrating every aspect of their operations — from ordering and payments to back-of-house management.

Driven by a deep passion for the hospitality industry, we continuously innovate to elevate the experience for both venues and their guests. Our solutions are powered by AI-enriched insights and automated workflows, enabling smarter decision-making and smoother operations at scale.

We’re proud to be an AI-first organisation. By automating repetitive tasks, we free up space for our teams — and our customers — to focus on what truly matters: solving complex problems, delighting guests, and driving meaningful growth.

Key Milestones

  • Expansion: Acquired OrderUp, Abacus, Zeemart, Copper and Nomnie forming Asia Pacific’s largest end-to-end group in hospitality technology.
  • Global Reach: From Melbourne to New York, Singapore to Jakarta, and all the way to Chennai, our presence spans major cities across the globe.

If you're someone who thrives on creativity, bold thinking, and using technology to make things better, faster, and smarter — you’ll feel right at home here.

Here’s a Quick Glimpse Of Liven

  • You can visit Career
  • You can visit LinkedIn
  • You can Visit Blog
  • Acquisition News

About The Role

At Liven, we’re transforming the way businesses in hospitality and beyond connect with their customers. As a Client Onboarding Consultant, you will play a pivotal role in helping new clients unlock value from our platform from day one. You’ll guide them through a smooth onboarding experience, ensure their account is configured correctly, and drive early activation of key features.

You will be the first trusted partner in their journey — supporting clients as they adopt the platform, resolving barriers early, and ensuring a confident, seamless transition into live usage. This role directly impacts client activation, product adoption, and long-term retention, making it essential to revenue protection and overall client satisfaction.

What You'll Do

  • Own and manage the end-to-end client activation and onboarding journey, ensuring a smooth progression toward successful go-live.
  • Serve as the primary point of contact during activation, building trust and strong client relationships.
  • Configure client accounts and set up platform workflows to support their operational needs.
  • Use CRM and onboarding tools to manage communication, track milestones, and maintain visibility across the activation pipeline.
  • Educate clients on Liven’s features and best practices to drive early adoption and engagement.
  • Identify risks, blockers, or technical issues early and resolve them proactively or escalate when necessary.
  • Collaborate closely with internal teams to deliver a consistent, high-quality activation experience.

Qualifications

  • 2–4 years of experience in onboarding, client activation, client management, or other client-facing roles.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to explain concepts clearly and confidently.
  • Strong problem-solving ability with sharp attention to detail.
  • A client-focused mindset grounded in empathy, professionalism, and proactive support.
  • Comfortable using CRM systems, onboarding tools, and client support platforms.
  • Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  • Proven ability to collaborate effectively across cross-functional teams.

Good to Have

  • Strong interpersonal skills with the ability to build trust quickly.
  • Confidence managing multiple activation or onboarding projects simultaneously.
  • Experience delivering training sessions, product walkthroughs, or client education.
  • A proactive approach to identifying risks or barriers and implementing timely solutions.
  • Tech-savvy, with the ability to learn new systems and tools quickly.

Was Du bei uns machst

Du entwickelst und realisierst Steuerungs- und Bedienkonzepte für unsere Anlagen – von der Idee bis zur Inbetriebnahme. In enger Abstimmung mit unseren Kund:innen übersetzt du komplexe Anforderungen in durchdachte, praxistaugliche Lösungen.

Konkret Bedeutet Das

  • Planung und Abstimmung von Montage-, Steuerungs- und Bedienkonzepten gemeinsam mit unseren Kund:innen
  • Projektbezogene Anpassung und Weiterentwicklung unserer standardisierten SPS-Programme
  • Service, Fernwartung und technische Unterstützung bestehender Maschinen und Anlagen
  • Weltweite Kaltinbetriebnahmen unserer Anlagen (ca. 30 % Reisetätigkeit)
  • Durchführung von Kundenschulungen sowie Erstellung technischer Dokumentationen

Was Du mitbringst

Du Passt Gut Zu Uns, Wenn Du

  • Ein Studium oder eine Technikerausbildung im Bereich Elektrotechnik (oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation) mitbringst
  • Strukturiert arbeitest und Verantwortung für Deine Lösungen übernimmst
  • Erfahrung in der Antriebstechnik sowie mit SPS-Systemen von Siemens und/oder Allen Bradley (Rockwell) hast
  • Sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch kommunizierst
  • Technik liebst und Lust hast, Dinge weiterzuentwickeln – nicht nur abzuarbeiten

Was wir Dir bieten

  • Viel Eigenverantwortung und Entscheidungsspielraum
  • Internationale Projekte mit echtem Praxisbezug
  • Kolleg:innen, die fachlich stark sind
  • Ein Umfeld ohne unnötige Bürokratie, dafür mit Vertrauen
  • Raum für neue Ideen und Weiterentwicklung

Über uns

Die IKN (Ingenieurbüro-Kühlerbau-Neustadt) GmbH ist ein mittelständisches Unternehmen, das sich auf die Entwicklung und Herstellung von Klinkerkühlern und Pyroanlagen für die Zementherstellung spezialisiert hat. Das Unternehmen mit Sitz in Neustadt am Rübenberge, Deutschland, wurde 1982 von Dipl.-Ing. Karl von Wedel gegründet. Mit unseren lokalen Niederlassungen in der Tschechischen Republik, Brasilien, den USA und Indien beschäftigen wir weltweit mehr als 180 Mitarbeiter. In den über 40 Jahren unserer Tätigkeit haben wir uns von einem Kühlerspezialisten zu einem Komplettanbieter für komplette Pyroanlagen mit mehr als 800 Referenzen weltweit entwickelt.

Wij zoeken per direct een veiligheidskundige. Een specialist die weet wat het betekent om in een GWW-projectorganisatie te werken. Een laagdrempelige methode die jou en ons helpt het veiligheidsbewustzijn te vergroten op onze projecten in het westen van Nederland.

Als veiligheidskundige binnen Ploegam ben je onderdeel van verschillende projectteams. Je helpt de medewerkers op onze projecten hun werk veilig uit te voeren. Dat betekent dat je zichtbaar bent op de projecten en meedenkt over oplossingen. Het is een praktische functie waarbij je écht onderdeel uitmaakt van de projectteams.

  • Bewaken VGM-prestaties binnen toegewezen projecten
  • Sturen op het melden van gevaarlijke en/of afwijkende situaties
  • Uitvoeren van incidentenonderzoek in samenspel met de leidinggevende.

Wat verwachten we van jou?

  • Een gedreven instelling
  • Een actieve opstelling met oog voor het Ploegam-beleid
  • Samenwerken met het projectteam
  • Kennis en ervaring met VGM op GWW-projecten
  • Een opleiding middelbaar veiligheidskundige en ten minste 3 jaar relevante ervaring
  • Ervaring met het hein-gedachtengoed is een absolute meerwaarde. Heb je nog geen ervaring dan ben je bereid gerichte training te volgen

Wat bieden wij?

  • Een essentiële functie binnen onze projectteams
  • Een uitdagende functie binnen een snelgroeiende organisatie
  • Volop ontwikkelmogelijkheden
  • Ruimte voor werk-privébalans
  • Een organisatie waar het nog echt om de mensen draait
  • Een goede cao (GGI) met onder meer 39 vrije dagen, een fietsplan en met korting sporten
  • Leuke feesten, Solexracefestival en een actieve personeelsvereniging.

Wat maakt een echte Ploegammer?

Iedereen die bij ons werkt is een echte Ploegammer. Allemaal zijn we uniek, maar wij zien toch ook wel wat overeenkomsten. Wij zijn samen werkers, die van aanpakken weten en die hun gezonde boerenverstand gebruiken. En we durven anders te kijken naar projecten en nieuwe oplossingen aan te dragen. Deze aanpak heeft ons al mooie dingen opgeleverd: de Spiegelwaal in Nijmegen, Ooijen-Wanssum, de fietsbrug over de A2 bij Eindhoven, de kunstzinnige Windboom in Bernheze en de eerste elektrische machine. Innovaties die ons verder brengen en die wij dankzij onze mensen hebben gerealiseerd.

Samen duurzaam werken aan een mooier en veiliger Nederland

Ploegam werkt vandaag voor een betere wereld morgen. Van plan tot uitvoering leggen we daarom veel nadruk op duurzame oplossingen, veiligheid voor onze mensen en de omgeving en het milieu. We slagen er in de afvalstromen te verminderen, we hergebruiken materialen en ontwikkelen elektrisch materieel. Op het vlak van veiligheid zetten we ook dagelijks stappen. Ondanks een sterke groei van ons bedrijf, neemt het aantal incidenten af. Ons motto: 'Veilig denken, veilig doen' werpt vruchten af. En daar profiteren niet alleen onze mensen van, ook de omgeving merkt dat wij zorg en aandacht voor hen hebben. Want een goed project is een veilig uitgevoerd project.

Bedrijfsprofiel

Bij Ploegam werken jouw collega’s iedere dag vol passie aan projecten op het gebied van grond-, weg- en waterbouw en transport. Elke opdracht pakken we op de Ploegam-manier aan: gedreven, met kennis van zaken en vaak net even anders - dat is de kracht van ons familiebedrijf. Ploegam staat voor Ploegmakers Aannemingsmaatschappij. Begonnen als klein familiebedrijf in het Brabantse Vinkel, inmiddels uitgegroeid tot serieuze marktspeler met standplaats Oss. Een kleine greep uit onze projecten: wij verzwaren dijken, bouwen bruggen en kades, verplaatsen de loop van een rivier of leggen een wegennetwerk aan. Zo zorgen wij dat Nederland een beetje mooier, maar ook veiliger en duurzamer wordt.

Wij bieden

Een uitdagende en afwisselende functie. Je komt in een sterk groeiend bedrijf terecht met betrokken medewerkers en een familiaire werksfeer. Er zijn uitstekende arbeidsvoorwaarden en ontwikkelingsmogelijkheden op vaktechnisch en/of persoonlijk gebied.

descriptionHtml:
We are inviting qualified candidates to join us as Print Production Manager, based onsite at our client's office in Banten, Indonesia.

Role Description

The Print Production Manager (PPM) is responsible for liaising with the clients and printers, providing internal instruction to modify artwork so that the final print will meet (as close as possible) the original design intent, across multiple packaging types and print processes.

Role And Responsibilities

  • Follow all Standard Working Practices (SWP)
  • Assess new designs, liaising with the client, printer and tooling supplier to agree artwork changes/separation approach, based on the chosen print process
  • Provide Artworkers with technical instructions on artwork separation
  • Support and develop Artworkers to apply reprographics/colour separation with minimum PPM input
  • Train and support new and junior members of the PPM team
  • Specify tooling requirements (where required)
  • Maintain client brand targets and colour standards
  • Maintain printer specification records, and printer qualification
  • Maintain PPM technical records
  • Provide post-print analysis (both measured and visual)
  • Work in conjunction with all other areas of the business to ensure that artwork is generated in the most effective and timely manner possible

Requirements

  • Experience in print and packaging
  • Printing Systems knowledge across a broad range of package types
  • Understanding of colour management / proofing systems
  • Possess excellent project management skills
  • Due to geographical requirements, Bahasa Malay language capability is required in this role
  • Excellent written and spoken English
  • Hybrid work arrangement and work onsite at client's office in Jakarta

Please attach a resume in English language
